izzyondroid:com.bojko108.mobiletileserve.name: Mobile Tile Server
izzyondroid:com.bojko108.mobiletileserve.summary: HTTP Server for your local Map Tiles
izzyondroid:com.bojko108.mobiletileserve.description:
Mobile Tile Server can be used as a HTTP server, serving Map Tiles from the device storage. When the server is running you can access the tiles from different mapping applications.
 The application provides four main options:
 Access of local Map Tiles
 Access of local MBTiles files
 Redirect to a Tile Server with QuadKey Tile schema
 Access static files
 Access to local Map Tiles 
 Local Map Tiles can be accessed on address: http://localhost:PORT/tiles – where PORT is set in application settings. In settings, you must specify a directory, where the files are stored. This directory is used as a root for the server. All files in that directory (including subdirectories) will be accessible from the server.
 Example: If you have map tiles stored in /storage/emulated/0/MobileTileServer/tiles/Plovdiv/{z}_{x}_{y}.png , you can set the root directory to: /storage/emulated/0/MobileTileServer . Then in order to access this map just start the service and navigate to: http://localhost:PORT/tiles/Plovdiv/{z}_{x}_{y}.png .
 In this case the root directory points to the parent folder (which contains ’Plovdiv’ subfolder). This way you can have multiple subfolders containing different map tiles and all can be accessed through the same server!
 Access to local MBTiles files 
 … can be found on address: http://localhost:PORT/mbtiles – where PORT is set in application settings. In settings, you must specify a directory, where the files are stored. This directory is used as a root for the server. All files in that directory (including subdirectories) will be accessible from the server.
 As MBTiles use TMS schema to store map tiles, y coordinate must be transformed in order to locate the correct tile row. If your app uses XYZ tile schema, pass negative value for y (-y) as a parameter.
 There are several parameters, which must be provided:
 ’file’: MBTiles file (including extension)
 ’z’: map zoom level
 ’x’: x coordinate of a map tile
 ’y’: y coordinate of a map tile
 Example: If you have tiles stored in MBTiles format, you can place your files in the root directory and access them with: http://localhost:PORT/mbtiles/?tileset=test.mbtiles&z={z}&x={x}&y={y} or if XYZ schema is used: http://localhost:PORT/mbtiles/?tileset=test.mbtiles&z={z}&x={x}&y=-{y} 
 Redirect to a Tile Server with QuadKey Tile schema 
 Redirect can be accessed on address: http://localhost:PORT/redirect/?url=&quadkey=true&z=&x=&y= – where PORT is set in application settings. In settings, you must specify a directory, where the files are stored. This directory is used as a root for the server. All files in that directory (including subdirectories) will be accessible from the server.
 There are several parameters, which must be provided:
 ’url’: url address on which to redirect
 ’quadkey’: ’true’ if the server uses QuadKey Tile schema
 ’z’: map zoom level
 ’x’: x coordinate of a map tile
 ’y’: y coordinate of a map tile
 Example: If you want to use for example Bing Maps, which uses QuadKey Tile schema and you only have XYZ tile coordinates you can use the redirect option, which will calculate the quadkey value and then will redirect the request to the server. For accessing Bing Maps Aerial map tiles you can navigate to: http://localhost:PORT/redirect/?url=http://ecn.t0.tiles.virtualearth.net/tiles/a{quadkey}.jpeg?g=6201&quadkey=true&z={z}&x={x}&y={y}

izzyondroid:com.rendox.routinetracker.name: Routine Tracker
izzyondroid:com.rendox.routinetracker.summary: planner calendar app and a habit tracker
izzyondroid:com.rendox.routinetracker.description:
Routine Tracker is a planner that aims to simplify managing activities that you need to perform consistently. It combines features of a planner calendar app and a habit tracker allowing you to keep all your activities in one place.
 Features: 
 Flexible schedules: The app supports daily, weekly, monthly, and alternate-day schedules. You're free to choose specific days or inform the app how many times you wish to complete the task within a period.
 Adaptive schedule that changes automatically based on your progress: When you fail to complete your routine, you’ll be suggested to sort out the backlog on the next non-due day. And vice versa, when you over-complete your routine, the next scheduled occurrence will be canceled. This behavior can be altered in the settings.
 Adequate streaks: Streaks do not only form out of multiple completions in a row. Non-due days are included in the streak as well. Your streak will remain unbroken as long as you complete the habit the planned number of times within a given period.
 Plan ahead: The routine calendar displays completions, streaks, and planning dates to help you visualize your progress and plan your future time effectively. View a clean and organized agenda for any date, eliminating visual clutter.
 Modern UI: Enjoy a visually appealing and modern interface, following the principles of the Material You design. The application supports both light and dark modes, landscape orientation, and dynamic color on Android versions 12 and later.
 Completely free app with no limitations: Track as many habits as you wish. Routine Tracker is entirely free and contains no ads or in-app purchases.
 Works offline and respects your privacy: Routine Tracker operates independently without needing an internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential data always remains on your device. Neither the developers nor any third parties can access your information.
 More to come, so stay tuned…

fdroid:app.pagedrop.name: PageDrop
fdroid:app.pagedrop.summary: Find books and send them to your jailbroken Kindle over Wi-Fi
fdroid:app.pagedrop.description:
PageDrop is a phone-first companion for jailbroken Kindles running KOReader. Find a book, convert it if needed, and send it to your Kindle over Wi-Fi, all from one app.
Requires a jailbroken Kindle with KOReader and its SSH server enabled. The in-app "Get your Kindle ready" walkthrough explains each step.
Features:
- Find books in-app across public-domain and open libraries (Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, Internet Archive, Wikisource and more) and your own OPDS catalogs
- Add books from your phone, or capture downloads from websites inside PageDrop
- Converts EPUB, PDF and text to MOBI, with PDF reflow for text PDFs (scanned PDFs are not OCRed)
- Automatic book details: titles, authors and covers
- Send to the Kindle over SSH/SFTP and refresh its library
- Kindle tab: see what is on the Kindle and manage those books
- Conversion server: books that need converting are uploaded to PageDrop's server (it asks first) and deleted about 24 hours later. The server's code is in the repository, so you can run your own. One switch in Settings keeps everything on the phone, and if the server fails the phone converts instead
- Free and open source (GPL-3.0)
PageDrop does not host or provide books. Some book sources and websites may offer material that is not freely licensed; you are responsible for respecting copyright law in your country.
No account, no analytics, no ads. Which hosts PageDrop contacts: https://github.com/spandan-kumar/PageDrop/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.

fdroid:app.palimpsest.name: Palimpsest
fdroid:app.palimpsest.summary: Encrypted notes, diary and to-dos with hidden vaults behind one password
fdroid:app.palimpsest.description:
Palimpsest is an encrypted diary and notes app with deniable vaults : one password field, any number of vaults, and no way to tell from the file how many there are. Every password opens its own vault. A decoy password shows a believable diary; another shows the real one.
 Experimental, not audited. It protects against a curious partner, a thief and a quick border check. It does not protect against a forensic lab, spyware on the phone, or someone who keeps demanding passwords. If an adversary keeps copies of the file from different moments and knows a decoy password, a hidden vault can give itself away. The threat model in the source repository has the details.
 Writing 
 Notes in a grid with folders, tags, pins and colours; a diary with a timeline and a month calendar; to-dos
 Markdown editor that hides the markers away from the line you edit
 Photos and voice notes captured in memory, never in the gallery; photos cropped before they are stored, EXIF and location dropped
 Links between entries, backlinks and a graph of links where you link entries by dragging one onto another
 Search, search inside an entry, trash with 30-day expiry
 Vaults 
 Create, change the password, delete a vault (its blocks are overwritten in place)
 A one-shot rule: on the next opening of this vault, destroy the vault with password X
 Backup of everything, restore, export of one vault under its own password, import with merging
 Privacy 
 No internet permission, no trackers, no ads
 Screenshots blocked unless you allow them; no preview in recent apps
 Incognito keyboard, no autofill, copied text cleared after 60 seconds
 Locks on screen off, after idle time and in the background
 The core is written in Rust: Argon2id, XChaCha20-Poly1305 and BLAKE2b; the container is a pile of 4096-byte blocks that all look like random bytes, with random chaff added all the time.

fdroid:com.awakeonlanmobile.name: AwakeOnLANMobile
fdroid:com.awakeonlanmobile.summary: Send WakeOnLAN packets (IPv4/IPv6) over the internet, includes a CIDR scanner
fdroid:com.awakeonlanmobile.description:
AwakeOnLANMobile enables you to send Wake On LAN ( WOL ) packets, allowing you to remotely wake up your devices over either a local area network (LAN) or over the internet. It supports IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. The application offers several features:
 Open Source : Licensed under GPLv3 License with zero advertisements and no account creation necessary.
 Local Storage : Add, edit, or delete device information for easy access.
 Network Scanning : Discover devices using either an IPv4 address or CIDR notation for subnets (e.g., 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.1.1/24). Choose between PING and TCP connect (sent to Port 443) packets for scanning. PING will require 1 second per IP address, while TCP connect will be faster.
 Theme Toggle : Switch between a light and dark mode theme to customize the appearance based on your preferences. The selected theme will be persisted even after shutting down the application.
 Developed with React Native (Typescript) and utilizes C++ turbo modules for native level socket access when sending and receiving packets. The ./cpp directory contains lightly modified code from 'https://github.com/nellogan/awakeonlan' and 'https://github.com/nellogan/netscan'. These are Linux commandline utilities that can be used in lieu of this application if your device supports a terminal (such as Termux or the new Android AVF Linux terminal).

fdroid:com.demosten.srednabg.name: SrednaBG
fdroid:com.demosten.srednabg.summary: Real-time average speed inside Bulgaria's average-speed camera zones.
fdroid:com.demosten.srednabg.description:
SrednaBG shows your real-time running average speed inside Bulgaria's average-speed camera zones — and tells you the maximum speed you can sustain for the rest of the zone without going over the limit.
Free. Open source. Bulgaria only.
WHAT IT DOES
• Running average, live — The moment you enter a zone, your running average becomes the hero number. No lag, no jitter. Updates every second.
• Max now — Shows the top speed you can drive for the rest of the zone without breaking the limit. Waze tells you the zone exists; SrednaBG tells you what to do about it.
• Green / amber / red at a glance — The screen color tracks your state. Green: within limit. Amber: careful, slow down. Red: already over.
• Voice alerts in Bulgarian and English — Keep your eyes on the road. SrednaBG speaks zone entries, exits, and slowdown warnings in the language you choose.
• Works fully offline — The Bulgaria map and zone list are bundled inside the app. No internet needed in the car. Updates arrive quietly when you're on Wi-Fi.
• Alongside Waze, or instead of it — Run SrednaBG as a full navigator, or let it sit quietly behind Waze / Google Maps — you'll hear its voice when it matters.
PERMISSIONS, EXPLAINED
• Background location — Average-speed zones can be many kilometres long, and a drive often outlasts the screen timeout or runs behind another navigation app. SrednaBG needs location while in the background so your average keeps updating with the screen off or another app in front. It is used only to compute your speed inside zones — never shared, and it never leaves your phone.
• Ignore battery optimizations (optional) — You can grant an exemption so the system doesn't suspend tracking mid-drive. It is optional and requested only from a card you tap; tracking still starts without it, just less reliably on devices with aggressive power management.
PRIVACY
• No cookies, no trackers anywhere.
• No account, no email, no signup. Install and drive.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. Free forever.
• No third-party SDKs. No Google Analytics. No Firebase.
• Your location never leaves your phone.
Open source — MIT License.
Source code: https://github.com/demosten-com/SrednaBG

fdroid:com.harristownapps.lomocamera.name: Lomo Camera

fdroid:com.harristownapps.lomocamera.description:
Lomo Camera is a deliberately tiny, single-purpose Android camera. It opens straight into a live cross-processed Lomo-style preview and saves the same look to the final JPEG.
There are no filter menus, accounts, analytics, ads, gallery browser or network features. The app is designed to behave like a dedicated camera rather than a general-purpose photo editor.
Features:
• live Lomo-style preview with adjustable effect intensity (0–200%) using an invisible right-edge swipe gesture
• original Lomo look at 100%, subtle or unfiltered shots at lower settings, and an extra-vivid high-intensity option
• full-resolution JPEG capture
• tap anywhere on the preview to focus
• pinch to zoom
• flash off, automatic and forced on
• front/rear camera switch
• portrait and landscape controls
• brief visual and haptic shutter feedback
• Lomo strength setting remembered between launches
• photos saved to DCIM/Lomo
Privacy:
Lomo Camera requests only the Android CAMERA permission. It has no INTERNET permission and does not request location access. Photos remain on the device and are saved using Android MediaStore.
The colour treatment is implemented with an independently generated RGB lookup table fitted from user-supplied before/after calibration photographs. No third-party camera application code or assets are included.
Lomo Camera is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

fdroid:com.health.openscale.sync.name: openScale sync
fdroid:com.health.openscale.sync.summary: Synchronize your openScale measurements with external services
fdroid:com.health.openscale.sync.description:
Synchronize your openScale measurements with external services
openScale sync is a companion app: it requires the separate openScale app (a bluetooth body-composition scale app) to be installed. It stores no measurements of its own. It reads them from openScale and forwards them to the services you enable, and it can bring measurements the other way as well, back into openScale.
Features:
* Seamless External Service Integration: Effortlessly synchronize data with Health Connect, Wger, Endurain, SparkyFitness, InfluxDB, generic Webhooks and MQTT (versions 3.1 and 5.0, including Home Assistant discovery).
* Real-time Synchronization: Automatically synchronize data upon insertion, editing, deletion, or clearing of measurements within openScale.
* Two-way Synchronization: Measurements that other apps wrote to Health Connect, Wger or MQTT can be imported back into openScale, filling the gaps your scale did not record. Each service has its own direction setting: export only, import only, or both.
* Optional Background Synchronization: Let the app reconcile everything every few hours, as a safety net for when the instant sync could not run.
* On-Demand Full Synchronization: Initiate a complete data synchronization manually whenever needed.
* Automatic Retry: A sync that could not be delivered is retried on its own with the current data, and any measurement still waiting is shown to you.
* Multi-User Aware: MQTT, InfluxDB and Webhook keep every openScale user separate; Health Connect, Wger, Endurain and SparkyFitness sync the user you select.
* Configurable Service Activation: Easily enable or disable individual external services to tailor your synchronization preferences.
* Intelligent Foreground Service: Utilizes a foreground service that activates only when required, minimizing battery consumption.
* Intuitive User Interface: Enjoy a user-friendly graphical interface for effortless navigation and control.
Your data is never sent anywhere except the services you enable and configure yourself. The app has no ads, no analytics and no accounts.

fdroid:com.raulshma.lenscast.name: LensCast
fdroid:com.raulshma.lenscast.summary: Turn your phone into a networked camera: web, MJPEG and RTSP streaming
fdroid:com.raulshma.lenscast.description:
LensCast turns your Android device into a networked camera station with professional controls, remote web access, interval photography, and scheduled recording.
Camera
• Live preview with a professional quick settings bar
• Manual controls: exposure compensation, ISO, white balance, focus mode, zoom
• Multi-lens support (ultra-wide, wide, telephoto) with runtime lens switching
• HDR, image stabilization, resolution up to 4K, frame rate 15–60 fps
• Photo capture and video recording
• Night vision / IR mode, scene modes, manual focus distance, color temperature
Live streaming
• Real-time MJPEG video streaming to any web browser on the same network
• Low-latency in-browser playback (WebCodecs over WebSocket) with automatic fallback to MJPEG and HLS
• RTSP streaming with AAC audio and H.264/H.265 video at 480p/720p/1080p for VLC, OBS, and NVRs
• ONVIF Profile S device service (off by default) so NVRs such as Home Assistant can discover the camera
• HTTPS mode with a self-signed on-device certificate
Web dashboard
• Watch the live stream, browse and download photos and recordings
• Full remote control of camera and stream settings
• Optional password authentication
Automation
• Object detection gate (optional): the open-source EfficientDet-Lite0 model — Apache-2.0, downloaded on demand with a pinned SHA-256 from TensorFlow's official hosting — triggers MQTT alerts or recording when configured objects appear
• Sound-event gate (optional): the open-source YAMNet model — Apache-2.0, also downloaded on demand with a pinned SHA-256 — triggers alerts or recording when configured sounds are detected
• Interval photography and scheduled or continuous recording
• Quiet hours for notifications
Optional network services (all off by default; each runs only when you enable and configure it)
• Telegram backup: auto-uploads new captures to the Telegram chat you choose (api.telegram.org)
• Web Push notifications: delivers encrypted detection alerts through your browser vendor's push service (such as Google's FCM or Mozilla's autopush)
• Model downloads: the optional detection models above are fetched on demand from TensorFlow's official hosting on Google Cloud storage
• STUN server for WebRTC streaming (WHIP push / WHEP viewing): blank by default, so streaming stays on your local network without contacting any third-party server
No ads, no tracking, no cloud defaults. All processing stays on your device; the web dashboard is served by a built-in HTTP server on your local network.
Note: the F-Droid build ships without the in-app self-updater; updates come from F-Droid.

fdroid:gift.dhamma.noapp.droid.description:
Not App turns your home screen icon into a customizable command center instead

fdroid:org.purplei2p.i2pd.description:
I2P (Invisible Internet Protocol) is a universal anonymous network layer.
All communications over I2P are anonymous and end-to-end encrypted, participants don't reveal their real IP addresses.
 I2P client is a software used for building and using anonymous I2P networks.
Such networks are commonly used for anonymous peer-to-peer applications (filesharing, cryptocurrencies) and anonymous client-server applications (websites, instant messengers, chat-servers).
 I2P allows people from all around the world to communicate and share information without restrictions.

apple-macos:6787358036.name: Calendar Mirror
apple-macos:6787358036.description:
Some calendars you can see but cannot reshare. A subscribed work schedule. A read-only team feed. An account that is not yours.
Calendar Mirror makes an editable copy of one calendar inside another calendar you own — one direction only, so the original is never touched. Because the copy lives in your own account, it reaches your other devices on its own.
PICK TWO CALENDARS
Choose the calendar to copy from and the one to copy into. Add as many pairs as you like; two can share a destination, and anything you add by hand is left alone. Repeating and all-day events, and moved occurrences, all come across.
CHOOSE HOW MUCH CROSSES OVER
Each pair decides: a full copy; titles and locations only; or "Busy" blocks that show your time and nothing else. Put a label in front of copied titles — "[Work] Standup", or "[Work] Busy" — and carry the meeting link into the copy's notes so a mirrored meeting is one you can join.
CHOOSE WHICH EVENTS
A pair can skip meetings you declined or have not answered, events the organizer canceled, all-day events and anything marked free, anything shorter or longer than you like, titles containing words you choose, and anything outside a window of the day on the weekdays you pick. Or tag one event at a time: #nomirror, #private, #public in its notes.
IT TELLS YOU WHEN SOMETHING BREAKS
A healthy pair is silent. If one stops syncing, an all-day warning appears in the destination calendar itself, and clears the moment the pair recovers.
ON IPHONE AND IPAD
Every pair in one list, with its health and event count. Pull down to sync now. Background refreshes run at the interval you choose, when iOS allows — treat it as the earliest a sync may start, not a guarantee.
SEND TIMES
"When are you free?" One tap gives you your next three free times as a line of text — "Tue 2–2:30pm, Wed 10–10:30am or Thu 3–3:30pm MDT" — worked out on your device from the calendars you chose, ready to paste into Messages, Mail or Slack. Also a Shortcuts action and a Siri phrase. Nothing leaves your device.
ASKWHEN.ME — A SEPARATE PRODUCT YOU CAN TURN ON
Off by default; until you turn it on, the app makes no network request of any kind. AskWhen.me is a subscription with its own server: a page at askwhen.me/yourpage where people can ask you for a time.
A request page, not a booking page. Your device works out which times to offer and sends only those — never your calendar, your events, your address, or your name beyond the label you choose. Someone picks a time and says who they are; the request comes to your device, and nothing lands in your calendar until you accept. Your device re-checks the time against your real calendar first.
Send times can carry a personal link: it opens your page once, for a week, and because you sent it there is no email confirmation — if the time is still clear, your device accepts it for you and they get the calendar file.
Free for 90 days, then $19.99 a year; your own name on askwhen.me, or your own domain, are upgrades. Payment is Apple's. The privacy page says what the server holds, and for how long.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
• No scheduling links unless you turn on AskWhen.me, a separate subscription.
• No unified calendar view — it makes copies; your calendar app shows them.
• No team, admin or SSO features. It is a single-person utility.
• Attendees are never copied: Apple's calendar framework cannot set guests.
• It cannot sync a calendar your device cannot already see.
PRIVACY
No account. No analytics, no tracking, no telemetry, no ads. No server, and no network request, until you turn on AskWhen.me — and its server never sees your calendar either. Once a copy lands in iCloud, Google or Exchange, that provider stores it under their policies.

debian-packages:backup2l.name: backup2l
debian-packages:backup2l.description:
backup2l [backup-too-l] is a tool for autonomously generating, maintaining
and restoring backups on a mountable file system (e. g. hard disk). In a
default installation, backups are created regularly by a cron script.
The main design goals are low maintenance effort, efficiency, transparency
and robustness. All control files are stored together with the archives on
the backup device, and their contents are mostly self-explaining. Hence, a
user can - if necessary - browse the files and extract archives manually.
backup2l features differential backups at multiple hierarchical levels.
This allows one to generate small incremental backups at short intervals
while at the same time, the total number of archives only increases
logarithmically with the number of backups since the last full backup.
An open driver architecture allows one to use virtually any archiving
program as a backend. Built-in drivers support .tar.gz, .tar.bz2 and others.
Further user-defined drivers can be added.
An integrated split-and-collect function allows one to comfortably transfer
all or selected archives to a set of CDs or other removable media.

 Backup and Restoration ,

flathub:com.voxdsp.Spaceminer.name: Spaceminer
flathub:com.voxdsp.Spaceminer.description:
The aim of the game, whatever you want, try and mine every asteroid if you can. Or just see how long you can survive in space.
 On the back of his head are four color cubes, these are minerals collected from mining asteroids, these colors are also present in asteroids,
 these minerals are converted into on of the four actions: break/mine, repel, stop, and shield (when shield is empty the two blue fuel
 cylinders will be consumed as shield).
 ESCAPE = Release mouse lock
 N = New Game
 Q = Break Asteroid
 E = Stop all nearby Asteroids
 R = Repel all nearby Asteroids
 W = Thrust Forward
 A = Turn Left
 D = Turn Right
 Shift = Thrust Down
 Space = Thrust Up
 Left Click = Break Asteroid
 Right Click = Repel Asteroid
 Mouse 4 Click = Stop all Asteroids nearby
 Scroll = Zoom in/out
 F = FPS to console
 P = Player stats to console

flathub:io.github.lavenderdotpet.LibreQu.name: LibreQuake
flathub:io.github.lavenderdotpet.LibreQu.description:
The LibreQuake project aims to create a complete, free content first-person shooter game, but
 LibreQuake by itself is just the raw material for a game. It must be paired with a compatible engine
 to be played.
 There is a massive back catalogue, spanning over two decades, containing thousands of Quake
 levels and other modifications (“mods”) made by fans of the game. LibreQuake aims to be compatible
 with these and allows most to be played without the need to use non-free software.
 To install mods for the flatpak version of LibreQuake you need to place them in the ~/.var/app/io.github.lavenderdotpet.LibreQuake/.quakespasm/ 
 directory. This is were your config, screenshots and demos are located too.
 Disclaimer: In its current form LibreQuake is a work in progress effort which may include placeholder
 assets, missing textures or unfinished parts.
 This release is bundled with the quakespasm sourceport which is released under the GPL-2.0 license.
 See the Github page for details about used licenses.

flathub:org.archivekeep.ArchiveKeep.name: ArchiveKeep
flathub:org.archivekeep.ArchiveKeep.description:
ArchiveKeep helps you preserve your personal files by maintaining identical copies across multiple
 storage locations — without risking corruption or data loss during synchronization.
 Once a file is archived, it stays unchanged. ArchiveKeep never overwrites existing copies with
 modifications or corrupted data, ensuring your archives remain intact over time.
 Features:
 Plain files — no proprietary format, readable with any application.
 Incremental synchronization — replicates new files or moves when storages become available,
 working fully offline.
 SHA-256 file fingerprinting — fast verification that catches silent bit-rot before it spreads.
 Multi-platform — available on Linux desktop and Android.
 No vendor lock-in — you control where your files live.
 Supported cloud storages:
 Google Drive — convenient, familiar, widely available.
 S3-compatible APIs — choose any vendor that supports the S3 protocol.
 ArchiveKeep is in active development and improving with each release. Feedback and bug reports
 are welcome.

KeyForge Master configurator is a intuitive software that lets you create custom actions and configurations, turning your KeyForge device into a tailored productivity powerhouse.
 Work smarter, not harder.
 Intuitive: Easy to use, clean design. Customize your device in no time.
 Versatile: Multiple predefined actions to choose from. Also you can create multiple configurations for every use case.
 Complex: You can also create your own custom actions/macros using our drag and drop builder.
 You can create multiple configurations for fun and work in the Settings panel. Switch the active configuration by pressing the Super Key on your device or using the Settings panel. 
 You can create custom actions/macros using Actions Forge, our intuitive solution for creating macros, developed to boost your productivity.

fedora-packages:argon2/argon2.name: argon2
fedora-packages:argon2/argon2.description: Argon2 is a password-hashing function that summarizes the state of the art in the design of memory-hard functions and can be used to hash passwords for credential storage, key derivation, or other applications. It has a simple design aimed at the highest memory filling rate and effective use of multiple computing units, while still providing defense against tradeoff attacks (by exploiting the cache and memory organization of the recent processors). Argon2 has three variants: Argon2i, Argon2d, and Argon2id. * Argon2d is faster and uses data-depending memory access, which makes it highly resistant against GPU cracking attacks and suitable for applications with no threats from side-channel timing attacks (eg. cryptocurrencies). * Argon2i instead uses data-independent memory access, which is preferred for password hashing and password-based key derivation, but it is slower as it makes more passes over the memory to protect from tradeoff attacks. * Argon2id is a hybrid of Argon2i and Argon2d, using a combination of data-depending and data-independent memory accesses, which gives some of Argon2i's resistance to side-channel cache timing attacks and much of Argon2d's resistance to GPU cracking attacks.

fedora-packages:ax86-terminus-ttf-fonts/.summary: Terminus TTF is a monospace TrueType Font
fedora-packages:ax86-terminus-ttf-fonts/.description: Terminus TTF is a TrueType version of Terminus Font, a fixed-width bitmap font optimized for long work with computers. If the application you want to use the font with supports the original Terminus Font, you should really use that one instead of this TTF version — it will most likely be a more pleasant experience for you. There are applications that neither support the original Terminus Font nor use bitmaps embedded in TrueType fonts. They completely rely on the automatically generated scalable outlines. When Terminus TTF is used with such applications, it will probably look a little bit weird and not exactly like the original Terminus Font (since the generated outlines do not exactly match the bitmaps); you will see whether you like it or not. Because the outlines are scalable, it should not matter which size you use, but anything bigger than 32 px (24 pt) will probably not look very nice. It should also be noted that you need to render Terminus TTF in monochrome black/white if the outlines are used; otherwise, they will look smeary.

firefox-addons:3006110.summary: Instantly blur your WhatsApp Web chat list and messages during screen sharing. Toggle privacy on/off with one click or a keyboard shortcut. Supports scheduled privacy, auto screen-share detection, and PIN lock.
firefox-addons:3006110.description:
WhatsApp Web Privacy Mode lets you blur your chat list and message bubbles on WhatsApp Web with a single click — so you can share your screen in meetings, record tutorials, or work in public without exposing private conversations.
Features
One-click toggle — enable or disable privacy mode instantly from the popup
Blur intensity control — adjust blur strength from subtle to fully opaque
Blur areas — blur the sidebar (chat list), message bubbles, or both independently
Hover to Reveal — temporarily unblur content while your cursor hovers over it
Last N Messages Visible — keep the most recent 1–5 messages unblurred while hiding the rest
Panic Key (Ctrl+Shift+P) — instantly cover WhatsApp with a frosted overlay in one keystroke
Keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+O) — toggle privacy mode without opening the popup
Scheduled Privacy — automatically enable privacy mode during set hours every day
Auto Screen Share Detection — activates privacy mode automatically when you start sharing your screen on Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and more
Notification Privacy — hides message content in browser notifications while privacy mode is active
PIN Lock — require a 4-digit PIN to turn privacy mode off, preventing casual disable
Export / Import settings — back up and restore your configuration as a JSON file

firefox-addons:592804.name: Session Sync
firefox-addons:592804.summary:
Save sessions as bookmarks and access them across devices.
Advanced Session Manager: edit, save, change, restore.
It can also be your best Bookmark Manager
firefox-addons:592804.description:
THIS ADDON IS NOT INTENDED FOR AUTO-SAVING OF SESSIONS! 
Save sessions as bookmarks and access them across devices
Using Session Sync you can save sessions as bookmarks .
Use the rich user interface for session management: create, restore, open, edit or delete sessions/bookmarks or add new tabs to a certain session.
 Why save sessions as bookmarks? 
 - all the data saved will be there no matter what addon you may use in the feature
 - when using the url bar, Firefox will automatically suggest links based on your bookmarks
 - easy access/edit/backup and then restore saved data using the integrated Bookmark Manager (even on smartphone / tablet) even if the addon is not installed
 Shortcut keys 
 - CTRL+SHIFT+F - open the Widget UI
 - CTRL+SHIFT+V - open the Tab View
 - CTRL+SHIFT+U - open the Window View
 - Shortcuts configuration can be changed from configuration (Firefox 60 and up, lower version do not offer the API required)
 The sync functionality works with any bookmark synchronization service like: 
 Firefox Sync Account (recommended)
 EverSync
 Session Sync will automatically detect new updates and display the updated sessions list across multiple machines.
General features
 - active session management (move around tabs)
 - advanced bookmark management
 - session restore with lazy-loading
 - session auto-saving (not backed by Bookmarks)
 - history list - session can be saved later as classic bookmark sessions
 - private windows are ignored by auto-save
 - auto-saving is only intended as a nice addition and is not full-featured (please look for other addons for complete auto-saving support) 
 - session filtering (search text) and sorting by name/position/date
 - advanced drag-n-drop UI with fluid animations
 - advance UI scaling for individual UI areas (session list, bookmark list, session header and toolbar)
 - 3 working modes: Panel, Tab View, Window View
 - many other customization
 Required permission explained: 
 Read and modify bookmarks - required for storing sessions as bookmarks as well as interacting with them
 Input data to the clipboard - required for right-click menu in order to copy bookmark title/URL
 Access browser tabs - required in order to be able to read/save browsing session information. (This provides only tab properties and not actual browsing content)
 Store unlimited amount of client-side data - Required for addon Settings, favicon caching, auto-saved history as well as additional information for sessions
 All data is stored local and/or is synced on your Firefox Account (bookmarks).

bluejetty:00129522:ios.description:
The Harvard Evening Van app enables Harvard students, faculty, and administrators to book on-demand shuttle rides during the Evening Van service hours.
The Harvard Evening Van app enables you to book a van to and from anywhere within the campus service area. Harvard Evening Van provides you a safe, convenient travel experience in and around the Harvard University campus. With the app you will be able to select your pick up location, tell us where you want to go, and track your van so you know when to head to the pick up location. The Harvard Evening Van is proudly operated by Harvard Transportation and powered by Via.
A new way to get around the Harvard University campus 
The Harvard Evening Van matches customers with others going in the same direction via a customized and flexible route. Sophisticated technology coordinates your trip, picking you up from near your location or a convenient location nearby, and taking you to where you want to go within the service zone.
On-demand
On average, a vehicle will come in minutes, and you'll always get an estimate of your pickup ETA before booking. You can also track your van in real-time in the app.
Try Harvard Evening Van, a new way to get around the Harvard University campus.
Love our app? Please rate us!
Questions? Email us at shuttle@harvard.edu

bluejetty:00173553:ios.summary: Looking for a satisfying puzzle that’s easy to learn but keeps you thinking? Goods Match 3D - Sorting Games is a relaxing matching game where your goal is simple: find three identical items, match them, and clear the board before the timer
bluejetty:00173553:ios.description:
Looking for a satisfying puzzle that’s easy to learn but keeps you thinking? Goods Match 3D - Sorting Games is a relaxing matching game where your goal is simple: find three identical items, match them, and clear the board before the timer runs out.
Sort goods, organize shelves, and discover a fun triple goods matching experience in 3D. Each level brings a new challenge as you look for the right combinations, match triples, and sort it in 3D before time runs out. 
How to Play
Swap and rearrange adjacent goods to create matches of 3, then clear them from the board. Keep matching and sorting until all the goods are cleared before time runs out. Complete each level to unlock new and exciting challenges as you progress. 
What Makes It Different?
Goods Match 3D combines familiar match-three gameplay with a colorful 3D experience. Each board features its own collection of goods and unique arrangement, giving you a fresh layout to explore and clear. With the timer counting down, you'll need to look carefully, find the right combinations, and decide which three items to match first. Some levels are quick and easy, while others require a little more planning. If you enjoy stuff sort, shelf sort, or closet sort games, you'll love the satisfaction of organizing colorful goods and clearing a crowded board.
Our Features
- Challenging Sorting Gameplay: Dive into a world of goods and engage in addictive sorting puzzles. Swap and match 3 identical goods to clear them from the board and earn points.
- Unique goods: Explore a rich variety of items—from soda drinks and snacks to toys, household goods, and more! 
- Easy Controls: Simple tap-and-drag controls make it easy to swap goods and create matches. 
- Dynamic Level Design: Ever-changing level designs keep the gameplay fresh, fun, and engaging.
- Limited Moves: Plan your moves carefully and make every match count. Can you clear the board before you run out of moves?
- Hidden Surprises: Look closely for hidden boxes and objects that can change how you approach a level.
- Lives to Keep Playing: You get 5 tries to take on each challenge, giving you another chance to complete tricky levels. 
- Unlock Chests & Rewards: Clear more levels to unlock chests and collect exciting rewards as you progress. 
Become a Match Master
Whether you want to unwind after a long day or give your brain a quick, rewarding workout, Goods Match 3D delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and fun. With its vibrant 3D visuals, endless variety of items, and simple yet addictive sorting mechanics, every level offers a fresh challenge that keeps you coming back for more. Download Goods Match 3D - sorting games today, step into the ultimate organizing adventure, and see how fast you can clear the shelves!

bluejetty:00097498:ios.description:
Employee Wellness Hub (EWH) is a health app that allows organizations to manage healthy habits for their employees. The app is first of its kind to manage health challenges, track health vitals, and monitor nutritional intake of their employees. EWH’s nutrition database includes information from 8,000+ food items from the USDA as well as 5,000+ food items from fast food restaurants. EWH App uses advanced motion chip in the smart phone (when available) to track precise movements (steps) and also integrates with Fitbit. The app can be customized for employers in terms of its look and feel and it can be integrated with additional data sources related to fitness and nutrition.Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
App integrates with the Health app.The Health app serves as a central repository for health and fitness data in iOS. With the user’s permission, app can communicate with the Health app to access and share information.

bluejetty:00168061:ios.description:
Fingering Charts is the comprehensive music education app that puts interactive fingering charts for multiple instruments right at your fingertips. Whether you're a student learning your first scales or a music educator teaching a full ensemble, Fingering Charts provides a quick, interactive reference for musicians to master their instrument.

• Interactive Fingering Display
Full-screen fingering charts with clear, easy-to-read layouts that show exactly where to place your fingers.
• Made for iPad and iPhone Duo
On larger screens, the fingering, staff, and keyboard sit side by side. On iPhone Duo, the app works on the cover screen when closed and spreads out when open.
• Director Mode*
Perfect for music educators! View fingerings for multiple instruments simultaneously. Present fingerings clearly to students during lessons and ensemble rehearsals.
• Trill Fingering Charts*

Other Features
• Key Signatures
• Pitch Playback
• Home Screen Widgets
• Written vs. Concert Pitch*
• Custom Themes*
• Audio Mode*
Perfect for:
• Music students of all levels
• Band and orchestra directors
• Private music instructors
• Professional musicians
Trusted by Music Educators
Built with input from professional music educators and designed to support both individual practice and classroom instruction.
*Premium features available via a one-time purchase of $4.99

bluejetty:00141017:ios.name: Unsolved Case Scarlet Hyacinth
bluejetty:00141017:ios.summary: Dive deep into the shadowy underbelly of a city plagued by crime in "Unsolved Case: The Scarlet Hyacinth." This thrilling detective game challenges you to solve criminal cases and uncover a sinister plot linked to a legendary serial killer.
bluejetty:00141017:ios.description:
Dive deep into the shadowy underbelly of a city plagued by crime in "Unsolved Case: The Scarlet Hyacinth." This thrilling detective game challenges you to solve criminal cases and uncover a sinister plot linked to a legendary serial killer. Equipped with your detective prowess and an eye for detail, this mystery hidden object game will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. This game offers a realistic crime scene investigation experience, making it a standout in the realm of mystery hidden object games. Each scene is a puzzle, laden with clues, riddles and brain teasers that only the most attentive players can solve!
You and your partner Scott have a lot of work to do. A man was murdered with a red hyacinth left on his body – the sign of a notorious serial killer from many years ago. You find out that your psychologist Mark Coleman was involved, and then he kills your boss Xavier. You have to get him behind bars as soon as possible, but there is another urgent matter: people are disappearing from their cars. Then the journalist Noah Hall, who got famous due to covering the Red Hyacinth, was murdered as well... Suddenly you will start to see Mark's side of what happened, and maybe even gain some sympathy for the guy. Can you stop this wave of crime? Are you ready to apply your brilliant detective mind to do that? Play now and find out!
· CRIME SCENE INVESTIGATION!
Dive into the world of crime solving games for adults, where every detail counts. Examine crime scenes, seek and find hidden objects, and use your sharp detective skills to piece together complex clues and uncover the truth behind each criminal case!
· TRICKY PUZZLES!
Challenge your intellect with a variety of logic puzzles and brain riddles that are intricately woven into the storyline. This game is perfect for fans of detective games and mystery hidden object games who love testing their problem-solving abilities, find all the hidden objects to earn achievements and highlight your success as a real detective!
· ENIGMATIC STORYLINE!
Get entangled in a criminal case, rich with mystical riddles and unexpected twists. As you delve deeper into the city of crime, the boundary between right and wrong blurs, leaving you to solve the unsolved case files and decide the fate of your characters!
· COLLECTIBLE ITEMS!
Make decisions that will influence the outcome of the detective story in these mystery hidden object games. Seek and find hidden objects and collectible items throughout various crime scenes. Your findings could either lead you to solve the riddle or send you down a path filled with red herrings!
Are you ready to uncover the truth and solve the mysteries that lie hidden in the shadows? Enjoy the free trial version of criminal case, then unlock the full game!

bluejetty:00146784:ios.description:
Have you ever been listening to a song, or have a friend playing some chords and want to know what key the song is in? This app could help.
This little helper can be used to identify the key a song is in via several methods:
 * Analysing live music via the devices's microphone 
 * Analysing a local audio file on the device
 * A set of user-entered chords

bluejetty:00100558:ios.summary:
► LOOKING TO TRAIN YOUR BRAIN?
Right Position is the app you’ve been looking for! Chock full of fun and relaxing brain puzzles, logic games, riddles, and brain teasers, there are always tons of levels to play through when you want to work
bluejetty:00100558:ios.description:
► LOOKING TO TRAIN YOUR BRAIN?
Right Position is the app you’ve been looking for! Chock full of fun and relaxing brain puzzles, logic games, riddles, and brain teasers, there are always tons of levels to play through when you want to work on your problem solving skills and memory in an entertaining way. A variety of brain games of varying difficulty are waiting for you, just begging to be solved!
► PROBLEM SOLVING MADE FUN
Levels consist of a visual puzzle that you need to solve – classic riddles, modern brain teasers, and more are all here. Straightforward instructions allow you to focus on the mental aspect of the brain tests instead of having to slog through rules, and soon you’ll find yourself relaxing and having fun despite your mind working hard to solve these challenging games!
Variety is the spice of life: all manner of concentration games, logic puzzles, and brain tests can appear here! From making sure the faces on everyone in the photo are on the right person, to placing objects in the right place and readjusting what goes where, these light brain games always offer up something different.
Logic made fun: we all know it’s good to work on our memory and logic skills, so why not at least have fun doing it? Brain training and puzzle solving doesn’t have to be a slog thanks to this game, where you can quickly pick it up and play a few levels whenever you feel like a mini challenge.
Great for on the go: get your thinking games and logic puzzles bundled up together, and get them in a format that you can easily play no matter where you are or what’s going on around you. Whip out your phone for a quick mental challenge and (if you’re good!) complete it before anyone even notices.
A chill challenge: Thanks to their short and sweet nature, these logic puzzles and thinking games provide a great way to relax. Give yourself some easy wins and feel good moments as you work on puzzle solving for a bit, then get back to whatever difficult task is at hand, feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
► BRAIN TRAINING AND PUZZLE GAMES DONE RIGHT
Concentration games and brain puzzles don’t have to be difficult to make a difference – so why not pick ones that make you feel good? Right Position has all sorts of light logic games and puzzle games that are sure to tickle your fancy, while also being good for you! So if you’re looking for some challenging games that are still fun and easy to play, give it a download today and see how many levels you can complete before you get stumped!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00096057:ios.summary:

calmi is your ai companion that actually gets it. talk about anything, anytime. no judgment, no waiting rooms, no awkwa
bluejetty:00096057:ios.description:
it's 3am. your brain won't shut up. you need to vent - not tomorrow, not in a week when therapy's available. right now.
calmi is your ai companion that actually gets it. talk about anything, anytime. no judgment, no waiting rooms, no awkward silences. just real conversations that help you understand yourself a little better.
never feel alone at 3am again.
research shows that regular self-reflection and talking things out can help you feel better. with calmi, you always have a safe space to pause, process, and feel understood. no waitlists. no $200/hour sessions. just you and a companion who's actually there when you need it.
why 140,000+ people trust calmi:
→ 24/7 support
whether you're spiraling at midnight, overwhelmed before a big day, or just need to process something that happened - calmi is always here. your thoughts deserve space, not a 3-week waitlist.
→ gen z mode
toggle it on and calmi talks like ur bestie - no cap.
→ long-term patterns
calmi remembers what you share. not in a creepy way - in a "wow, i didn't realize i always feel this way" way. over time, you'll spot the themes driving your mood swings, anxiety triggers, and emotional spirals.
→ personal insights
get clear reflections, gentle nudges, and suggestions to help you grow. not generic advice copy-pasted from a wellness blog - real observations based on your actual conversations.
→ private and secure
every chat is encrypted and protected against unauthorized access. we don't sell your data. we don't read your conversations. what you share stays between you and calmi. period.
what people are saying:
"to be honest, i gave it a try and it's really good. i feel better now."
"i tried it and i can genuinely say—this is insane. i'm so amused by how good the ai is."
"that shit works a little bit too well."
how calmi works:
just open the app and start talking (after a quick onboarding to get to know you). tell calmi what's on your mind, and the conversation flows from there.
calmi uses ai trained to listen, reflect, and respond in ways that actually help you think through what you're feeling. it's not therapy - it's the conversation you wish you could have with a friend who's always available and never judges.
calmi keeps learning too. understanding isn't always perfect, so your feedback helps us close any gaps and make calmi even more helpful for you.
important stuff:
calmi is an ai-powered tool designed to help you know yourself a little better every day. it's not meant to treat, cure, prevent, or diagnose any medical or mental health conditions. if you need support for a mental health concern, please talk with a licensed provider.
calmi isn't a substitute for human care, doesn't provide mental health services, and isn't monitored in real time by a human. if you are in crisis or immediate danger, contact your local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room. please don't try to access emergency care through this app.
crisis resources:
→ us: call or text 988 (suicide & crisis lifeline)
→ canada: call or text 988 (suicide crisis helpline)
→ crisis text line: text HOME to 741741 (us) or 686868 (canada)
→ international: findahelpline.com
ready to try?
calmi requires an auto-renewing subscription. a 3-day free trial is included. subscription auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. manage subscriptions in settings.
terms of use (eula): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
privacy policy: https://calmi.so/privacy-policy
questions? thoughts? just want to say hi? reach out anytime:
dennis@calmi.so
vlady@calmi.so

bluejetty:00134329:ios.name: National Park Trail Guide
bluejetty:00134329:ios.summary:
National Park Trail Guide is your comprehensive guide to hiking and site seeing in our National Parks.
• Currently packing complete trail data and hike descriptions for many of your favorite National Parks, including life-list destinations
bluejetty:00134329:ios.description:
National Park Trail Guide is your comprehensive guide to hiking and site seeing in our National Parks.
• Currently packing complete trail data and hike descriptions for many of your favorite National Parks, including life-list destinations like Yellowstone, Yosemite, Grand Canyon, Zion, Grand Teton, Mount Rainier, Point Reyes, Rocky Mountain, Zion, Acadia and many more!
• Search for hikes using the map or a park's “best of” list curated through star rankings from the community.
• Never get lost again! See your live position on a terrain or satellite map and vertical profile
• No cell signal needed. The data is available offline, and your phone uses its built-in GPS to show your location.
• Plan the perfect trip for you, using our hike difficulty ratings, elevation profiles, star ratings, and informed insights on seasons, camping and lodging, guided tours, food and drink, and more.
• Traveling with kids? We have an expert-selected list of Family Friendly Hikes. Want to target the park’s most beautiful features? View our list of Gems.
• Other cool features: Create a to-do list, track your hikes, or send your exact location to help in case of emergency.
• The app is completely free--it’s our gift to you as part of the National Park Service's Centennial Celebration.
By using GPS, we can show your location on trails and vertical profiles. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00144008:ios.description:
Приложение Штрафы ГИБДД с фото онлайн – простой способ проверять и оплачивать штрафы ГИБДД, оформлять ОСАГО по выгодной цене. 
Приложение найдет все штрафы в официальных источниках (ГИБДД РФ, ГИС ГМП, АМПП, Госуслуги) по всем регионам России, а партнерский сервис поможет сэкономить на страховке ОСАГО до 70%.
ПОЛНАЯ ИНФОРМАЦИЯ О ШТРАФАХ
В карточке штрафа отображается самая исчерпывающая информация:
- фотография с камер ГИБДД
- дата и время нарушения
- адрес и место нарушения на карте
- статья КоАП
- номер постановления
ОСАГО ОНЛАЙН С ЭКОНОМИЕЙ ДО 6500₽
Доступен сервис по сравнению цен и покупке полиса ОСАГО. Почему стоит оформлять полис в приложении: 
- сравнение цен в 20 известных страховых 
- автозаполнение данных об авто 
- только надежные страховые – члены РСА (Российского Союза Автостраховщиков)
- гарантия подлинности – купленный полис заносится в базу РСА.
УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ О ШТРАФАХ 
Мы своевременно пришлем уведомления:
- о новых штрафах, чтобы вы не пропустили скидку 25% на оплату
- об истечении действия скидки
- о передаче штрафов в ФССП

Step into the world of entertainment with Xuper TV – the intelligent movie discovery app that helps you find what to watch, where to watch it, and even play while you explore.

Available to members of participating employers and health insurance plans
Change is hard. Having the right team and the right tools makes it easier. Whether you want to lose weight, better manage diabetes, reduce stress, or improve eating and exercise habits, Vida’s coaches, dietitians, therapists and medical providers can help you. Choose a health coach whose style you like for a program that fits your unique health goals. 
At Vida, we meet you where you are, and help you get somewhere better.
CONVENIENCE
With Vida’s mobile app, easily stay in touch with your health team through messaging, phone calls, and video sessions. Vida integrates with more than 100 devices and apps, including Apple Health, to track your progress and share it with your care team.
PROVEN RESULTS
Vida works. On average, Vida members in weight loss lose 7% of their body weight, those working on diabetes see an average A1C reduction of 1.4 points and those in therapy reduce anxiety by 58%, depression by 60%, and stress by 33%. 75% of those working on blood pressure reduce their hypertension by one full stage. 
EMPLOYEE AND HEALTH PLAN PARTNERS 
Vida is trusted by Fortune 500 employers and national health plans, many of which cover the full cost of Vida Health. 
*****************
“My therapist helped me overcome stress and anxiety both at home and work.”
- Kytn
“Everything has changed. I lost 30 pounds. I had retired from boxing and came back to the sport with the support of my Vida coach – it’s unbelievable. I’m ready to jump back into the boxing ring again. I’m 40 years old, but feel like I’m 20.”
- Mauricio
“I'm proud to say I'm still smoke-free, breathing easy, and I've now lost 85 pounds. I'm more active than I've ever been.”
- Lyndsey
“I’m exercising daily and taking over 10,000 steps daily, which was foreign in the past. My diet has also completely changed, with more fruits and vegetables and grains. With these changes, I feel a lot more energetic and have clarity of mind.”
- Chris, lost 25 pounds and reduced his elevated blood pressure
“I feel empowered by being healthy, losing weight, going to the gym, cleaning my diet, and changing my perspective about life. I am happy again!”
- Frank, lost 30 pounds and reversed his diabetes

bluejetty:00024113:ios.name: one sec | screen time + focus
bluejetty:00024113:ios.summary:
Stop opening social media on autopilot. one sec adds a short pause before distracting apps so you can choose what deserves your attention.
This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies wi
bluejetty:00024113:ios.description:
Stop opening social media on autopilot. one sec adds a short pause before distracting apps so you can choose what deserves your attention.
This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies with the Max-Planck Institute, with the German and Danish government, and in dozens more scientific collaborations:
one sec has incredible effects on your screen time: app usage drops by 57% on average!
…just read our App Store reviews or try it for yourself if you don’t believe me (…you should really try it)!
How is one sec different from Screen Time limits or app blockers?
- one sec DELAYS access to distracting apps instead of blocking apps completely – that’s an important difference psychologically.
- This way, we solve the screen time problem at its roots: long-term & sustainably!
- one sec is always on, and makes using social media just slightly more annoying…so you’ll end up using it only when you actually have a reason!
Which apps can I use with one sec?
- You can set up one sec with any app you’d like to use less / more intentional.
- Most popular use-cases are: social media, games, video streaming, dating, stock/coin trading, adult content.
- Using one sec with one app of your choice is completely free, for more you’ll need to purchase one sec pro (we also need to finance development of our app!).
What if I get stuck scrolling?
- No worries, one sec offers a Doom Scroll Emergency Brake: We call it Re-Intervention.
- After a set time (e.g. 5 minutes) you’ll be kicked out of social media, and you’ll have to go through an intervention again to unlock more time.
Where can I learn more about the scientific background of one sec?
→ https://one-sec.app/research
Can I use one sec to interrupt access to websites as well?
→ Yes, one sec offers a free Safari extension as well.
How does one sec work technically?
- one sec uses Shortcuts Automation to toggle a deep breath animation whenever you open one of the configured apps (Instagram, Twitter, YouTube…).
- This breaks unconscious social media habits short-term (literally, as soon as you have set it up) and even helps long-term by adding more friction when opening these apps.
Integrations:
- Structured: one sec blocks apps during unfinished tasks.
- LENGO: learn vocabulary to unlock social media.
I developed one sec for myself in 2020…and it worked so well I decided to upload it to the App Store.
Especially for people with ADHD one sec is a great tool to gain back control for incredible focus and concentration.
– Frederik

one sec pro (annual / monthly / lifetime unlock)
one sec can contribute mindful moments to the Health App via HealthKit.
one sec is covered by U.S. Patent 12,468,828 B2.
Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://one-sec.app/privacy/

Killer Sudoku by Sudoku.com is great
bluejetty:00125786:ios.description:
Enjoy an engaging Killer Sudoku experience! Jump into enhanced gameplay, solve tons of puzzles, train your brain, and have fun!
Discover the new brain-training puzzle from the developer of Sudoku.com!
Killer Sudoku by Sudoku.com is great for both beginners and advanced players. Although Killer Sudoku is harder than classic sudoku, we made it accessible for players of all skill levels. With its enhanced gameplay, it's easy to follow the game rules and become a sudoku master in no time. Explore Killer Sudoku and discover a refreshing take on the classic paper-and-pencil sudoku puzzle.
What you get:
* Killer Sudoku puzzles to expand your sudoku experience.
* Thousands of levels to solve.
* Daily challenges to win unique trophies.
* Seasonal events to get unique medals.
* Hints and notes to guide you when you get stuck.
* Tons of gameplay to challenge your brain.
* New game from a top developer!
How to play:
* Fill all rows, columns, and 3x3 regions with numbers exactly like classic sudoku.
* Every cell is part of a cage, indicated by dotted lines.
* Make sure the cells can be added up to the sum in the upper left corner of the cage.
* The sum of all numbers of each 3x3 region, row or column always equals to 45.
* Numbers cannot repeat within cages, a single row, column, or 3x3 region.
Dive into the world of Killer Sudoku! Play anywhere, anytime!

bluejetty:00066456:ios.summary: WeTransfer is the simplest way to send (and receive) big files. Whether you’re at your desk or on the go, transfer up to 200 GB in one go. That’s about 2000 videos of your cat. Share photos and videos in their original format, including all
bluejetty:00066456:ios.description:
WeTransfer is the simplest way to send (and receive) big files. Whether you’re at your desk or on the go, transfer up to 200 GB in one go. That’s about 2000 videos of your cat. Share photos and videos in their original format, including all the important EXIF metadata that originates from your camera. With WeTransfer, you can check the download status, forward, and delete transfers right from your phone. If you previously sent a transfer from your laptop, you can access the files and link in the app, so you can easily paste it into your favorite messaging app without needing to open your computer. Our Live Activity notifies you when a transfer finishes uploading, so you can multitask or play a quick game while sending huge files. Notifications let you know the minute you receive something so you can preview (or download) your files wherever you are.
About us
Having made our name in the game of quick and simple file-sharing, WeTransfer has grown into a collection of tools designed for and inspired by the creative process. Collect is the go-to app for saving and sharing inspiration in boards that organize your ideas. Portals makes it easy to request feedback on your in progress projects with Reviews that include asset markup and approval flows. WeTransfer is the original web platform, where creatives share their biggest files.
Terms of Service: https://wetransfer.com/legal/terms
Privacy policy: https://wetransfer.com/legal/privacy

FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Step into the shoes of a private detective and follow the trail to a dark past hidden within a small town's snowy holiday resort.
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
CRIME SECRETS: CRIMSON LILY IS A CAPTIVATING BLEND OF HIDDEN OBJECT CHALLENGES, PUZZLE SOLVING, AND DARING DETECTIVE WORK.
When a grim murder interrupts a private detective's vacation at the very gate to the hotel at which she was going to stay, she puts her plans for R&R on hold and sets out to do what she does best: solve violent crimes. All she has to go on is a single clue: a mysterious paper lily attached to the victim's frozen body. Could it be the killer's calling card?

Cut off by a blizzard and left to her own devices, the protagonist will need to put her detective skills to work as she questions possible witnesses, searches for clues, and follows a trail that leads her deep into the dirty dealings of a small town filled with big fish and other enigmatic characters.
FIND CLUES IN THE GAME'S UNIQUE DETECTIVE MODE TO SOLVE THE MYSTERY!
Was the tragic death of a young journalist, Lilly, a few years back only an accident, or was it somehow connected to the mysterious new murder? Is the killer trying to send a sinister message? If so, why, and to whom?

bluejetty:00034037:ios.description:
Chowstore lives inside Chowdeck. Shop groceries, household essentials and everyday items from Chowstore, alongside tasty meals from your favourtite restaurants — all delivered to you!
Africa's leading on-demand online food delivery service, Chowdeck, offers quick and convenient food delivery from hundreds of your favourite restaurants! Browse our extensive food menu, order food online, and enjoy fast and reliable delivery right to your door. Say goodbye to long queues and waiting time with Chowdeck!
Enjoy a variety of cuisines, including:
- African & Fast Food (Jollof rice, Pasta, Burgers, Waakye, Kelewele)
- Asian (Chinese, Indian, Japanese, and Lebanese)
- Drinks (Alcoholic and Non-Alcoholic)
- Mexican (Tacos)
- Halal friendly
- Healthy / Vegetarian (Breakfast, Smoothies, Fresh Fruit Juices)
- Pastries (Cakes, Cookies, Meat pies, Sausage rolls) and more.
Eat your favourite meals where you like! Chowdeck delivers food in numerous cities in Accra, Lagos and Abuja, including Yaba, Alausa, Ikoyi, Ogudu, Wuse, Gwarinpa, Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikeja, Surulere, Festac, Amuwo Odofin, Egbeda, Alimosho, Gbagada, Ikoyi, Jahi, Maitama, Garki, Jabi, Utako, Mabushi, Katampe, Kado Wuye, Apo, Gudu, Life Camp, 1st Avenue, Asokoro, Jahi, Wuse and Central Areas with ongoing expansions to other major cities across the continent.
With Chowdeck, order food online and get it delivered to you immediately or at a scheduled time. Alternatively, order ahead online and pick it up at your favourite restaurants.
Get notified from when the restaurant accepts your meal to when it arrives. Track your meal every second of the way between the restaurant and delivery.
Our restaurant partners include Honeysuckle, Papa's Pizza, Mega Chicken, Ajishafe, Burger King, Mama JB Takeout Restaurant, Jay's Diner, King Glab, Korede Spaghetti, Panarotti's Pizza, Fruits2Go, Amoke Oge, Saminu Kilishi, KFC, Debonair's Pizza, Mr Biggs, Yakoyo, Labule, Red Gourmet Kitchen, El Padrino's, Iyan Aladuke, The Place, Cubana Fish, DO Bowls, Food Fusion, Johnny Rocket, Papiees Maestro, Keje Grill, Ojuelegba Restaurant, So Fresh, Eden Life, Korean Wife's Table, Squizz'd, Cookie Nation, Old English, and more.
Shop your groceries online easily from Chowstore, plus leading supermarkets including Blenco, FoodCo and Domino Supermarket. Buy household needs, including beauty and cosmetics, self-care, baby food, pet needs, snacks, drinks, cleaning supplies and grocery staples such as bread, milk, chocolates, coffee, sugar, fruits, vegetables, frozen foods,snacks and alcoholic beverages.
The Chowdeck Lifestyle is marked by ease and enjoyment. We offer our beloved customers unique perks like discounts, free delivery, and promotions through our in-app loyalty program and partnerships with local and international companies.
What are you waiting for? Order food online with Chowdeck and enjoy fast, convenient delivery wherever you are!
- Enter your location and find restaurants and supermarkets delivering to your location.
- Browse meals and products listed from restaurants and supermarkets near you.
- Pay online, sit back, and relax.
- Track your order in real-time in-app and through notifications.
- Rate and review your experience.
Any questions? Contact our Support team at https://chowdeck.com/contact
We are available on:

- Chowstore - https://www.chowdeck.com/chowstore
- Instagram - https://instagram.com/chowdeck
- Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/chowdeck

Wonderland is a magical game where you create your own fairytale adventure and play out stories you create. Peter Pan, Wendy, Captain hook and the lost kids are ready for a new adventure. Explore the lost kid's tree house, visit the pirate's ship and discover hidden treasures. Filled with lots of new characters and locations this game will connect to other Wonderland games making your fairytale bigger than ever!

* New Characters - Peter Pan, Wendy, Tinkerbell and many more fun characters are waiting for you.
* 5 locations such as Pirates Cove, The Watchtower and captain hooks pirate ship.

* Multitouch so kids can play together on the same screen!
* Discover how to reach the pirate's hidden treasures.
* Can you find all the fairies hiding around the tree house?

The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. bluejetty:00027615:ios.description:
What Makes Lila Different?
LILA (lee-la) takes an evolutionary approach to astrology — one that places free will and self-awareness at the heart of your journey. Your chart isn't a script that's already been written. It's a mirror that reflects your deepest nature, the raw materials of your soul. It's up to you what you do with them.
"The intensification of a person's self-awareness: in astrology, that is all that matters."
— Steven Forrest
We believe that astrology isn't about predictions — it's about alignment. The goal isn't to fit yourself into an external mold or live by rigid cosmic rules, but to recognize and embrace who you truly are. Your birth chart shows a pattern of needs and tendencies that, when honored, create peace of mind. When ignored, they lead to inner friction. The task of life is to align your outward choices with your inner nature.
That alignment isn't just something you see. It's something you build.
Lila is here to help you do both. Think of us as your astrological guide and mentor — always available when you need insight or direction, and always oriented toward the same goal: that you leave every conversation with something you can actually use. Not just awareness of who you are, but a clearer sense of what to do with that. Whether you're exploring your natal chart, navigating current transits, or understanding your relationships, Lila helps you decode the symbols and use them in ways that make your life richer and more fulfilling.
Astrology isn't about judgment or destiny. It's about choice. It's about perspective. And ultimately, it's about happiness — because the more you embrace your authentic self, and build your life around that truth, the more life flows.
Lila is here to help you live your Divine Play.
---
Follow us at www.instagram.com/lilaastrology
Send feedback and questions to info@lilaverse.app

* Share your work!

Jigsaw Puzzle by Color Planet is the perfect way to return to warm old-day memories while creating new ones. This high-tech twist on a classic game is perfect for everyone, so don’t wait to start knocking down the Jigsaw challenges. Download now and give it a go!

Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.
When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.
[Core Features]
Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.
Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.
Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.
[Strategic Gameplay]
Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!
Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!
Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!
Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.
Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.
Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!
[Stay Connected]
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5cYPN24ftf

bluejetty:00062618:ios.description:
Quadratic Master is the best app for solving and learning quadratic equations, inequations, and functions on your iPhone.
Whether you are a high-school student currently learning about quadratics in your math class or somebody who needs to solve quadratic functions on a regular basis, Quadratic Master is for you.
Main benefits:
• Save time on your math homework
• Learn about quadratics in just a fraction of time
• Share solutions with your classmates.
Free version offers:
• Quadratic equation solver (roots, discriminant, factorization)
• Formulas and guide for manually solving quadratic equations
• Quadratic inequation solver
Quadratic function solver (Vertex form)
3D rotating model of parabola for better understanding of quadratics in geometry
Full version provides:
• Detailed solution for quadratic equations
• Quadratic function solver - general and factored form
• Explanations and formulas for all quadratic function properties
• Quadratic inequation solver with ≥ and ≤ inequality
• Graph mixer - the perfect tool to play with and explore quadratic function graphs
Rapid-fast solving with Single-digit input mode
The full version is available for a small one-time fee.
- - - - - 
I’ve built Quadratic Master back in 2009 when I was in high school and I was learning about quadratic equations in my math class. It is the first app I’ve ever built, and at the risk of sounding cheesy - it still holds a special place in my heart. Even though it was never a significant moneymaker, I’ve kept it updated throughout the years. And I’m happy to say that it has attained over 95.000 downloads to date. If you enjoy using the app, please consider buying the full version. Thank you.
- Lukas Petr, author of Quadratic Master
