bluejetty:00064809:ios.description:
Collaborative smart calendar for your finances with a spark of AI.
Track and forecast your money as easily as adding events to a calendar! Dollarbird helps you make sense of your financial situation, plan ahead and manage your money together with those who matter.
“It’s a delight to use.” - The Next Web 
“Dollarbird makes sense for anyone who wants to keep a closer eye on their cash flow for better financial planning purposes.” - TechCrunch 
Also featured in Mashable, Lifehacker, The Guardian, iMore, TUAW, etc. 
It comes with:
• A simple calendar-based interface where you can add, keep track and visualize your transactions.
• Automatic balance forecasting that learns from your spending habits and predicts how your balance will evolve over time
• Advanced AI that learns over time and makes categorization easier.
• Option to collaborate with your partner, family or team to manage your finances and stay up to date on common money matters. 
• Your data stored in the cloud, available on all your devices regardless of the platform you’re rocking on.
Dollarbird offers auto-renewable in-app purchases to access Pro features that allow you to collaborate with your family or team. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. If auto-renewal is not turned off, your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be the same as the currently active subscription cost. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes & App Store Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
What our users say about Dollarbird:
Andy - “Love it I have been using dollarbird for years now and absolutely love it. The only one of its kind, has helped over the years to make sure I never overspend!”
Heather - “Holy budgeting awesome! Who knew tracking payments and expenditures could be so pretty??”
Ariel - “Excellent This is exactly what I have been looking for! I don't need all of the fancy finance stuff, just a simple way to see what will be in my account each day based on pre-planned bills/expenses. :)”
Allene - “I love this app. It's simple yet robust. I like that I do not have to link all of my accounts to track spending. I can input recurring expenses, easily adjust them, and I can budget. I like the future income and expense forecast feature. I've downloaded literally 25 different apps over the years and I continue to use this one with no complaints.”
Emily - “This app changed my life. Works great, intuitive, doesn't link to your bank account, just easy way to record all your purchases. I love the clean simple design. I've used it nonstop since I downloaded it!!”
Note: You need to sign up for a user account to be able to use Dollarbird. You can do this on the first screen after the app starts by tapping on the "Sign Up" button.
By downloading and using Dollarbird you agree to our Terms of Use: https://legal.dollarbird.co/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00187032:ios.description:
Drivers of Element's customers can complete fleet tasks quickly and conveniently with the Xcelerate for Drivers mobile app. Recognizing you have little time for the administrative tasks required to maintain your vehicle, Xcelerate for Drivers helps you easily complete a to-do list of vehicle-related tasks, find repair shops and gas stations, and access your service card for fuel and maintenance needs.
Highlights:
• Report your business and personal mileage and maintain logs of trips taken using your company vehicle each month.
• Quickly handle preventive maintenance for your vehicle by finding a local recommended service vendor.
• View your vehicle's registration renewal status and upload licensing prerequisites.
• Access your vehicle's service card for fuel and maintenance and request a replacement if it is lost or stolen.
• Find a nearby gas station for the best priced fuel to quickly refill your tank.
• Easily acknowledge and download your company's policy.
• Use Face ID to store your login information and quickly launch the app.
Note: While trip tracking, continued use of GPS can dramatically decrease battery life. Xcelerate for Drivers captures location updates even in the background mode.

bluejetty:00157649:ios.summary: Stay ahead of the storm with WeatherAI: real-time radar, accurate local forecasts, minute-by-minute rain alerts, and critical severe weather warnings. Get timely notice of major events like tornado emergencies and hurricane warnings, and fo
bluejetty:00157649:ios.description:
Stay ahead of the storm with WeatherAI: real-time radar, accurate local forecasts, minute-by-minute rain alerts, and critical severe weather warnings. Get timely notice of major events like tornado emergencies and hurricane warnings, and follow tropical storms all season long.
WeatherAI is an all-in-one forecasting app with an AI assistant built for everyday planning and severe weather. Check conditions anywhere, watch storms on an interactive map, track hurricanes, monitor river flooding, follow earthquakes, view air quality, and explore advanced radar and satellite layers. Works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.
Features:
• Live Radar Map: Storms, precipitation, lightning, and alerts on one interactive map
• Minute-by-Minute Precipitation: See when rain or snow will start and stop, with our AI Next Hour forecast and alerts up to 60 minutes ahead in the U.S. (Standard or higher)
• AI Weather Summary: A fast daily overview of what matters most (Standard or higher)
• AI Weather Chat: Ask about the forecast, what to wear, activities, SPC outlooks, air quality, nearby earthquakes, and more (Standard or higher)
• Accurate Local Forecasts: Real-time conditions plus hourly and daily forecasts for your location or any searched city
• Weather Sources: WeatherAI Forecast, Apple Weather, or the National Weather Service, plus Open-Meteo, XWeather, and OpenWeather with Pro
• Hurricane & Tropical Tracking: Active storms with forecast cones, tracks, and watches/warnings from the National Hurricane Center
• Weather Alerts: Official alerts for the U.S. (NWS), Canada (MSC), the U.K., Europe (Meteoalarm), and more countries
• Air Quality (AQI): Local by default, with global detailed AQI (Standard or higher)
• Professional Radar & Satellite Layers: NEXRAD Level 3, MRMS, HRRR, RTMA, ProbSevere storm risk, and GOES/Himawari satellite (Pro)
• Lightning: Strikes near you (Standard or higher), plus GOES GLM satellite lightning on radar (Pro)
• Earthquake Tracking: Nearby and recent quakes (USGS or EMSC), plus tsunami advisories
• Water: River levels and crest forecasts, tide predictions, and buoy observations
• Wildfires & Volcanoes (U.S.): Nationwide fire coverage, including CAL FIRE, plus volcano activity
• Space Weather: Aurora forecast with tonight's viewing conditions, Kp index, solar imagery, and X-ray and proton flux
• Aviation Weather: Nearby METARs/TAFs and soundings, decoded on-device with Apple Intelligence
• Widgets & Live Activities: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Live Activities in the Dynamic Island
• Apple Watch: Conditions, forecasts, and complications, with alerts delivered straight to the watch
• Siri & Shortcuts: Ask for conditions, your alerts, or radar by voice, plus a Control Center button for radar
Radar map layers include:
• Weather alerts and storm reports
• Storm Prediction Center (SPC) convective outlooks (tornado/wind/hail), fire outlooks, and mesoscale discussions
• WPC excessive rainfall outlooks and CPC temperature/precipitation outlooks
• Storm tracks, tropical systems, turbulence, and pilot reports (PIREPs)
Notifications:
• Severe weather alerts (U.S./Canada/UK/Europe) with optional Critical Alerts, earthquakes, space weather, daily summaries, and custom weather triggers (limits vary by tier)
• NWS Area Forecast Discussions (AFD) and Hazardous Weather Outlooks (HWO) for up to 10 selected locations
• SPC Convective Outlook alerts when your selected locations enter a risk area
Ad-Free:
• Ad-free experience with Standard or higher
Subscriptions:
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within those final 24 hours.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://weatherai.world/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://weatherai.world/terms

bluejetty:00130438:ios.name: Hip Hop Drummer: Boom Bap
bluejetty:00130438:ios.summary: Hip Hop Drummer is a drum machine for hip hop beats that swing. Pick a groove, set the swing and play: boom bap, Dilla-style, trap, lofi, afrobeats and more, with the loose, human feel of a real drummer. Not loops, not pads: a drummer that
bluejetty:00130438:ios.description:
Hip Hop Drummer is a drum machine for hip hop beats that swing. Pick a groove, set the swing and play: boom bap, Dilla-style, trap, lofi, afrobeats and more, with the loose, human feel of a real drummer. Not loops, not pads: a drummer that plays with you. Free to download, with every feature unlocked for the first 7 days. Now with AUv3 support.
Flex Swing is what makes it different. Set the swing per track for 16th and 8th notes, push it or pull it back with negative swing, and get that laid-back, behind-the-beat feel made famous by J Dilla. Now also inside the plugin, automatable from your DAW.
Key Features:
- Standalone & AUv3: play Hip Hop Drummer inside your DAW (AUM, Loopy Pro, GarageBand and other AUv3 hosts) or as a standalone app, on iPhone and iPad.
- MIDI-only Plugin: load Hip Hop Drummer (MIDI) as a lightweight MIDI generator to drive your own sounds.
- 341 Grooves in 9 Banks: Hip Hop, Hip Hop x2, Half, Dilla, Boom Bap, Trap, Afrobeats & Latin (with reggaeton and amapiano), Swing and Odd Times. Every groove is editable, and you can create your own banks.
- Flex Swing: per-track swing, negative swing and 10 ready-made presets, from a subtle shuffle to Dilla-style feels, and save your own.
- Build Your Own Kit: over 1,000 sounds in 39 kits. Swap any piece, sound by sound.
- Sounds View: give every piece a different sample for its ghost note, accent and special hit, for a natural, human feel.
- Lofi Sound: slow down a Dilla or Boom Bap groove and shape it with the low-pass and high-pass filters.
- Jamming Tool & Random Generators: add live variations and spark new ideas on the spot.
- Live Pads: switch grooves and trigger fills in real time with 8 assignable pads and full MIDI control. FILL ► plays an intro to start and an ending to stop.
- Song Mode: redesigned, with a new Song Part editor to build a full song structure in seconds.
- Effects & Mixer: new compressor, visual EQ, filter, tempo-synced delay, reverb and limiter, plus a send knob and level meters on every track.
- Studio Mix (optional): one-tap studio mix chains, including Console with REEL tape machine, Room and Punch. Listen before you buy.
- Sound Module: use the kit as a MIDI sampler, standalone or as a plugin.
- MIDI Setup: map every control, MIDI Clock In / Out and MIDI-controllable tempo. Share and import your maps.
- Share Across Lumbeat Apps: send and receive grooves and Live Pad Sets with the other Lumbeat drummer apps and iBassist.
- Share by File: send a groove or song by AirDrop, Mail or Files, no account needed.
- Export: audio and MIDI, Multi-Track or Full Mix, in seconds.
- New iPhone vertical layout and external keyboard support.
Try for Free
Every feature is unlocked for the first 7 days, no restrictions. After the trial, unlock full access forever with a single one-time purchase. No subscription, ever.
Already own Hip Hop Drummer? Your full version stays unlocked when you update, nothing to buy again.

bluejetty:00017676:ios.description:
Make your day easier. Manage your MBH Bank transfers, cards and accounts in one clear, easy-to-use app.
Important: Do not share your login data with anyone, and always open the Netbank directly from our webpage www.mbhbank.hu rather than from a link or a search engine.
What can the app do for you?
• Account balance (can be hidden), transactions and account information 
• Hungarian Forint transfers and transfers between own accounts
• Addition of customers and switches in the customer selector 
• Bank card activation, suspension and limit settings 
• Adding a card to Apple Wallet
• Setting of secondary identifiers 
• Payment requests 
• Group collections 
• Payment of bills
• Monitoring of Fundamenta Home Savings accounts and loans 
• Quick login via face recognition/fingerprint 
• Push notifications for transactions and approvals 
How to start 
1. Open an MBH retail account with internet banking (if you do not yet have one).
2. Download the app and select login.
3. Enter the first 8 digits of your card or account number.
4. Enter your internet bank ID and password.
5. Enter your one-time password received in a text message.
6. Set a 6-digit mPIN.
7. Enable biometric identification to speed up your login.
Important 
• The availability of individual functions may vary depending on the customer profiles. You can see the member bank grouping of the functions in our user manual, which is accessible from our webpage (www.mbhbank.hu).
• Daily limits for one-off HUF transfers may vary.

bluejetty:00042257:ios.description:
Thousands of real estate companies — like your new apartment community, real estate agent, or moving company — partner with Updater to help you organize and complete your move. We know how stressful moving can be, so we provide end-to-end moving support to help you save time, money, and get settled into your new home. With Updater, you can quickly and easily:
Forward your mail
One central place to update your address, voter registration, and all other important household accounts. Significantly faster than the traditional USPS process.
Discover, compare, and purchase TV and internet
Compare internet plans, speeds, and prices from the top providers at your new home. Learn what’s popular and purchase TV and internet services from the nation’s most trusted providers.
Set up utilities
Quickly connect or transfer utility services (water, gas, and electric) in your new home to avoid delays or outages.
Secure renters/homeowners insurance
Transfer an existing policy or set up a new policy that meets your coverage requirements.
Find and book movers
Whether you need help moving just a few items or your entire home, we've got you covered. Book same-day moving help, a full-service moving company, or anything in between.
Purchase boxes and packaging supplies
Get affordable, high quality boxes and packing supplies delivered right to your door.
Bonus: moving checklists & tips
We’ve seen it all, so we have lots of helpful advice to share. Keep your move organized and stress-free with our handy checklists and guides.
About Updater
Updater is an app to help you conquer your move. We take care of the heavy lifting so you can focus on all the things you’ve been daydreaming about — like finding your new local spots and making memories in your new home. Let’s be real — moving may never be perfect, but it’s way easier with Updater.

O Super App O Trabalhador evoluiu! Além de ser a sua fonte confiável de notícias sobre benefícios sociais e direitos trabalhistas, agora somos uma ferramenta completa para a sua carreira.
Baixe agora e tenha na palma da mão um Buscador de Vagas de Emprego e um Assistente Virtual para tirar suas dúvidas.
NOVIDADES DA VERSÃO:
- Buscador de Vagas e Estágios: Não perca tempo em vários sites. Encontre oportunidades de emprego, Jovem Aprendiz, home office e estágios divulgados por grandes empresas em todo o Brasil. Filtre e encontre o trabalho ideal.
- Chat Online: Dúvidas sobre sua rescisão? Não entendeu o desconto no contracheque? Pergunte ao nosso Assistente! Ele foi treinado para ajudar você a entender seus direitos de forma simples e rápida.
FERRAMENTAS E CALCULADORAS TRABALHISTAS - Faça cálculos exatos em segundos e não seja enganado: 
- Cálculo de Rescisão: Simule quanto deve receber ao sair do emprego. 
- Décimo Terceiro (13º): Calcule o valor e antecipação. 
- Cálculo de Férias: Saiba o valor dos dias vendidos e abono. 
- Horas Extras e DSR: Calculadora completa de jornada. 
- FGTS e INSS: Cálculos de descontos e saldo líquido.
GUIAS, CALENDÁRIOS E NOTÍCIAS ATUALIZADAS - Mantenha-se informado sobre os principais programas do governo:
- INSS (Meu INSS): Calendário de pagamentos, prova de vida, agendamento, extrato previdenciário e tabelas atualizadas.
- FGTS: Saque-aniversário, saque extraordinário, consulta de saldo na Caixa e uso do fundo para habitação.
- PIS / PASEP: Calendário do Abono Salarial, tabela de valores (ano base), quem tem direito e como consultar (Carteira de Trabalho Digital).
- Bolsa Família e Cadastro Único: Calendário atualizado, regras, valores e consulta pelo CPF.
- Seguro Desemprego: Como dar entrada, cálculo de parcelas e regras.
- MEI: Guia para microempreendedores, DAS e declaração anual.
- Vale Gás e Benefícios Sociais: Notícias sobre auxílios estaduais e federais.
POR QUE BAIXAR O APP O TRABALHADOR?
- Tudo em um só lugar: Vagas, cálculos e notícias.
- Leve e Rápido: Ocupa pouco espaço no seu celular.
- Os Principais Recursos são Gratuitos: Informação de qualidade sem custo.
- Fácil de usar: Interface simples para todos os trabalhadores.
Instale agora mesmo! Tenha o controle da sua vida trabalhista e fique à frente nas oportunidades de emprego.
AVISO IMPORTANTE / DISCLAIMER:
- Este aplicativo é uma iniciativa privada e NÃO representa nenhuma entidade governamental.
- Não possuímos vínculo com o Governo Federal, CAIXA ou INSS.
- As informações são baseadas em fontes públicas oficiais e na legislação vigente.
- Fonte dos dados governamentais: Portal da Transparência.

bluejetty:00016103:ios.description:
방탄소년단 공식 응원봉 BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK의 모바일 앱입니다.
본 앱은 아미밤V3와 아미밤SE 버전을 모두 지원합니다.
[주요 기능 안내, MAIN FEATURES]
1. 공연모드
티켓 좌석 정보 등록 후 응원봉과 연동하면, 공연 중 다양한 응원봉의 무대 연출을 즐기실 수 있습니다.
공연이 있을 때만 사용 가능한 메뉴입니다.
2. 스마트폰 블루투스 연결
응원봉의 스위치를 아래로 내려 블루투스 모드로 맞춰주세요.
스마트폰의 블루투스 기능을 켜고 응원봉을 스마트폰 화면에 가까이하면, 응원봉과 스마트폰이 연동됩니다.
일부 스마트폰에서는 GPS를 켜야 블루투스 연결이 가능합니다.
블루투스 연결이 되지 않는 분들은 GPS 기능을 켜주시길 바랍니다.
3. 셀프모드
스마트폰과 블루투스 모드로 연결 후, 스마트폰 화면에서 직접 원하는 컬러를 선택하시면 응원봉의 컬러가 변경됩니다.
4. 배터리 잔량체크
"셀프모드" 상태에서 하단 버튼을 클릭하면 응원봉의 배터리 잔량 확인이 가능합니다. 배터리 교체가 필요한지 확인해 주세요.
[공연 관람 전 주의사항]
- 공연 관람 전, 본인의 티켓 좌석 정보를 확인하여 응원봉에 좌석 정보를 입력해 주세요.
- 응원봉의 무선 연출이 제대로 작동하지 않는 경우, 응원봉을 페어링 하지 않았거나 페어링 과정을 완료하지 않은 것이 원인일 수 있습니다. 앱을 통해 응원봉과 좌석 페어링을 완료해 주세요.
- 반드시 응원봉에 등록한 좌석 정보와 같은 좌석에서 공연을 관람해 주시길 바랍니다.
임의로 다른 좌석으로 이동하게 되면 응원봉 무대 연출이 달라질 수 있으니 주의해 주세요.
- 공연 도중 응원봉의 전원이 꺼지지 않도록, 공연 전 배터리 체크를 해주세요.
- 응원봉의 무대 연출을 위해, 공연 관람 시에는 반드시 좌석 정보 등록이 완료된 응원봉의 스위치를 위로 올려 “공연모드”로 설정해 주셔야 합니다.
- 공연장에서는 페어링 부스를 운영할 예정이오니, 응원봉에 좌석 정보 입력이 어려우신 경우 페어링 부스를 방문해 주세요.
- BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK의 공연 연출은 전 세계의 공연에서도 진행 예정입니다.
[앱 이용을 위한 필수 접근 권한 안내]
앱과 응원봉의 원활한 이용을 위하여 아래 권한을 필요로 합니다.
안내 팝업이 뜨면 [허용] 해주세요.
- 저장 공간: QR/바코드 및 공연정보 위해 사용
- 전화: 기기의 인증 상태를 유지하기 위해 사용
- 카메라: QR/바코드 인식을 위해 사용
- 블루투스: 응원도구 연결을 위해 사용
- 위치: 블루투스 연결을 위해 사용
This is the mobile App for the BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK.
This app supports both ARMY BOMB V3 and ARMY BOMB SE versions.
1. CONCERT MODE
Enter your concert ticket information and pair your light stick. You can enjoy various stage effects during the concert
This menu will be enabled several days prior to a concert.
2. CONNECTING WITH BLUETOOTH ON YOUR SMARTPHONE
Move the switch down on the light stick to set it to “BLUETOOTH MODE”..
Turn on the Bluetooth function on your smartphone and hold your smartphone close to connect them.
Some smartphones require you to turn on GPS to enable Bluetooth connectivity.
If you can not connect to Bluetooth, please turn on the GPS function.
3. SELF MODE
After connecting with your smartphone with Bluetooth, touch a color you want on the screen. The light stick color will change accordingly.
4. BATTERY CHECK
While in “SELF MODE”, select the button on the bottom of the screen to check the battery level of your light stick. Check if you need to replace the battery.
[NOTICE]
- Check your seat information on your ticket before the concert and enter it on the light stick in advance.
- If the light stick does not work properly, the cause may be due to not pairing your light stick or not completing the pairing process. Please complete the pairing of the light stick and the seat through the app.
- Please be seated in the same seat where you registered for the light stick. Moving to a different seat may cause different stage appearance.
- Check the light stick battery in advance to prevent turning off during the concert.
- To take part in the light stick production, be sure to register your light stick via the mobile App and set the light stick switch to “CONCERT MODE”.
- There will be Paring Booths located in the concert venue. If you need help registering your seat information, please visit a Paring Booth.
- Stage production integrating the BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK will be featured in shows throughout the world, including the United States and Europe.
[Required access permission]
To use the app and the light stick, the following permissions are required:
- Device Storage: save QR code/ seat info etc.
- Phone: read phone status and identity
- Camera: take pictures of QR/barcode
- BLE: connect light stick
- GPS: connect BLE

- 공연 관람 전, 본인의 티켓 좌석 정보를 확인하여 응원봉에 좌석 정보를 입력해 주세요.
- 응원봉의 무선 연출이 제대로 작동하지 않는 경우, 응원봉을 페어링 하지 않았거나 페어링 과정을 완료하지 않은 것이 원인일 수 있습니다. 앱을 통해 응원봉과 좌석 페어링을 완료해 주세요.
- 반드시 응원봉에 등록한 좌석 정보와 같은 좌석에서 공연을 관람해 주시길 바랍니다.
임의로 다른 좌석으로 이동하게 되면 응원봉 무대 연출이 달라질 수 있으니 주의해 주세요.
- 공연 도중 응원봉의 전원이 꺼지지 않도록, 공연 전 배터리 체크를 해주세요.
- 응원봉의 무대 연출을 위해, 공연 관람 시에는 반드시 좌석 정보 등록이 완료된 응원봉의 스위치를 위로 올려 “공연모드”로 설정해 주셔야 합니다.
- 공연장에서는 페어링 부스를 운영할 예정이오니, 응원봉에 좌석 정보 입력이 어려우신 경우 페어링 부스를 방문해 주세요.
- BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK의 공연 연출은 전 세계의 공연에서도 진행 예정입니다.

[앱 이용을 위한 필수 접근 권한 안내]

앱과 응원봉의 원활한 이용을 위하여 아래 권한을 필요로 합니다.
안내 팝업이 뜨면 [허용] 해주세요.
- 저장 공간: QR/바코드 및 공연정보 위해 사용
- 전화: 기기의 인증 상태를 유지하기 위해 사용
- 카메라: QR/바코드 인식을 위해 사용
- 블루투스: 응원도구 연결을 위해 사용
- 위치: 블루투스 연결을 위해 사용

This is the mobile App for the BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK.
This app supports both ARMY BOMB V3 and ARMY BOMB SE versions.

1. CONCERT MODE
Enter your concert ticket information and pair your light stick. You can enjoy various stage effects during the concert
This menu will be enabled several days prior to a concert.

2. CONNECTING WITH BLUETOOTH ON YOUR SMARTPHONE
Move the switch down on the light stick to set it to “BLUETOOTH MODE”..
Turn on the Bluetooth function on your smartphone and hold your smartphone close to connect them.
Some smartphones require you to turn on GPS to enable Bluetooth connectivity.
If you can not connect to Bluetooth, please turn on the GPS function.

3. SELF MODE
After connecting with your smartphone with Bluetooth, touch a color you want on the screen. The light stick color will change accordingly.

4. BATTERY CHECK
While in “SELF MODE”, select the button on the bottom of the screen to check the battery level of your light stick. Check if you need to replace the battery.

[NOTICE]

- Check your seat information on your ticket before the concert and enter it on the light stick in advance.
- If the light stick does not work properly, the cause may be due to not pairing your light stick or not completing the pairing process. Please complete the pairing of the light stick and the seat through the app.
- Please be seated in the same seat where you registered for the light stick. Moving to a different seat may cause different stage appearance.
- Check the light stick battery in advance to prevent turning off during the concert.
- To take part in the light stick production, be sure to register your light stick via the mobile App and set the light stick switch to “CONCERT MODE”.
- There will be Paring Booths located in the concert venue. If you need help registering your seat information, please visit a  Paring Booth.
- Stage production integrating the BTS OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK will be featured in shows throughout the world, including the United States and Europe.

[Required access permission]

To use the app and the light stick, the following permissions are required:
- Device Storage: save QR code/ seat info etc.
- Phone: read phone status and identity
- Camera: take pictures of QR/barcode
- BLE: connect light stick
- GPS: connect BLE

bluejetty:00184146:ios.description:
PayLah! for teens — redesigned. Navigate easily, find deals that fit.
Unlock a world of convenience with DBS PayLah!, the all-in-one app designed to simplify your daily transactions and enhance your lifestyle. Whether it's making payments, transferring funds, or enjoying exclusive deals, PayLah! makes everything effortlessly accessible.
Effortless Payments
• Scan & Pay: Enjoy quick and secure payments at millions of merchants both locally and overseas. Pay at hawker centres, restaurants, shops, and online with NETS QR, PayNow QR, FavePay QR, and SGQR. When you travel, effortlessly pay with overseas QR codes such as DuitNow QR (Malaysia), PromptPay QR (Thailand), QRIS (Indonesia), and UnionPay QR (globally).
• Send & Receive Money: Instantly transfer funds to friends and family with just a few taps. Effortlessly request funds from your friends, making shared expenses a breeze.
• QR Gift/eGift: Surprise your loved ones with a QR Gift or send them an eGift!
• Pay Bills: Pay a wide selection of bills all directly within the PayLah! app through AXS.
Beyond Payments
• Entertainment: Effortlessly purchase movie and event tickets via Golden Village and SISTIC.
• Shop: Explore and get extra perks for your shopping via Shopee, CapitaStar and Lazada
• Travel: Buy travel insurance conveniently on the go within PayLah! app through Chubb Insurance.
Deals & Rewards
• Exclusive Deals: Discover 1-for-1 and exclusive dining deals, and other promotions. Browse exclusive deals with ease by tapping on Dine, Shop or Travel icons to find your favorite merchant deals.
• For DBS/POSB Credit Cardmembers: Quick access to your DBS Points and POSB Daily$! Gain instant access to offset purchases, indulge in retail therapy with shopping and dining vouchers from the DBS Rewards Catalogue, or experience the flexibility of the new Rewards Flexi eVoucher.
Download and register for DBS PayLah! today.
Other Information:
• DBS PayLah! is a mobile payment and mobile wallet service offered by DBS Bank Ltd. SGD deposits are insured up to S$100k by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC).

• NETS is a national banking payment system designated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS).

bluejetty:00178363:ios.description:
► TWO PARTS LOGIC TO ONE PART LUNACY
First you drew. Next you deleted. Now dive into the latest instalment of the fiendishly entertaining puzzle game with a truly loony sense of humor and get displacing. 
Fit the pieces into the right places on the picture, but make sure to get them in the right order too. Engage your brain and your sense of humor to solve an endless series of crazy puzzles where finding the solution is only half the fun – it’s the hilarious and inventive animations each solution launches that will keep you coming back to the DOPest logic game for more brain-tickling adventures and cartoon fun.
► DISPLACEMENT ACTIVITIES 
• Familiar fun in a brand-new format – in the brand-new gameplay, you must put the three items in the right place on the picture and in the right order to solve the puzzle . Master the game’s simple mechanic then let your imagination run riot as you try to unravel each ingenious pictorial riddle.
• Regular shots of DOPamine – over 100 puzzles are already in the game, each with its own unique comic situation and particular brand of crazy logic that will require all your lateral thinking powers to solve. bluejetty:00084227:ios.description:
Welcome to Monkey Words – A Wild New Word Game Challenge!
Get ready to test your vocabulary in Monkey Words, a head-to-head word game. It’s a unique twist on classic gameplay: 
1) you get 15 letters in your tile rack and can make multiple words per turn 
2) your board is your own
3) best score after 3 rounds wins!
How to Play
Unlike traditional word games, Monkey Words gives you your own set of tiles to craft as many words as you can—no sharing the board with your opponent! Create high-scoring combinations and be strategic with bonus spots! The player with the most points after three turns wins.
Key Features
- Exciting PvP Gameplay: Challenge friends or random opponents to thrilling word-building matches.
- Unique Word-Building Mechanics: Craft your own board from a full set of tiles—no need to wait or share space.
- Achievements: Push yourself to new limits and unlock fun milestones as you play!
- Simple Yet Strategic: Easy to learn, but mastering the art of high-scoring plays will keep you hooked.
Why You’ll Love Monkey Words
Whether you're a seasoned wordsmith or just love casual games, Monkey Words will keep you entertained with its fresh twist on classic word games. Sharpen your vocabulary, beat your friends, and claim the title of Monkey Words Champion!
Ready to prove your word power? Download Monkey Words for FREE now and let the word-building frenzy begin!

bluejetty:00024680:ios.summary: SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professiona
bluejetty:00024680:ios.description:
SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professional live performance, song composition and puts a comprehensive array of world-class instruments, sounds and patterns right at your fingertips.
SampleTank gives you 8 multitimbral instrument slots that you can easily layer or split. Choose from a comprehensive, expandable sound collection that covers virtually every acoustic and electronic sound imaginable. Plus, each instrument category includes instrument riffs and grooves so you can start composing and playing in no time.
The included instruments and the new sound engine are derived from the desktop version of SampleTank, IK's flagship workstation, offering you unmatched realism, variety of sound and audio performance. For the first time on iOS, thousands of professional sample-based sounds and patterns can be easily accessed, layered and used for playing live or in the studio. 
SampleTank 2 comes with over 140 instruments and 1,000 patterns including pianos, electric pianos, synths, organs, drums, basses, guitars, strings, brass, woodwinds, voices, ethnic instruments, percussion and sound FX. 
What’s more, SampleTank offers an ever-growing library of sounds and are available via in-app purchase:
• Elektronika - a series of electronica and EDM-oriented groove libraries and sound collections that make it easy to create hits in today’s most popular styles
• Miroslav Philharmonik — the legendary orchestral libraries, now available on your mobile device! Stunningly realistic and expressive samples of a wide range of orchestra and percussion instruments.
• SampleTank PRO - the latest and most high-end sounds and grooves available, letting you create professional-grade compositions on your mobile device
• Plus additional libraries covering cinematic sounds, the finest pianos, drum libraries from iconic drummers and much more!
SampleTank for iOS offers over 2,300 instruments and over 1,200 MIDI patterns — the largest collection of sounds available for any virtual instrument for iOS.
Features:
• 8-part multitimbral professional quality sound and groove module
• Expandable sound library with 2300+ instrument
• Over 1,200 melodic and rhythmic patterns
• 8-track MIDI recorder with audio export
• Totally redesigned intuitive interface
• New sound engine derived from SampleTank 3 for Mac/PC
• Zones feature lets you easily create splits & layers on your controller
• Song and Live environments for composing and playing
• Built-in insert effects and master reverb
• MIDI learn feature makes programming external controllers easy
• Plug-and-play compatibility with iRig interfaces and controller
• Polyphony: up to 64 voices on new Apple devices

bluejetty:00130786:ios.name: Duplicate Photos Cleaner App
bluejetty:00130786:ios.summary: Duplicate Fixer - Photos is a comprehensive solution designed to help users declutter their photo library by quickly identifying and removing duplicate or similar images. With just a few taps, you can easily reclaim valuable storage space o
bluejetty:00130786:ios.description:
Duplicate Fixer - Photos is a comprehensive solution designed to help users declutter their photo library by quickly identifying and removing duplicate or similar images. With just a few taps, you can easily reclaim valuable storage space on your device, ensuring that your photo collection remains organized and optimized. The app boasts advanced scanning algorithms that work with remarkable precision, allowing you to effortlessly detect and eliminate unwanted duplicates without fear of losing your important memories.
The app offers flexible scan modes to suit your needs, including:
- **Duplicate Scan**: Instantly finds and displays exact copies of your photos.
- **Similar Scan**: Detects images that are nearly identical but may have minor differences, such as lighting, angle, or slight variations.
- **Custom Scan**: Gives you full control over which files to scan and clean, allowing you to tailor the search process to specific folders or albums.
Before making any deletions, Duplicate Fixer - Photos ensures complete peace of mind by offering a detailed preview feature. You can review all detected duplicates and similar photos alongside the original images, making it easy to decide which files to keep and which to discard. This preview option reduces the risk of accidentally deleting important photos while providing a clear and user-friendly experience.
**Key Features:**
- **Multiple Scan Modes**: Choose between Duplicate, Similar, and Custom scans to target exactly what you need.
- **Detailed Preview**: View all detected duplicates or similar photos side by side with the originals, ensuring accuracy before deletion.
- **Customizable Scanning**: Focus on specific albums or folders to make the scan process as efficient and precise as possible.
- **One-Tap Deletion**: Easily remove all unwanted images in a single step, freeing up disk space instantly.
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Navigate the app with ease thanks to a clean, intuitive interface designed to simplify the photo-cleaning process.
With Duplicate Fixer - Photos, you get a smart, efficient, and hassle-free way to maintain an organized photo library while keeping your device's storage optimized.
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
- The payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of your selected subscription.
- Your subscriptions can be managed, and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your App Store Account Settings.
Terms of Use (EULA) : https://sunshine-dev.com/?page_id=98

bluejetty:00089336:ios.description:
Simple, elegant and highly customization widgets. 
TRACK YOUR HEALTH AND FITNESS GOALS!
View your 35+ health and nutrition stats at a glance and keep track of your goals! Widget Wizard works with the Apple Health app so you can keep all your data in sync.
Use Widget Wizard to log your activities, health and nutrition info. It's as simple as tapping on the widget! 
You can individually choose which health stats you provide access to. All data is stored in the Apple Health app and remains on your device for your security and privacy.
MIX & MATCH 
Powerfully simple. Simply powerful. Combo widgets that let you choose what data you want to see together in one widget! Don't like combo widgets? You can have single widgets too! 
CHOOSE YOUR DATA!
• Agenda widget that combines calendar events and reminders together
• 35+ Health Stats, including steps, distance, cycling distance and more. 
• Weather - Requires in-app subscription, see below.
• Countdown to events or reminders
• Monthly calendar
• General / unscheduled reminders.
• Clock
• A Stat Bar with health stats, battery percentage and more!
• Constantly updated with new data sources!
WEATHER SUPPORT
Combine weather data from over 45,000 weather stations into any widget!
Weather requires a subscription to cover the weather provider service costs. The subscription period is 3 months and will auto-renew, unless you cancel your subscription from your iTunes account 24 hours before the expiration date. You can also turn off auto-renewal by going to Account Settings on the App Store.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR WIDGET
• Choose your accent and background colours!
• Choose your fonts!
• Completely create your own theme!
Customization requires Widget Wizard Pro, a one-time in-app purchase that unlocks advanced features for life.
MULTILINGUAL
Available in English, French, Dutch, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Turkish, Korean, Brazilian Portugeuse and Simplified Chinese thanks to community translators!
Some icons designed by icons8.
Link to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://widgetwizard.app/privacy-policy.html

Viettel Money – Hệ sinh thái tài chính số
Đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu thanh toán, chuyển tiền và tài chính. Tạo tài khoản chỉ bằng số điện thoại. Mọi dịch vụ trong 1 ứng dụng duy nhất.
CHUYỂN TIỀN VÀ THANH TOÁN DỄ DÀNG: 
- Quét mã QR thanh toán nhanh chóng và tiện lợi.
- Thanh toán hóa đơn điện, nước, truyền hình, nạp tiền điện thoại, mua data... với ưu đãi độc quyền dành riêng cho người dùng Viettel.
- Chuyển tiền qua số điện thoại, liên ngân hàng nhanh chóng, dễ dàng, an toàn.
DỊCH VỤ TÀI CHÍNH ĐA DẠNG: 
- Gửi tiết kiệm, tích lũy online với lãi suất cạnh tranh, an toàn và dễ dàng quản lý
- Vay nhanh tiền mặt với các khoản vay linh hoạt, đăng ký bằng Căn cước công dân (dịch vụ do đối tác của Viettel cung cấp và chịu trách nhiệm):
+ Hạn mức: 3 – 50 triệu đồng
+ Kỳ hạn: 3 – 48 tháng
+ Lãi suất phần trăm hàng năm tối đa 4%/tháng (48%/năm) 
Ví dụ minh họa: Vay 10.000.000 VNĐ trong 12 tháng, với lãi suất phần trăm hàng năm tối đa 4%/tháng, tổng số tiền cần thanh toán khoảng 14.800.000 VNĐ. (Lưu ý: Chi tiết khoản vay, lãi suất phụ thuộc vào đối tác cung cấp dịch vụ.)
ĐỔI VOUCHER MIỄN PHÍ: Sử dụng điểm Viettel++ để đổi miễn phí hàng triệu voucher từ các đối tác lớn: Highlands Coffee, McDonald’s, DAEWOO,…
AN TOÀN – BẢO MẬT CAO: Đạt tiêu chuẩn bảo mật quốc tế, đảm bảo an toàn cho mọi giao dịch.
Hotline: 18009000
Tổng Công ty Dịch vụ số Viettel, trực thuộc Tập đoàn Công nghiệp – Viễn thông Quân đội Viettel.
Trụ sở chính: Số 01 Giang Văn Minh, Phường Giảng Võ, thành phố Hà Nội, Việt Nam.

bluejetty:00042212:ios.description:
Palm Tran’s Go Glades service provides curb-to-curb, on-demand shared transportation in the Glades!
Connect to Palm Tran’s fixed route bus service, shop, work, learn and play. Go Glades is a ridesharing service that’s convenient, easy and affordable.
The Go Glades app makes it easier than ever to get where you need to go — with a few taps,
book a ride using the app and Palm Tran will match you with a vehicle going your way.
What does on-demand mean?
It means you can get a ride when you need it, in real-time. You don’t have to schedule your ride in advance.
How does Go Glades work?
Start by downloading the Palm Tran Go Glades app, then create an account using your name, phone number and email address. Confirm your location and input your destination to see the ride options. Then, book your ride and track it in real time.
Questions? Head to https://www.palmtran.org/go-glades/ or call 561-649-9838. 
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00063276:ios.description:
Doodle Mirror is the original face filter app on the App Store.
Launched in 2010 — before face filters went viral — it started a whole new way to play with your face.
Today, Doodle Mirror is more than a camera.
It’s a real-time creative playground where funny face distortions, masks, stickers, voice effects, and interactive games come together instantly.
Funny Face Filters (Real Time)
— Unique and hilarious face distortion filters
— Stretch, bend, twist, and reshape faces instantly
— Supports multiple faces at the same time
— Fast and accurate real-time face tracking
Mix Filters with Filters
— Apply filters on top of other filters
— Combine face distortions with masks
— Create endless unique looks in real time
— A powerful mixing system where every result is different
Masks, AR Effects & Voice Changer
— AR masks and visual effects
— Random mask for each detected face
— Funny voice changer effects for videos and games
Create Stickers for Messengers
— Turn photos into custom stickers
— Create expressive sticker packs
— Export stickers for WhatsApp and Telegram
Filter Games — Play with Your Face
— Boxing face game
— Face puzzles (15-puzzle & jigsaw) using your live mirror
— Guess the Celebrity quiz with distorted celebrity faces
— Viral-style games inspired by TikTok and Instagram trends
Brainrot Voice Game
— A voice-controlled game inspired by viral Italian memes
— Say the correct meme name out loud to advance
— A fun challenge for meme lovers and friends
For over a decade, millions of users worldwide have been laughing, creating, and playing with Doodle Mirror.
Your face has never been this fun.

bluejetty:00084071:ios.name: SyncTasks
bluejetty:00084071:ios.summary: As a daily Notion user, I found the Notion mobile app to be too cluttered and overly complicated for simple tasks management. It is also severely lacking in widget integration which is a crucial part of the iOS experience. I have tried Todo
bluejetty:00084071:ios.description:
As a daily Notion user, I found the Notion mobile app to be too cluttered and overly complicated for simple tasks management. It is also severely lacking in widget integration which is a crucial part of the iOS experience. I have tried Todoist and TickTick with Zapier, but they lacked support for all the features I needed, AND THERE IS A SUBSCRIPTION?! I wanted a simpler, more integrated solution. That's why I built SyncTasks.
Due to popular demand, I've added the option to use SyncTasks as a standalone to-do app without syncing with Notion. This can be especially useful for quickly tracking tasks like grocery lists and other on-the-go needs.
Key Features of SyncTasks:
Notion Integration: Two-way sync with your Notion databases. This feature also allows you to sync databases from multiple Notion Workspaces.
Apple Reminders Integration: Two-way sync with your Apple Reminders.
Minimal Task List Widget: My favorite feature! Inspired by dumb phones, this minimalist widget blends seamlessly with your wallpaper to create a distraction-free interface reminiscent of a dumb phone. Your home screen will display only your tasks, with no other distractions, so you can stay focused and get as much done as possible.
Stay Organized: I've decided to go back to basics and stick with the trusty folder system to help you group your tasks and stay organized. You can also quickly filter and search through your tasks to find exactly what you need.
Exclusive Membership Card: I absolutely love the feeling of getting something unique for myself. So, I've added this totally unnecessary but fun feature! When you first get your card after upgrading to premium (it's a one-time purchase, by the way—because I absolutely hate subscriptions), you can drag and shake it to unlock a series of randomized colors with different gradients on the card. This means your card will be unique to you and you alone. I know it's not essential, but it's kind of exciting, right?
No ads. No tracking. Transparent update: Nobody likes being tracked, and I'm no exception. listings.name: SyncTasks
listings.description:
As a daily Notion user, I found the Notion mobile app to be too cluttered and overly complicated for simple tasks management. It is also severely lacking in widget integration which is a crucial part of the iOS experience. I have tried Todoist and TickTick with Zapier, but they lacked support for all the features I needed, AND THERE IS A SUBSCRIPTION?! I wanted a simpler, more integrated solution. That's why I built SyncTasks.

Due to popular demand, I've added the option to use SyncTasks as a standalone to-do app without syncing with Notion. This can be especially useful for quickly tracking tasks like grocery lists and other on-the-go needs.

Key Features of SyncTasks:

Notion Integration: Two-way sync with your Notion databases. This feature also allows you to sync databases from multiple Notion Workspaces.

Apple Reminders Integration: Two-way sync with your Apple Reminders.

Minimal Task List Widget: My favorite feature! Inspired by dumb phones, this minimalist widget blends seamlessly with your wallpaper to create a distraction-free interface reminiscent of a dumb phone. Your home screen will display only your tasks, with no other distractions, so you can stay focused and get as much done as possible.

Stay Organized: I've decided to go back to basics and stick with the trusty folder system to help you group your tasks and stay organized. You can also quickly filter and search through your tasks to find exactly what you need.

Exclusive Membership Card: I absolutely love the feeling of getting something unique for myself. So, I've added this totally unnecessary but fun feature! When you first get your card after upgrading to premium (it's a one-time purchase, by the way—because I absolutely hate subscriptions), you can drag and shake it to unlock a series of randomized colors with different gradients on the card. This means your card will be unique to you and you alone. I know it's not essential, but it's kind of exciting, right?

No ads. No tracking. Transparent update: Nobody likes being tracked, and I'm no exception. I've also included a Release Notes section in the app where I'll share all the new features, major bug fixes, and improvements with you. This keeps the update process as informative and transparent as possible. I'm doing this because I genuinely want to build and grow alongside my users.

If you've encountered a similar issue with the Notion mobile app and are looking for a solution, want a way to stay focused and get things done, or just simply want to hang out, install SyncTasks and join me on this journey. I'll see you on the other side!

bluejetty:00084131:ios.name: OnStation - Digital Stationing
bluejetty:00084131:ios.summary: OnStation gives road construction crews live digital stationing on any phone. Know your exact station and offset instantly — no stakes, no rover, no manual calculation. Document what you see, where you see it, with every photo and note auto
bluejetty:00084131:ios.description:
OnStation gives road construction crews live digital stationing on any phone. Know your exact station and offset instantly — no stakes, no rover, no manual calculation. Document what you see, where you see it, with every photo and note automatically anchored to a station reference.
WHAT IT DOES
Open the app on any phone and see your exact station and offset, tied to your project alignment. Drop a flag, take a photo, leave a note — all automatically geo-referenced to a precise station and timestamp. Your documentation builds itself as work happens, not at the end of the shift.
WHO USES ONSTATION
Prime contractors and field crews — Eliminate location hunting. Tie every photo and note to a station. Build defensible records for pay applications and change orders without extra paperwork. Density technicians log compaction test results directly in the field at the correct station, cutting hours of manual entry.
CEI inspection teams — Replace paper daily work reports with station-anchored photos, flags, and notes. Export documentation in DOT-ready formats. When a dispute arises over where work occurred, the evidence is already there.
DOT agencies — Create a shared platform across contractors, inspectors, and agency staff. Real-time oversight, standardized documentation, and Active Worksite safety notifications give agencies visibility that paper-based systems cannot provide.
KEY FEATURES
• Live digital stationing — instant station and offset on any phone, tied to the uploaded project alignment
• Geo-referenced flags, photos, and notes — every observation auto-anchored to a station and timestamp
• Design layer overlays — view plan sheets, utility maps, and CAD files on the live project map
• Flags and chat — drop a flag at any location, attach photos and notes, share across the project team
• DOT-ready reports — export documentation in standardized formats for closeout, audits, and compliance
• Active Worksite — alerts the traveling public of construction worker locations via Waze and navigation apps
• MM/LRS conversion — convert between stationing, milepost markers, and linear reference coordinates
• Integrations — connects with HCSS HeavyJob, Trimble, TransTech, FleetWatcher, and GPS/GNSS receivers
• Works offline — field documentation continues without connectivity
RESULTS FROM THE FIELD
• $18,000 saved per density technician per year — Mathy Construction
• Guardrail dispute resolved in seconds vs. hours — RS&H, I-4 Corridor FL
• GPS rover dependency eliminated from daily workflows — APEX Engineering
• 3 utility strikes avoided on a single project — Hoffman Construction
• "This is EXACTLY why I wanted this app. All this is now on record and we can all come back to it." — DOT Inspector, April 2026
ABOUT ONSTATION
Founded in 2013, OnStation is the leading digital stationing platform for road construction. Used on more than 5,000 projects by over 400 contractor organizations and 16+ state DOT agencies across the United States. SOC 2 Type 2 certified. Setup takes 30 minutes with no special hardware required.
Learn more: onstationapp.com

bluejetty:00148692:ios.summary:
- Arbento is story intelligence for writers. 
It reads your manuscript, learns your characters, and thinks with you about structure scene by scene.
- The AI that knows your whole story
Most writing tools see one sentence at a time. Arbento
bluejetty:00148692:ios.description:
- Arbento is story intelligence for writers. 
It reads your manuscript, learns your characters, and thinks with you about structure scene by scene.
- The AI that knows your whole story
Most writing tools see one sentence at a time. Arbento sees the whole manuscript. Every scene you write, every character you introduce, every rule you establish Arbento reads and remembers it. When something contradicts, it says so. When a scene is missing its structural purpose, it tells you specifically what to fix.
- Beat analysis
Tag any scene to a story framework: Save the Cat, Three-Act Structure, or Hero's Journey. Arbento evaluates whether the scene delivers what that beat requires: a score, what's working, what to fix, and a rewrite tip drawn from your actual prose. Not generic advice. Analysis of your specific scene.
- Codex AI intelligence
Build your story's Codex: characters, places, world rules. Arbento reads it before every analysis. It catches continuity errors (wrong eye colour, destroyed objects reappearing), flags unregistered characters as they appear in your prose, notices when a character's behaviour contradicts their arc, and surfaces forgotten threads you haven't returned to.
- Editorial feedback
A developmental editor's read of your prose. What's landing, what one thing would improve it, specific language corrections, and what this scene sets up for what follows. Honest, specific, based on your writing not a generic critique.
- Story health
A full structural read of your entire manuscript. Missing beats, pacing observations, your strongest scene, and the single highest-priority thing to fix next. Developmental editing at a fraction of the cost.
- Writing signals
Readability score, sentence rhythm, tone fingerprint, overused words, echo detection. Every scene, always.
- For iPhone, iPad and Mac
Write on iPhone on the train. Continue on Mac at your desk. Everything syncs fast, reliable, and available offline.
Arbento is for writers who want to understand their story better, not writers who want AI to write it for them.
Free to try. Pro subscription unlocks AI analysis.

bluejetty:00137286:ios.description:
Welcome to the "Infinite Alchemy - AI Craft" app that allows you to combine different elements and get new ones.
Each combination is a small puzzle that needs to be solved.
Drag the elements you need to the top of the screen. If you want to combine elements to get a new item, drag one onto the other and release your finger. In a matter of seconds, our AI model will generate a logically correct result. The result will be a new element, which you can transform further by combining it with other elements. All manipulations are accompanied by custom sound effects.
Each new combination of elements is a small new discovery. You can sort merged elements by date/time and alphabetically. Added the ability to reset with one button (erasing all merged elements and selectively). To quickly duplicate an element in the work area, double-click on it. Auto-scroll to a new element can be disabled in the settings. If you want to start the game from the beginning, you can get rid of all generated elements with the click of one button (or manually delete unnecessary elements).
The most amazing thing is that this game has no end. You can create more and more new elements, as well as come to those already created earlier but combining them with other elements- get completely new.
This game is very addictive and allows you to explore all things around us in a very interesting way. We've added a lot of Easter eggs to the game, so you won't be bored. The database of elements is updated and expanded every day.
At the beginning, you will have 4 fundamental elements available to you:
1. Air. Is an invisible substance that surrounds our world. It not only gives us the ability to breathe, but is also a key factor in meteorological phenomena.
2. Water. Is the source of life on Earth. It covers most of the planet's surface and makes up the majority of our body.
3. Fire. Is a symbol of heat, light and energy. It was discovered by ancient people and brought them warmth, protection and the ability to cook food. Fire also has destructive power.
4. Earth. Is the fundamental element on which we live. It provides us with fertility and resources to grow food. The earth is also where we build our homes and create societies.
These items play a key role in the variety of phenomena on our planet. That's why the game will start with these 4 elements, so pay attention to each of them.

bluejetty:00042655:ios.description:
Smash worlds together and watch them shatter, merge, and melt, driven by real physics, not pre-made animations. Every planet is made of thousands of interacting particles, so every collision is computed live and no two impacts ever look the same.

- Black holes that tear planets apart
- Custom planet textures from your own photos
- Runs on everything: tune particle count, accuracy, and timescale to your device

bluejetty:00119096:ios.name: Noble Quran in English & Audio
bluejetty:00119096:ios.summary:
The Noble Quran, also informally known as the Hilali-Khan translation
Interpretation of the Meanings of the Noble Qur'an (1999) by Darussalam (first published 1977) is translated by Muhammad Muhsin Khan and Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali.
bluejetty:00119096:ios.description:
The Noble Quran, also informally known as the Hilali-Khan translation
Interpretation of the Meanings of the Noble Qur'an (1999) by Darussalam (first published 1977) is translated by Muhammad Muhsin Khan and Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali. This translation is among the most widely read translations in the world, primarily because it is the officially promoted translation of the Saudi Government.
This English translation was sponsored by the Saudi government and is provided free. It has been reported to be the most popular and "Now the most widely disseminated Qur'an in most Islamic bookstores and Sunni mosques throughout the English-speaking world, this new translation is meant to replace the Yusuf 'Ali edition and comes with a seal of approval from both the University of Medina and the Saudi Dar al-Ifta. This venture utilizes mainstream classical sources of commentaries namely, Tabari, Qurtubi, and Ibn Kathir.
As with any translation of the original Arabic into another language, in this case English, this is an interpretation of the meanings of the Noble Qur'an (Word of God). The translation is heavily interspersed with commentaries and notes from At-Tabari, Al-Qurtubi and Ibn Kathir.
Mushin Khan completed the translation in twelve years, during which he consulted a number of English versions of the Qur'an but had found that they had ambiguity, shortcomings and dogmatic errors. So later, in association with Dr. Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din Al-Hilali, he undertook the task of interpretation of the meanings of the Noble Qur'an providing evidences from the authentic sources for clarification.
Abdul Malik Mujahid also said that Khan and Hilali behested that Darussalam Publishers and Distributors bring about a summarized edition in one volume:
"Its popularity among the readers encouraged them to prepare a comprehensive version of the interpretation of the meanings of the Qur'an in nine volumes comprising a number of Ahadith from Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim and other books with comments from Tafsir At-Tabd, Tafsir AI-Qurtubi and Tafsir Ibn Kathir, where necessary to elaborate upon the Qur'anic Verses."
The Quran is the central religious text of Islam, which Muslims believe to be a revelation from God (Arabic: الله‎, Allah). It is widely regarded as the finest piece of literature in the Arabic language. Muslims consider the Quran to be the only book that has been protected by God from distortion or corruption. However, some significant textual variations (employing different wordings) and deficiencies in the Arabic script mean the relationship between the text of today's Quran and an original text is unclear. Quranic chapters are called suras and verses are called ayahs.

It is widely regarded as the finest piece of literature in the Arabic language. Muslims consider the Quran to be the only book that has been protected by God from distortion or corruption. However, some significant textual variations (employing different wordings) and deficiencies in the Arabic script mean the relationship between the text of today's Quran and an original text is unclear. Quranic chapters are called suras and verses are called ayahs.

bluejetty:00090327:ios.description:
Birthday Invitation Maker is the ultimate iOS app for creating personalized and enchanting birthday invitations for your special occasions. Whether you're planning a birthday party for a boy, girl, superhero enthusiast, princess aficionado, or unicorn lover, this app has you covered with a wide array of beautifully designed templates and a plethora of customization options
Key Features:
Diverse Template Categories: Our app offers a vast selection of invitation templates categorized to suit every taste. Choose from categories like Girls, Boys, Super Heroes, Princess, Unicorns, and more. No matter the theme of your party, you'll find the perfect template to match.
Beautiful Designs: Our professional designers have crafted each template with care, ensuring that they are visually stunning and eye-catching. Every design radiates charm and creativity, making your invitations truly special.
Photo Personalization: Add a personal touch to your invitations by easily inserting your own photos. Whether it's a snapshot of the birthday boy or girl, a family picture, or a themed image, our app lets you effortlessly include your desired photos within the invitation.
Text Customization: Tailor the invitation to your exact needs by adding custom text. You can include event details, RSVP information, and heartfelt messages in various fonts, colors, and sizes. Our user-friendly text editor ensures your message is just right.
Animated Invitations: Stand out from the crowd with animated invitations. Choose from a selection of captivating animations that will add an extra layer of excitement to your digital invitations. Your recipients will be delighted by the surprise!
Easy Sharing: Sharing your invitations is a breeze. Once you've created the perfect birthday invitation, you can share it with friends and family through various channels, including email, text messages, social media, and more. You can also save it to your device or print it for physical distribution.
Save and Edit: The app allows you to save your invitation projects, making it convenient to come back and make changes or create new invitations for different events.
How It Works:
 Choose a template that matches your party theme or personal style.
 Add your own photos to make it truly unique.
 Customize the text with event details, RSVP information, and personal messages.
 Select from a range of delightful animations to make your invitation come to life.
 Share your animated masterpiece with friends and family through various platforms.
With Birthday Invitation Maker, you have the power to create memorable and personalized invitations that will leave a lasting impression on your guests. Make every birthday celebration extraordinary with our easy-to-use, feature-rich app. Download it today and start designing invitations that capture the magic of the moment!

bluejetty:00186059:ios.description:
◆◇◆◇◆ Thank you for the 10,000,000 DL! ◆◇◆◇◆
The werewolf game that is popular in schools and parties is released as an iOS app!
[Overview]
A player will be killed by the werewolves who tells lie if the human players don't find the werewolves.
Can you find the werewolves with your technical talk, deep insight, and reasoning?
A bad majority decision leads to killing the important player.
Is the game that your friends suspect of liar each other or that your friends try to trust each other?
The playstyle is your own.
[Good navigation for biginners]
The traditional werewolf game was a card game.
And it needs the cards and a gamemaster who presided at the game and can't play as a player.
But this werewolf game app doesn't need any gamemaster.
The one iOS device acts as a host with being read the text by a player.
It's very easy!
Let's play this game with over 4 players!
[Special cards]
The additional cards make the game more exciting!
You can use the supernatural power and lead the game in a special role.
And you can also hide your special role in surviving.
- Fortune Teller
The fortune teller can see through the identity of one player who you suspect to be a werewolf every night.
- Knight
The knight can choose one player to protect from the werewolves every night.
- Shaman
The shaman can check if the dead players are werewolves or not.
- Psycho
The psycho wins when the werewolf team wins.
- Lovers
The lovers know who the other lover is.
- Vampire
The vampire is a special player who belongs to neither the citizen team nor the werewolf team.
When you survive until the tame is over, you win.
The new cards ( Rich, Psycho Killer, Great Shaman, etc. ) are released by updating.
You can have a new experience in every game.
[Player Points]
This app supports "Player Points". So you will be ranked by the points that you got by the games.
Make your original prize for the top player! It will make the games hot.
Number of Players: 4 - 20 players ( You need only one iPhone device. )
[Subscription Features]
- Card Master Key
Terms of Use This function enables all role cards.
- Adfree

bluejetty:00151354:ios.description:
YOURFNB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with YOURFNB:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the YOURFNB app, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00122876:ios.description:
The KodaMobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact KodaBank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the KodaMobile App, you must be enrolled as an KodaBank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00182724:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182724:ios.description:
Palace was the most popular study hall / cafeteria card game in my high school growing up in the 90's. According to Wikipedia it's also popular amongst backpackers, and as a result is widespread.
This version of palace is two player. There are eight different computer characters you can play against, each with slightly different playing styles. You can now also play multi-player with a friend.
Tips:
1. Tap on cards to select/deselect. You can select one or more cards of the same kind. Click on the discard pile or use swipe gesture to discard selected cards.
2. Use the Undo button (top right of screen) to undo last move if you make a mistake.
3. Turn screen sideways to make view wider when you have a lot of cards in your hand.
Basic Rules:
Each player is dealt 3 'face down cards'. You are not allowed to see or change these until the end of the game. Next, 3 'face up cards' are placed on top. Finally, each player is dealt 3 cards to form their hand. If you wish, you can switch cards from your 'hand' with your 'face up cards'.";
Whoever has a 3 or the next lowest card starts the game.
Each turn you must discard a card (or two or more cards of the same) greater than or equal to the one at the top of the pick up pile, then draw cards from the deck so you have at least 3 cards in your hand (unless the deck has run out of cards or you already have 3 or more cards in you hand).
2's and 10's are wild cards. 2's resets the pile and 10's clear the pile. 4 of a kind, like a 10, clears the pile.
If don't have a card that is greater than or equal to the card on top of the pile or a wild card, you must pick up the entire pile.
When there are no more cards in your hand, and the deck is empty, proceed to play your face up cards. Once all of the face up cards have been played, play the face down cards.
If you are the first to get rid of all your cards you win.

bluejetty:00178887:ios.description:
Challenge yourself in a new puzzle game, blast all the colorful cubes, solve fun puzzles, reach the target, and win awesome rewards! 
Match and crush blocks in a super fun puzzle game - it’s free, it's awesome, and it’s addicting! Swipe and match 2 or more adjacent cubes to complete missions, reach high scores, and clear levels. 
Play Cubes Empire Champions for free, now available on the App Store, and perfect for your iOS device. This amazing tapping game may look easy, but it is really challenging to master. With limited moves in every level, it’s all up to your thumbs - make smart blasts and collapse more colored blocks. Try to clear the board with fewer moves to get a higher score. 
Puzzle games are much easier when you get some help! 
Enjoy a Unique Gameplay and create blasting combos to pass tricky challenges. Use powerful boosts like the RAY GUN, PIŇATA, and YO-YO and pop the cubes!
Employ these super cool power-ups and boosts at the right time to create major explosions, clear the board and win awesome prizes. 
Unlock AMAZING BOOSTERS that will help you crush the cubes and win levels:
* Match, blast, and explode 5 or 6 tiles to get a rocket
* Match, pop, and smash 7 or 8 toon blocks to get a bomb
* Match, crush and pop 9 cubes to earn a color wheel
Rockets, bombs, and color wheels will help you blast the blocks and beat the challenges! 
Use these amazing boosts at the right time to pop cubes, clear the board, and win awesome prizes! 
Play Cubes Empire Champions, and enjoy the best game FEATURES:
- Fun gameplay. Connect and smash 2 or more adjacent bricks of the same color to create a cube blast
- Plenty of fun levels filled with cool puzzles and challenges that will train your brain 
- Amazing boosts and gifts to help you along the way
- Fun challenges to test your matching skills
- Easy to learn and play - crush and collapse blocks and win levels 
- Relaxing blaster game to play with family and friends
Get ready to train your brain with hundreds of blasting levels filled with cool challenges and brain teasers. Test your logic and color-matching skills as you match and pop the cubes and blast your way to the top. 
Cubes Empire Champions is a super fun and addicting matching game! Try this cool blaster game, fill your world with color, and smash all the colored blocks!
Note that Cubes Empire Champions ads do not necessarily show actual gameplay.

bluejetty:00119918:ios.name: Baby Piano + Kids Music Games
bluejetty:00119918:ios.developer: 22LEARN Toddler and Baby Learning Games, LLC
bluejetty:00119918:ios.summary:
***** Developed by an award-winning educational studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all TWELVE (!)
bluejetty:00119918:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning educational studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all TWELVE (!) RANKED #1 APP FOR KIDS on APP Store in many countries.
Musical Puzzles is a musical toy for babies and toddlers developed by an award-winning educational studio, 22learn. Children will love 10 engaging games that nurture the aspiring little musicians’ creativity, motor skills, and appreciation of sounds and music.
======
Recommended ages: 2-8
LEARN to differentiate and match sounds
EXPLORE the sounds of musical instruments
CREATE your own melodies and record them
PLAY with instruments and engage in several matching games
LISTEN to popular childhood classics such as Old MacDonald
======
10 featured games in total (4 NEW GAMES included in the recent update):
1. Animal Piano
Play the piano. Record your music. Listen to classic childhood melodies, including Old MacDonald, Twinkle Twinkle, Bingo, Five Little Monkeys, and Alphabet Song.
2. Matching Game
The ultimate challenge for little sound explorers. Can you match the same sounds? Listen to the sound to be matched and then match it with one of several options.
3. Xylophone
Complete a xylophone puzzle. Then play the xylophone, listen to a melody, or record your own music.
4. Drums
Who wouldn’t want to be a drummer? Complete the puzzle and then beat the drums to your heart’s content.
5. Music Machine
Drag the sound marbles onto the music machine to explore sounds and make your own music.
6. Super Music Machine
More instruments, more machines, more fun! Mix and match different instruments to create complex compositions.
7. Memory Game (NEW)
Listen to the sequence of sounds. Memorize the sounds and attempt to reproduce the sequence. Be ready for a challenge – the sequences get progressively longer.
8. Notes & Buttons (NEW)
Complete a fun shape matching activity and unlock cute buttons that make sounds. Be sure to record your music as you tap on the colorful buttons.
9. Quack Puzzle (NEW)
Quack, quack, music under attack! Complete a fun puzzle—a stacker with duck heads—and compose quirky melodies that combine musical and animal sounds as a reward.
10. Rhythm Flight (NEW)
Time to test your ear for rhythm with our very special music birds. Tap on the birds at the right time to get them to chirp a melody for you. Choose out of five popular songs: Old MacDonald, Alphabet Song, Bingo, Twinkle Twinkle, and Five Little Monkeys.
======
Musical Puzzles was extensively tested with preschool children to ensure its design is as simple as possible and that children can explore the application independently. We hope your tiny musicians will love it!

bluejetty:00114581:ios.description:
Worditaire — Where Words Meet Solitaire
Worditaire is a beautiful fusion of classic Solitaire and modern word puzzles — a fresh, elegant way to relax your mind while sharpening your logic and vocabulary.
Step into a world where every card holds a word, and every word connects to meaning.
Inspired by timeless solitaire, Worditaire transforms card play into a mindful word-sorting challenge.
How to Play:
Just like in classic solitaire, each level starts with a partially filled board.
Draw one card at a time from the deck — but instead of numbers and suits, you’ll find words and themes.
To build a stack, start with a category card (for example: Fruits, Emotions, Colors).
Then place each word card onto its matching category (Apple, Joy, Blue).
Think ahead, plan your moves, and clear the board within a limited number of moves.
Why You’ll Love Worditaire?
- A new twist on classic solitaire and word puzzles
- Strategic yet soothing — perfect for a mindful break
- Hundreds of levels to test your logic and associations
- Calm visuals and elegant card design
- No time limits — play at your own pace
- Relax, learn, and enjoy as you play
For Fans Of:
If you love solitaire, word solitaire, crossword, or word connect games,
you’ll adore Worditaire — a relaxing card puzzle that feels fresh, smart, and beautifully simple.
Ready to Play?
Unwind your mind and expand your vocabulary.
Flip, sort, and match your way through hundreds of elegant word decks.
Download Worditaire today and discover the art of word solitaire!

bluejetty:00138560:ios.summary:
See the weather like never before.
Vortix Pro puts live, animated weather radar on a beautiful interactive map — with forecast overlays, severe weather alerts, and aviation tools trusted by pilots.
LIVE RADAR & SATELLITE
Animated radar pl
bluejetty:00138560:ios.description:
See the weather like never before.
Vortix Pro puts live, animated weather radar on a beautiful interactive map — with forecast overlays, severe weather alerts, and aviation tools trusted by pilots.
LIVE RADAR & SATELLITE
Animated radar playback with timeline scrubbing. Global radar, US base reflectivity, US composite, and satellite imagery — all updating in real time. Scrub forward into forecast and nowcast frames to see what's coming.
17 GFS FORECAST OVERLAYS
Go beyond radar. Visualize Temperature, Wind Speed, Wind Gusts, Precipitation, Snow Depth, Humidity, Pressure, Cloud Cover, UV Index, CAPE, Visibility, Dew Point, Feels Like, Wave Height, Soil Temp, Air Quality, and Dust & Smoke — up to 14 days out.
SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS
NWS alerts displayed as color-coded badges by severity. Tap for full alert details. Push notifications for lightning and hurricanes near your location.
10-DAY FORECAST & TODAY VIEW
Swipe-up panels with current conditions, hourly breakdowns at 3-hour intervals, and expandable daily forecasts. Tap any stat for an interactive 24-hour bar chart. Conditions include Feels Like, Wind, Humidity, Pressure, UV Index, Visibility, Precipitation, and AQI.
FAVORITES
Save locations around the world. See current temp, conditions, and local time at a glance. Tap to fly the map there instantly.
AVIATION WEATHER
VFR & IFR sectional maps, airspace overlays (Class B/C/D/E with labels), TFRs, AIRSIGMETs, ADS-B traffic, and obstacle data. Built for pilots who need real situational awareness.
HURRICANE TRACKER
Active tropical cyclone tracks from the National Hurricane Center with forecast cones.
LIGHTNING TRACKER
Real-time lightning strikes on the map with configurable alert radius.
DESIGNED TO BE BEAUTIFUL
Glassmorphic UI with smooth animations, dark mode, and a responsive layout that adapts from phones to tablets to landscape.
18 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more.
Vortix Pro offers a free tier with radar and NWS alerts. Unlock all overlays, aviation layers, and premium features with a subscription.
Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.
A subscription provides access to premium features and future enhancements.
Data Sources
Weather data powered by Apple WeatherKit.
Location Services
Used to deliver accurate local forecasts, radar, and alerts.

bluejetty:00145967:ios.summary:
