Gamification is an educational approach that motivates learning by c
bluejetty:00145967:ios.description:
Welcome to Dinosaur School, where learning and play are combined together organically! Designed for children aged 2-6, this is absolute fun!
Learning Through Gamification
Gamification is an educational approach that motivates learning by combining application design and game elements in a learning environment. And we believe that the home is the perfect environment for children to develop a love for learning! We combined age and developmentally appropriate learning activities with fun interactive games — supporting the enjoyment, engagement, and interest of young learners, inspiring them to want to keep learning. 
With Dinosaur School, children learn organically, while having a blast! 
We've designed a variety of lessons that meet the developmental and educational stages of kids aged 2-6, including:
Colors & Shapes – Learning colors and shapes is a fundamental skill during preschool education. Kids use building blocks to assemble dream models and learn different shapes and colors in the games!
Math – Teach child to recognize numbers, learn counting, and understand number values.
Alphabet & Vocabulary – Recognize English letters, learn words, and begin spelling in the cool parkour game!
Physics & Logic – Puzzle games about physics and logical concepts, like track-connecting, Connect the Dots, and more!
Art & Creation – Try drawing in Dinosaur School! The picture you've completed could even be brought to life! Extremely fun!
Kid-Approved Themes
Children will experience a busy construction site, a bustling amusement park, a mysterious pirate base, and more! These exciting themes will grasp kids' curiosity and keep them learning while exploring. More new themes to be released in the future!
Educational Fun
Over 60 scenes to explore on their own, including the maze, parkour, handwriting, block building, doodling, and many other games. Each of these scenes are designed to introduce children to fundamental skills such as math, literacy, creativity, spatial imagination, logical thinking, and more.
Games Children Love and Parents Trust
With friendly interfaces and simple guidelines, kids can play independently. Lively, animated, and amusing game plots also bring blast waves of laughter to kids during the play.
Features
• 6 popular themed elements: engineering trucks, amusement park, pirates, policeman, bumper cars and snowy world!
• 15 interesting games: maze, blocks, parkour, doodling, kart races, and more.
• 68 scenes to be explored. Each play brings new experience! 
• 24 vivid and lovely dinosaur companions
• Variety of educational content: Math, English, Shapes, Colors, Logic, and more! 
• Instant rewards and coin collecting — use to build own dinosaur city
• Play offline without the Internet
• No third-party advertising
About Yateland
Yateland crafts apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers across the globe to learn through play! With each app we make, we are guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

Games Children Love and Parents Trust

bluejetty:00018400:ios.description:
Access your accounts and enjoy customizable features that let you manage your money, your way -- with advice from the experts only a tap away. It’s a whole new world of easy.
THE CONVENIENCE OF BLENDED BANKING 
Opening one app to make a trade, another app to pay a bill, and another to redeem rewards? With the everyday banking features you’d expect and so much more, the TD app has you covered:
• Manage your portfolio of diverse TD accounts, and control access to your debit and Credit Cards.
• Pay bills, deposit cheques, and manage TD Rewards.
• Easily move or send money – within Canada or internationally.
• Trade – including partial shares – and monitor your TD Direct Investing Canadian and U.S . accounts using our helpful investing features.
• Stay on top of your credit score.
• Get faster, priority access to phone support when you login and call from the app.
READY TO MEET YOU WHERE YOU’RE AT
Whether you’re looking to meet with an advisor, explore TD’s account offerings or grow your investing knowledge, our app makes it easy.
• Book and manage in-person appointments.
• Research and apply for TD Accounts and Services.
• Receive personalized offers and insights on your spending.
• Increase your investing knowledge and confidence with our comprehensive library of ‘How to Invest’ videos and resources.
SIMPLE AND SECURE
We are committed to making the TD app secure and convenient :
• The TD app uses industry-standard biometrics for login (on supported devices) as well as two-step verification for greater peace of mind.
• Customize your Quick Actions and Dashboard based on your personal preferences.
Discover how convenient managing your money can be with the TD app.
By clicking "Get", you consent to the installation of the TD app (1) and any future updates that can perform the functions described. The TD app is for use by customers with TD Digital Banking Credentials. You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting this app.
IMPORTANT DISCLOSURES ABOUT THE TD APP
We use your mobile marketing identifier and other technologies to deliver personalized content on our websites and relevant advertising on other websites, unless you change your preferences. To update/manage these preferences on the TD app, use your device's opt-out settings. Open: Settings > Privacy > Advertising” and turn on “Limit Ad Tracking” to opt-out of interest-based ads. To manage these preferences on our websites, use your browser and select Ad Choices & Personalization at the bottom of the www.td.com homepage.
If you require assistance, call 1-866-222-3456, mail TD CASL Office, Toronto Dominion Centre, PO Box 1, Toronto ON, M5K 1A2, or email us at customer.support@td.com.
(1) Provided by The TD Bank Group which includes The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its affiliates, who provide deposit, investment, loan, securities, trust, insurance and other products or services.

bluejetty:00177849:ios.name: Solitaire Collection +
bluejetty:00177849:ios.summary:
Klondike solitaire, free cell solitaire, Spider solitaire, Tripeaks solitaire......the most popular solitaire card games, ALL IN ONE! Most importantly, it is FREE.
Solitaire Collection + offers 4 of the best Solitaire card games in one app
bluejetty:00177849:ios.description:
Klondike solitaire, free cell solitaire, Spider solitaire, Tripeaks solitaire......the most popular solitaire card games, ALL IN ONE! Most importantly, it is FREE.
Solitaire Collection + offers 4 of the best Solitaire card games in one app! And plan to add Pyramid Solitaire, Hearts and other card games in the near future.
Let's take a look at what great content is in the game：
KLONDIKE
#1 popular and classic card games. Fill all suit-specific foundations in ascending order (Ace to King) to win.
SPIDER SOLITAIRE
Eight columns of cards await you. Clear them all with fewest moves possible.
Play single suit or challenge yourself with four suits!
FREECELL SOLITAIRE
Just like Klondike, move all cards into the foundations according to suit, Ace to king. Need to use free cells strategically。
THEMES
We think that your game shouldn't be boring, so we provide a lot of well-designed tablecloths and cards looks. You can win coins to exchange these themes, and get a brand new game experience.
CHALLENGES
Every day, there are new challenges to be solved. You can accumulate points for completing challenges, and winning the gold badge at last.
More features coming soon!
*******************************
Subscription
Subscription is an optional subscription that gives you some bonus to play, such as remove ads， get some free coins everyday, gain more exp after winning.
You can subscribe to Solitaire for a term of one month with price US$1.99 a month and US$9.99 a year . The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Renewal prices are US$1.99 per month and $9.99 per year . The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged for a renewal in the last 24 hours of the current period. Purchasers can manage their subscription and turn off automatic renewal in their Account Settings.
Subscriptions may be stopped by turning off automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A subscription cannot be cancelled in the middle of its term.
*******************************
Privacy policy: https://www.mygoldenwood.com/privacy.html
Terms of service: https://www.mygoldenwood.com/service.html

bluejetty:00186622:ios.name: geotrainer: Geography Map Quiz
bluejetty:00186622:ios.summary:
Get to know the whole world, one quiz at a time.
Explore countries, capitals, flags, regions and cities through engaging quizzes. Discover the world from Amman in Jordan to Quito in Ecuador. Learn at your own pace and build your geography
bluejetty:00186622:ios.description:
Get to know the whole world, one quiz at a time.
Explore countries, capitals, flags, regions and cities through engaging quizzes. Discover the world from Amman in Jordan to Quito in Ecuador. Learn at your own pace and build your geography knowledge a little at a time. Just a few spare minutes on the train, while waiting or between appointments are enough to learn something new.
“My new favorite pastime. So much better than endlessly scrolling through social media.”
“The best geography app I’ve tried. You discover new places and learn where they are as you go.”
▶ Start right away
Open the app and jump straight into a quiz. No registration. No ads.
▶ Quiz your way
Choose from multiple choice, typing, saying it out loud, or tapping the globe. Pick the quiz mode that works best for you. Flag quizzes offer even more variety: name the country, pick the flag, point to the country on the globe, or color the flag. Would you like to focus on a specific region of the world? Customize the quizzes to match the topics that interest you most.
▶ Daily Quiz
Practice regularly with the Daily Quiz – every day, a new selection of questions awaits you. The app automatically adapts the questions based on your answers: questions you answer incorrectly appear more often, while topics you’ve mastered appear less often.
▶ Multiplayer Quiz
Challenge your friends and family to play a quiz together. Pick a topic, share the code, and compete in a live quiz. Who knows the world’s capitals best? And who can really name all the countries in Asia?
▶ A Wide Variety of Quizzes
More than 35 quiz topics. Start with countries, flags and capitals across every continent, plus regional deep dives — think U.S. states, Swiss cantons, Italian regions and cities from London to Amsterdam. Every region has free quizzes waiting for you.
▶ World Atlas
Explore the interactive globe. Discover each country through photos, fun facts, and carefully curated information. More information, travel guides and the latest headlines are just a tap away. Not sure how to say Ouagadougou or Reykjavík? You can listen to the pronunciation of the country and capital names.
▶ Did you know?
Open the app each day and you'll find a new country fact waiting. You can also add the flag widget to your Home Screen to discover new flags throughout the day.
▶ Become a supporter
geotrainer is an indie app, made and maintained by one person. Want to support my work? With the supporter subscription, you get all the quizzes for an affordable yearly price. Thanks to the subscribers, I can keep the lights on and continue adding new features every month.
Do you have any questions or suggestions? You can reach me directly from the app's settings. I'd love to hear from you.
Privacy policy: https://geotrainer.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://geotrainer.app/terms

Step into the ultimate multiplayer archery experience with Archery Clash! Compete in stunning real-time 1-on-1 matches, tournaments, and challenges against players from around the world.
In Archery Clash, the art of shooter sports and cold weapon mastery come together in exhilarating 3D duels. As a legendary archer, you'll wield bows, spears, and axes to outsmart and outmaneuver your opponents. Each precise throw and strategic strike will test your precision, strategy, and archery skills. Are you ready to rise to the top and claim your place among the bow masters?
Embark on an Unforgettable Archery Adventure
Archery Clash is more than just a game—it's an immersive journey into archery with RPG elements, strategic depth, and intense PvP action. Whether you’re drawn to the challenge of tournaments or the thrill of competitive matches, Archery Clash offers something for every archery enthusiast. Download now and enter a world where only the sharpest shooters and strategists prevail.
Engage in Thrilling Competitions & Betting Tournaments
Climb the ranks in exciting PvP tournaments, showcasing your skills as a master of archery and cold weapons. Experience a unique betting system that adds a strategic edge to every duel, rewarding both bravery and skill.
Strategic Shooter & Archery Gameplay
Dive into turn-based duels where every decision matters. Choose your weapon from a diverse arsenal of bows, spears, and axes, and master the art of knife throwing. Each weapon provides distinct gameplay advantages, perfect for PvP enthusiasts and fans of combat archery simulators.
Progress & Customize: RPG-Style Upgrades
Victory unlocks a wealth of upgrades and legendary gear, enhancing your prowess in this competitive sports arena. Customize your arsenal to match your combat style, making every tournament and betting match a showcase of your unique abilities.
Skill-Based Challenges for Archery Enthusiasts
Archery Clash is as much about tactical intellect as it is about precision. Anticipate your opponent's moves, perfect your aim, and time your strikes to dominate the battlefield. This archery simulator offers a true skill-based challenge for both seasoned archers and newcomers alike.

Whether you are noticing early thinning, have a family history of hair loss, or are already undergoing treatment–get real data, not guesswork.
WHAT THE SCIENCE SAYS
Hair loss follows predictable patterns. The earlier you track it, the more options you have. Hairloss AI is built on a neural network trained on thousands of clinical cases, delivering objective, consistent results every time you scan–the same standard every dermatologist uses, now in your pocket.
HOW HAIRLOSS AI WORKS
Snap a photo. Our auto-alignment system guides you to the correct angle for 100% consistent shots. In seconds, you get:
· Your Norwood stage–the clinical standard for measuring male pattern baldness
· A Hair Score (0–100) based on hairline position, density, and coverage
· A density heatmap that visualizes thinning areas before they're visible to the naked eye
TRACK WHAT MATTERS
Hair regrowth is a marathon – and for some, it's about staying ahead of it. Hairloss AI helps you stay consistent and see what's actually working, whether you're managing active loss or simply keeping a close eye on your baseline.
· Establish your baseline early, so you'll know for certain if anything changes
· Scan every 2 weeks to catch changes early and build an objective visual history
· Log your treatments–minoxidil, finasteride, PRP, red light therapy, supplements, and more
· Compare any two scans side by side to see real progress over time
· Spot patterns between your routine and your results
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
We understand how personal this is. Hairloss AI does not store your photos or scan data on external servers. Everything stays on your device.
WHETHER YOU'RE JUST STARTING OUT OR DEEP INTO TREATMENT
Some men download this app the moment they notice their hairline moving. Others come in already on finasteride, wanting to know if it's working. Some are simply keeping an eye on things because their father went bald at 35. And some just want to know their baseline–so that if anything ever changes, they'll be the first to notice.
Wherever you are in that journey–get your personalized hair analysis and start tracking with the precision your hair deserves.
DISCLAIMER
Hairloss AI is not a medical tool and should not be considered a substitute for professional medical advice or diagnosis. All results are suggestions based on currently available AI technology and the scan and analysis capabilities of the tools used. Always consult a healthcare professional before making any medical decisions.
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.hairlossai.app/policy
TERMS AND CONDITIONS: https://www.hairlossai.app/terms

bluejetty:00063164:ios.description:

Colorfull is a free coloring book for adults, you, me, and people of all ages. Simple to color: choose your palette and tap to color. Put your artistic energy to good use and color your own masterpiece! Feel the satisfying sense of creative accomplishment as you color away. Download now, it’s FREE!
GREAT FEATURES:
- One free illustration a day
- Make music while you color - a first for coloring books!
- Tap to color
- Zoom in/out
- Over 200 colors in 10+ palettes and counting - find your perfect pigment
- History palette shows previously used colors
- Easy to use UI
- 100's of beautiful images professionally drawn by artists unique to Colorfull
- Images added continuously
- 10 categories (and counting): florals, animals, famous works of art, messages, mandalas, ocean, treats, patterns - Colorfull has it all!
- Get inspired by artists and the Colorfull community - see what others are coloring!
- Quick sharing options: Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, texts, emails
- Works offline
- Your drawings are saved instantly
- Manage your masterpieces in My Works - recolor images over and over
- For whole family: designed for adults, appropriate for kids, children, boys, and girls
We are excited to continue updating the Colorfull experience for you. We’d love to hear from you so we can make it better for you, the Colorfull community.
Color Beautifully
- The Amelia & Co Team
*Synesthesia is a neurological phenomenon in which stimulation of one sensory pathway leads to automatic, involuntary experiences in a second sense. Steal an Egg run, Jump for animals, catch Brainrot, break your Lucky Block, and run for your life in a chaotic animal world! Experience satisfying Keyboard ASMR and typing gameplay as you escape every disaster.

GAME FEATURES
- Multiple modes: Steal an Egg, Tsunami Escape for Brainrot, Don't Wake Brainrot, and Find the Brainrot
- Enjoy satisfying keyboard with fun typing ASMR challenges
- Packed with Animal, Brainrot, Memerot, secrets, hidden zones, animal collection and Lucky Blocks
- Fast, chaotic gameplay built for jumping, robbing, running, stealing, and surviving
- Discover rare Brainrots and Mythic Eggs

HOW TO PLAY
 - Type across the keyboard to find Brainrots hidden around the map
 - Steal Egg, animal, catch Brainrots, rob players, and kick rare lucky blocks
- Jump to steal animals
 - Run from the tsunami and survive dangerous monsters
 - Open Lucky Blocks, unlock secrets, and complete your Brainrot collection

Download now to enjoy Keyboard ASMR, exciting typing gameplay, Steal Egg challenges, and chaotic animal runs! 

Steal, jump, collect, and build your ultimate animal collection today!

bluejetty:00128818:ios.description:

Welcome to London in this new adventure games! But it’s not the London you used to know. The magical glasses show you that just beneath the surface of a well-known capital of Great Britain lies a mysterious world of magicians, giants, dwarves, and magical creatures. You have been called in by your Lakrian friend Sakir beneath London’s surface and investigate a series of strange murders that threatens to break the centuries-old peace between the races of Lakrians, Dwarves and blue-skinned giants Yotuns. Go on a quest of hidden objects games to explore these unique and dangerous worlds as you track down the mysterious killer playing this thrilling brand new series detective games - Secret City: London Calling Collector’s Edition!
· EXPLORE THE HIDDEN CITY IN OUR GAME!
Enjoy your unique adventure in the Secret City and as you play hidden pictures, explore great landscapes, fantasy locations full of magician Lakrians, Dwarves and blue-skinned giants Yotuns!
· UNTANGLE THE MYSTERIOUS CHAIN OF EVENTS AND FIND THE CULPRITS!
Who’s responsible for the series of murders? Can it be the local residents, or some interveners? Be attentive to find all the seek and find games that will lead you closer to the answer!
· ENJOY COLLECTOR’S EDITION BONUS GAME AND MORE!
Magic puzzles, riddles, search and find games are waiting for you in this marvellous game, as well as a Bonus Chapter, Wallpapers, Concept Art and Mini-games that you can replay many times!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Secret City: London Calling! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00043191:ios.description:
Are you out of time and in a hurry?
Are you a manicurist (nails), hairdresser, or barber, or do you work with makeup or waxing?
Do you want a professional appointment book that is simple and quick to use?
The Nail Calendar does all the hard work for you and leaves more time to spend with clients.
Nail Calendar brings the most common Beauty Salon services registered automatically.
Then, with just a few clicks, you are ready to work.
We support the following beauty activities:
Hairdresser
Barber
Manicure (nails)
Hair removal
Make-up
The Nail Calendar also has the billing divided by:
Day
Month
Year
Register your customers directly from your contact list to make your life easier.
Start serving your manicure, hairdresser, barbershop, makeup, and waxing clients. You can also register personalized services to attend your Hall in the best way.
If you are a manicurist (nails), the app will help you even more with the possibility of inserting personalized manicure services. If you do nail artwork, you can set the price and duration of services.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Nail Calendar offers one auto-renewing subscription option:
$1.99 per month
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. This subscription provides you with unlimited access to the Nail Calendar features while you maintain an active subscription
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Read the terms and conditions here:
https://storage.googleapis.com/arbocorp/nail-calendar-terms.html

How Many - Trivia Game is the ultimate brainy challenge that will leave you exposed to the world of word games and brain games! Test your IQ with mind-boggling trivia and brain tests. Unravel puzzles, stack knowledge, and embark on an offline journey of excitement!
In this challenging and fun quiz game, you'll face thousands of unique and challenging trivia questions that test your knowledge of various topics and categories. With multiple game modes, you'll be entertained for hours as you play through quizland, answering questions and trying to outdo your friends in trvia. In each round, you'll be presented with a question and a list of possible answers, and you'll have multiple ways to respond. You can try to answer the question directly by selecting one of the multiple choice options, or you can try drawing a number with your finger on the screen. The game will use image recognition technology to try to understand the number you've drawn and provide you with a corresponding answer.
If you're not sure of the correct answer, you can also try guessing. The game will keep track of how close your guess is to the correct answer, and if nobody knows the correct answer, the player with the closest guess will win the round. As you progress through the game, the questions will become more difficult, so you'll need to use all of your knowledge and problem-solving skills to get as far as possible. With features reminiscent of popular games like trivia star, hq trivia, and triviacrack, you'll feel like you're playing a round of preguntados with friends. Whether you're a trivia buff or just looking for a fun quiz to pass the time, this game has something for everyone.Compete with friends in this thrilling trivia crack and become the trivia king. Guess answers, answer funny surveys, and have fun like never before. From Scrabble to Kahoot, this game has it all! Dive into the world of jeopardy, show off your brainpower, and conquer the top ranks.
Get ready for an IQ test that will buzz your brain with exhilarating quiz games. How Many brings you an unforgettable experience of word games and brain teasers. Download now and enjoy endless hours of fun!

bluejetty:00129089:ios.description:
Dive into the world of wild wolves and live your life as one of them! The best wolf RPG on mobile is finally here. Explore the amazing environment, develop your character and upgrade your skills to become the Alpha of your pack! You can try your strength in one of two modes: CO-OP or PVP - everything in Online Real-Time Multiplayer. Play with your friends and people from all over the World! 
Online Real-Time Multiplayer RPG 
Stunning 3D graphics
Beautiful environment
Realistic animals
Character development and upgrades
Cooperative multiplayer hunting and PVP Battle Arena modes
Smooth performance
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER SIMULATOR
Compete with players from all around the World! The wilderness is never empty. Meet other wolves in real time and conquer the forest! 
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Join your friends and family in game! You can now easily create your own team and play together. Keeping in touch is easy thanks to the friends list and chat options.
CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
Are you a mighty Gray Wolf? A Dhole Wolf? Or maybe a mysterious Black Wolf resembles you the most? Unlock new skins, choose your favorite and create your unique character! 
RPG SYSTEM
You are the king of your own destiny! There is no imposed path to follow in this simulator. Decide which attributes to develop and which skills to upgrade to become the Alpha of the pack!
AMAZING GRAPHICS
Enjoy the stroll around the map and admire the stunning environment! Starting from your den all the way to the mountains and streams, the high-end graphics make the game incredibly pleasant. Don’t the animals look realistic? Try and chase them all!
VARIOUS GAME MODES
Hunting mode lets you explore the map while searching for prey: from rats and rabbits, through does, foxes and racoons, all the way to bisons and bulls. Cooperate with other players to fight the strongest opponents! If you need a bigger thrill, join the Battle Arena mode - you will be teamed up with other wolves to compete with another pack. This means war!

bluejetty:00081171:ios.description:
Buckle up for an exhilarating journey with Car Jam! 
Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test as you navigate through a sea of cars, ensuring every passenger finds their perfect car.
Your job is to get a variety of colorful cars and their passengers to the end. 
But it’s not as easy as it looks - these cars are all jammed into a tiny parking lot, and you’ll need to use your wits to figure out how to get them out and onto the road.
It’s not all stress and frustration - Car Jam is designed to be fun and entertaining! 
The colorful graphics and catchy sound effects will keep you engaged, and the quick levels mean you can play for just a few minutes or for hours on end.
It's time to show off your puzzle-solving skills and become the ultimate Car Jam champion!

bluejetty:00153530:ios.summary:

Get smart suggestions on what to see and do, and where to stay and e
bluejetty:00153530:ios.description:
Whether you’re navigating a buzzing city or escaping to somewhere serene, Mindtrip is always in your pocket — ready to help you do it better (and yes, it’s totally free).
Get smart suggestions on what to see and do, and where to stay and eat — tailored to your vibe and location. Map your route, check what’s nearby and easily add stops to your trip plan.
Ask anything along the way and get instant AI-powered answers — plus trusted tips from real travelers and local experts. Need to shift gears? Update your plans on the fly. Traveling with others? Invite them to join your trip and make memories together, stress free.
Mindtrip puts everything you need for smart, seamless travel at your fingertips — personalized, organized and always a step ahead. You explore. We’ll handle the rest.
What’s in the App
• Personalized Recommendations: Get tailored suggestions for where to stay, eat and explore based on your travel vibe.
• Chat: Ask anything and get instant, AI-powered answers. Dig deeper and tweak your plans as you go.
• Interactive Maps: See what’s nearby, check distances and get smart routes wherever you are.
• Events: Discover what’s happening near you, from major concerts and sports to local happenings.
• Guides: Explore tips and itineraries created by real locals and travel experts who know a place inside out.
• Magic Camera: Snap a photo to learn more about what you’re seeing or instantly translate signs, menus and labels.
• Start Anywhere: Turn travel inspo from articles, videos, photos or Google Maps, into a chat, collection or trip plan.
• Collections: Save inspiration and favorites by theme or destination to revisit anytime or share with friends.
• Collaboration Tools: Invite friends into group chats. Share collections and itineraries you can edit together.
• Trips: Keep everything for a destination in one flexible hub — key details, chats, media, ideas, itineraries and bookings.
Mindtrip helps you travel differently — with everything you need, right when you need it.
We Love Feedback
We’re on a mission to make Mindtrip your ultimate travel companion — and your feedback helps shape what comes next. Got a feature idea, something you’re loving or something that could be better? Drop us a line at hello@mindtrip.ai and help make the app (and your next adventure) even better.

Collect the jewels scattered throughout the levels.

Features
Free-to-play
Take it offline! No Wi-Fi required to play
Many levels to play though
Simple control scheme
No time restrictions - enjoy the game at your own pace
Stunning graphics and eye-popping FX

bluejetty:00089722:ios.description:
Ponto Fácil is the complete app for anyone who wants total control over their work hours and overtime bank.
Easily record daily clock-ins and clock-outs, manage multiple jobs, and log absences, holidays, vacation, and extra entries — such as paid or earned overtime — keeping your balance always in sync with reality.
Key features:
Personal control
• Your time bank balance always at your fingertips
• Browse history by day, week, or month
• Partial and total balance always visible
Clock-in & out
• Easily record entries, exits, and breaks
• Save your location at the time of each record
• Photo of the receipt from the time clock machine
Multiple jobs
• Set different rules and schedules for each job
• Independent time bank per job
Cloud backup
• Save and restore your data via Dropbox or Google Drive
Home screen widget
• See your balance without opening the app
PDF export
• Full report for any period, easy to share by e-mail
Charts
• Total balance, daily balance, hours worked, first and last punch
Schedules & tolerances
• Detailed schedule for each day of the week
• Tolerances for automatic time bank calculation
Notifications
• Start of shift, break, return, and end of day
• Enable or disable each one individually
Absences & events
• Justified and unjustified absences
• Partial or full-day holidays and vacation
Light & dark theme
• Automatically adapts to your system preference
And much more!

bluejetty:00033261:ios.description:
Offline Games: No WiFi - FunOn brings a complete collection of mini games, puzzle games, board games, card games, and timeless classics to one convenient app. Play without internet at home, while traveling, or whenever WiFi is unavailable.
From flights and road trips to subway rides, daily commutes, waiting rooms, and quiet breaks, FunOn is ready whenever you want to play. Open the app, choose a game, and turn the fun on.
Your Offline Games Collection
Find something for every mood. Relax with a classic, solve a quick puzzle, train your brain, challenge an opponent, or enjoy a casual mini game when you only have a few minutes.
Classic Board & Card Games
Ludo
Play the classic board game against friends or AI opponents. Plan your route, protect your pieces, and race to the finish without needing an internet connection.
Solitaire
Enjoy the timeless card game wherever you are. Sort the cards, build each stack, and complete a relaxing round at your own pace.
Strategy Games
Think ahead, plan every move, and test your decision-making skills in board games designed for thoughtful offline play.
Puzzle & Brain Games
Block Puzzles
Fit blocks, clear lines, and find the right place for every piece. Simple controls and satisfying challenges make block puzzles easy to begin and rewarding to master.
Color Match & Logic Puzzles
Recognize patterns, match colors, organize objects, and solve creative logic challenges while exercising concentration and problem-solving skills.
IQ & Brain Training
Test your memory, attention, reasoning, and logic with smart challenges. Discover solutions and give your mind a quick workout wherever you are.
Relaxing & Casual Mini Games
Match-3 Games
Swipe, match, and create satisfying combinations in colorful levels. These casual puzzles are ideal for relaxing moments and short breaks.
Quick Mini Games
Discover easy-to-learn challenges for short sessions or longer play. Switch between different gameplay styles without downloading a separate app for every game.
Why Play FunOn?
• Play the included games without internet or WiFi
• Works in airplane mode
• Mini games, puzzles, board games, and card games in one collection
• Relaxing, casual, strategic, and brain-training challenges
• Play solo, against AI, or together on one device where supported
• Simple navigation and quick access to every game
• Suitable for quick breaks and longer play sessions
• New games, improvements, and challenges added through updates
Play Offline Anytime, Anywhere
Keep your favorite offline games ready when a stable connection is unavailable. FunOn is a convenient choice for:
• Flights and airplane travel
• Road trips and long journeys
• Subway and train rides
• Daily commuting
• Waiting rooms and appointments
• Breaks at work or school
• Relaxing at home
• Taking time away from the online world
A Game for Every Mood
Choose a calm puzzle when you want to relax, a brain game when you want a challenge, Solitaire when you prefer familiar cards, or Ludo when you want classic board gameplay. FunOn makes it easy to move between quick activities and longer sessions.
Designed for Simple Offline Play
The clear interface helps you find your next game quickly. The included offline games remain accessible without an active internet connection.
One App, Many Ways to Play
Bring puzzles, card games, board games, and casual challenges together in FunOn. Return to familiar classics and discover new ways to play whenever you have free time.
Whether you are looking for no WiFi games for a flight, relaxing puzzles for home, brain games for a commute, or mini games for a quick break, FunOn keeps a varied game collection in your pocket.
Turn your free time into play time with offline entertainment, casual games, brain challenges, and relaxing moments.
No internet connection needed. No WiFi required. Just open FunOn and turn the fun on.
Install Offline Games: No WiFi - FunOn and start playing anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00062365:ios.description:
Mémorable, l’application pour stimuler votre mémoire de façon ludique et intelligente.
En 10 minutes par jour approfondissez vos connaissances et votre culture générale grâce à des questions courtes, des extraits d’articles du Monde, des vidéos ou des infographies.
Chaque leçon se conclut par une correction avec votre score du jour, des explications de vos bonnes et mauvaises réponses, et une sélection d’archives du Monde habituellement réservées aux abonnés.
Pour favoriser une mémorisation à long terme, Mémorable prend en compte l’impact du temps et de l’oubli et construit un programme de révisions personnalisé.
Voici quelques exemples de leçons : 
JFK, “Mister President”
La chute du mur de Berlin
Ce que révèle l’ADN
La succession de Mahomet
Les débuts d’Internet
Le droit de vote des femmes
Disney, de Walt à l’empire
Le rap sort du ghetto
Le Mondial de rugby
Fonctionnalités :
- Cinq leçons par semaine (dont un atelier de révisions)
- Une correction immédiate 
- Un programme de révisions personnalisé
- Un accès privilégié à des archives du Monde
- Des contenus diversifiés : articles, vidéos, audios, infographies
- Des centres d’intérêts et des jours de réception paramétrables 
Témoignages d’utilisateurs :
« C’est addictif, on a envie d’en refaire ! »
« Mémorable : une façon très pédagogique et simple de présenter les informations. »
« Il y a des auteurs que l'on ne connaît pas suffisamment et dont il est bon de se souvenir. »
« Très bon nouveau format du Monde, intéressant et poussé, ça permet de revoir les bases et de comprendre certaines choses. »
« Je me régale de chaque nouvelle leçon, attendant la suivante avec impatience ! » 
Le téléchargement et l'accès à l'application sont gratuits et illimités.
Le montant de l'abonnement est débité sur votre compte iTunes automatiquement à la confirmation de l'achat.
Si un abonnement payant est souscrit avant la fin d'une offre gratuite, le nouvel abonnement (payant) débutera à la fin de la période offerte.
Le téléchargement et l'accès à l'application sont gratuits et illimités.
Politique de confidentialité : https://www.lemonde.fr/confidentialite/ 
Conditions générales : https://moncompte.lemonde.fr/cgv
Aide : https://www.lemonde.fr/memorable/faq

Слухайте українське радіо, відкривайте нові станції, створюйте список улюблених і насолоджуйтеся радіо всюди — на iPhone, Apple Watch і в CarPlay.
• Для вас: Відкривайте радіостанції завдяки щоденним рекомендаціям на основі того, що ви слухаєте. Доступно також на Apple Watch.
• My Top: Автоматично створює список радіостанцій, які ви слухаєте найчастіше, щоб вони завжди були під рукою.
• Радіобудильник: Починайте день з улюбленого радіо. Встановлюйте одноразові або повторювані будильники та прокидайтеся під обрану радіостанцію на iOS 26 і новіших версіях.
• Улюблені: Створюйте та впорядковуйте список улюблених радіостанцій для швидкого доступу. Улюблені та My Top автоматично синхронізуються між вашими пристроями Apple.
• Apple Watch: Переглядайте станції, «Для вас», My Top та Улюблені й керуйте відтворенням прямо із зап’ястя.
• CarPlay: Слухайте улюблені радіостанції в дорозі завдяки повній інтеграції з Apple CarPlay.
• Listen On: Якщо доступна інформація про пісню, швидко знайдіть її в Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music або YouTube.
• Зараз грає: Переглядайте інформацію про пісню й обкладинку альбому та насолоджуйтеся анімованою візуалізацією під час прослуховування.
• Діліться тим, що слухаєте: Діліться піснями за допомогою карток для дописів та історій або надсилайте посилання на улюблені радіостанції.
• Завжди актуально: Регулярно оновлюваний каталог забезпечує доступ до актуальних і популярних українських радіостанцій.
Radio UA можна безкоштовно використовувати для прослуховування радіостанцій з інтерфейсом, що підтримується рекламою. My Top та інші основні функції прослуховування доступні всім. Підписка Premium необов’язкова — вона прибирає візуальну рекламу та відкриває додаткові функції.
Premium
Оберіть Premium, щоб отримати всі можливості Radio UA: приберіть візуальну рекламу, відкрийте повну функціональність CarPlay та Apple Watch, перемикайте станції кнопками «Попередня» та «Наступна» в автомобілі, на навушниках або екрані блокування, використовуйте Listen On без денного обмеження та керуйте відтворенням за допомогою Siri та «Команд».
• Premium Індивідуальний – 1 місяць – 1,99 USD
• Premium Індивідуальний – 1 рік – 14,99 USD
• Premium Сімейний – 1 рік – 17,99 USD, з тими самими перевагами для всієї родини.
Спробуйте Premium безкоштовно та насолоджуйтеся Radio UA без візуальної реклами й з усіма функціями Premium.
Примітка: Потрібне підключення до Інтернету. Radio UA відтворює загальнодоступні онлайн-трансляції радіостанцій безпосередньо з їхніх оригінальних джерел.

bluejetty:00068276:ios.description:
Get a Real US Mobile Number + Global eSIM in One Powerful App
SLYFONE is the only app that gives you both:
A real U.S. mobile number (not VoIP) for verifications, calls, and secure texting
A global eSIM to stay connected with mobile data in 110+ countries
Use SLYFONE to activate WhatsApp, protect your privacy, make international calls, and stay online wherever life takes you.
What Makes SLYFONE Unique?
Unlike VoIP apps, SLYFONE gives you a real mobile number you can use for app signups, banking, and secure 2FA. And with built-in global eSIM, you get instant, affordable data without SIM cards, roaming charges, or local carriers.
Whether you're at home, traveling, or building your business, SLYFONE has you covered.
Top Features
Virtual U.S. Mobile Number
- Activate apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, Zelle, PayPal & more
- Receive SMS for 2FA or signups (works with banks, crypto, social media)
- Make & receive calls or texts over Wi-Fi/data
- Caller ID, voicemail, call forwarding, and spam blocking
- Perfect second line for business or privacy
Global eSIM Coverage
- Get mobile data in over 100 countries — no SIM card needed
- Easy to install and activate from the app
- Avoid roaming fees while traveling
- Use alongside your SLYFONE number for full global connectivity
- Ideal for travelers, expats, digital nomads, and remote workers
Use SLYFONE For:
- App & account verifications (WhatsApp, Uber, Binance, etc.)
- Two-factor authentication (2FA) codes from banks and social platforms
- Traveling without roaming or SIM swaps
- Keeping your personal number private
- Running your small business or side hustle with a dedicated line
-Secure texting & calling while abroad
All-In-One Communication Tools
- Real US number (not VoIP)
- Global eSIM (travel-ready)
- Send/receive texts & calls
- Spam call blocking
- Call forwarding to any US/Canada number
- Caller ID & voicemail transcription
- Share media in messages
- Number porting support
- Free toll-free calls (no subscription needed)
Subscription Plans
A paid plan is required to activate and use your US number.
- 3-Month Plan – $8.99
- Annual Plan – $29.99
- Outbound Credits – $10 for 1000 credits (1 credit = 1 SMS or 1 min call)
No hidden fees. No free trial. Please review pricing before purchasing.
Privacy Policy: https://slyfone.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://slyfone.com/terms.html

Conheça o aplicativo eConsig, desenvolvido pela Zetra, empresa pioneira e líder nacional na gestão de margem consignável. Com ele, é possível simular e acompanhar os seus consignados (empréstimos, seguros, associações, entre outros) a qualquer hora, de onde estiver, com total segurança e facilidade.
É perfeito porque, com um celular ou tablet, você pode:
• Consultar o extrato de descontos e o seu contracheque
• Simular um consignado;
• Ter o ranking com as taxas praticadas pelas instituições financeiras 
• Cancelar as solicitações dos consignados

Precisa de ajuda?
Para utilizar o aplicativo, é necessário ter em mãos seu login e senha para navegar com segurança.

bluejetty:00023429:ios.description:
Learn Japanese words the fast way with Lirer. 
On Lirer you can:
* Learn Japanese words from basics to JLPT N1 level.
* Practice Japanese Alphabets (Hiragana and Katakana)
* Listen to thousands of audio files voiced by native speakers
* Search through the Japanese words dictionary.
* Enhance your studying with a personalized review.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
* Explanation and exercises for all the Japanese words of JLPT N5, JLPT N4, JLPT N3, JLPT N2, JLPT N1.
* Japanese Alphabets quiz.
* Audio voiced by professional native speakers.
* Lessons created by Japanese teachers and writers.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Lirer offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $6.99/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $19.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Lirer courses while you maintain an active subscription. Lirer also offers a Lifetime subscription for $29.99 which is paid for by a one-off upfront payment with unlimited access to the Lirer courses forever.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. 
Read about our privacy&terms here - 
https://getbunpo.com/privacy.html
Have a feedback? Contact us to
iphone@bunpo.app

bluejetty:00070332:ios.description:
Use this app to receive remote assistance for all kinds of equipment, machinery, and infrastructure issues.
• Simplify troubleshooting and improve productivity by showing the problem instead of just telling about it.
• Receive real-time service and support from your remote experts
• Your experts see what you see and annotate with 3D markers that stick to real-world objects
• You can even share your knowledge by creating video tutorials for training purposes 
Key Features: 
• Remote camera sharing and real-time video streaming
• HD VoIP
• 3D annotations
• Highest security standards: 256 Bit AES session encoding, 2048 Bit RSA key exchange 
• Plus so much more…
TeamViewer Assist AR is the #1 choice for visual and remote guidance of field service technicians.
Information on Mandatory Access
● Camera: Necessary to generate video feed on the app
Information on Optional Access*
● Microphone: Fill the video feed with audio, or used to record message or session
*You can use the app even if you do not allow the optional permissions. Please use in-app settings to disable the access.

bluejetty:00119691:ios.description:
TradeStation: Born to Trade
Winner of the #1 Innovation Award from StockBrokers.com (2026) and Best in Class for Active Traders, Options Trading, Futures Trading, and Advanced Trading.†
The TradeStation Mobile App is your on-the-go connection to a powerful trading ecosystem.
POWERFUL ANALYSIS
• Real-time streaming quotes with price and volume alerts on stocks, options, and futures
• Advanced candlestick, OHLC, and line charts with dozens of indicators and drawing tools
• Custom timeframes, including pre- and post-market
• Hotlists, news summaries, sector ETFs, analyst ratings, and earnings calendars
• Notifications on significant moves and upcoming earnings
• Options risk measurement, volatility, and probability of profit stats
ADVANCED TRADE EXECUTION
• Monitor market depth and trade with sub-second precision
• Intuitive bid and ask buttons for faster order entry
• Analyze, trade, and roll options spreads on the go
• Scroll-away header for more screen space
OPTIONS & DERIVATIVES
• Advanced position grouping for complex multi-leg strategies by goal or underlying
• Flat, order-based, smart margin, and custom (Flex View) grouping modes
• Streamlined multi-leg workflows designed for speed and clarity
DISRUPTIVE, VOLUME-BASED PRICING
• Options as low as $0/contract for high-volume traders
• Futures pricing as low as $0.50/contract and $0.25 for micros
• $0 base commission on equities, ETFs, and options*
• No minimum deposit required
ACCOUNT FEATURES
• Secure login with Touch ID and Face ID
• Link your bank for deposits and withdrawals
• Effortlessly transfer between TradeStation accounts
CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM
Trade on the go, then scale up to TITAN X for multi-monitor support, deep customization, and advanced features. Manage your account through HUB. Explore TradeStation’s
expanding AI and API integrations, including TradeStation MCP, to connect your brokerage with the tools that match your strategy.
Need help?
Contact us at (800) 822-0512.
†Visit www.TradeStation.com/Awards to learn more.
*Fees and charges may apply. Visit www.TradeStation.com/Pricing to learn more about all the fees and charges that may apply.
For additional disclosures, visit https://www.tradestation.com/important-information/.
For US and non-European residents, securities and futures trading is offered to self-directed customers by TradeStation Securities, Inc., a United States broker-dealer
registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and a futures commission merchant licensed with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. TradeStation
Securities is a member of the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, the National Futures Association, and a number of exchanges. For European residents, securities,
options, and futures trading is offered by TradeStation Europe B.V., which is registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (no. 89426657) and regulated by the Dutch
Authority for the Financial Markets in the Netherlands.
Options trading is not suitable for all investors. Your TradeStation Securities’ account application to trade options will be considered and approved or disapproved based on all
relevant factors, including your trading experience. See www.tradestation.com/DisclosureOptions.
Security futures are not suitable for all investors. To obtain a copy of the security futures risk disclosure statement visit www.TradeStation.com/DisclosureFutures.
TradeStation Securities, Inc., TradeStation Europe B.V., TradeStation International Ltd, and TradeStation Technologies, Inc. are wholly owned subsidiaries of TradeStation
Group, Inc., operating, and providing products and services, under the TradeStation brand and trademark. When applying for, or purchasing, accounts, subscriptions,
products, and services, it is important that you know which company you will be dealing with. Visit www.TradeStation.com/DisclosureTSCompanies for further important
information explaining what this means.

bluejetty:00097195:ios.name: Known: AI Matchmaking
bluejetty:00097195:ios.summary:
Known is a matchmaker in your pocket. Tell us who you are on one voice call, and we'll introduce you to one person at a time, then book the date for you.
The swiping era is over.
Swipes and likes turned dating apps into an endless dopamine
bluejetty:00097195:ios.description:
Known is a matchmaker in your pocket. Tell us who you are on one voice call, and we'll introduce you to one person at a time, then book the date for you.
The swiping era is over.
Swipes and likes turned dating apps into an endless dopamine chase. Small talk is exhausting, and by the time you finally meet someone, it's often too late for anything real. Known gets to know you first, then handles everything until you're sitting across from someone worth meeting.
In early testing, 80% of Known introductions led to an in-person date. Not chats that fizzled out. Real dates, in real life.
Not a game. Not a job. Not a gamble.
HOW IT WORKS
1. A voice call, not a form
You talk, and Known listens: who you are, how you live and what you want from a relationship. Most members spend about 26 minutes on the call. Known writes your profile for you and keeps it current as it learns more.
2. One introduction at a time
No feed and no queue. Known sends one hand-picked introduction, chosen from what it knows about both of you.
3. 24 hours to say yes
You both have 24 hours to accept. If either of you passes, the introduction closes and Known starts on your next one.
4. Ask Known before you meet
Ask anything you'd like to know about your match before the date. Known answers from what it learned on their call.
5. The date, handled
When you both say yes, Known checks your calendars, picks a local restaurant that fits your tastes, dietary needs and budget, and makes the reservation. All that's left is to show up.
6. A quick check-in after
A short follow-up after each date helps Known make your next introduction better.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE KNOWN
- No swiping: one considered introduction instead of an endless feed.
- Built for serious relationships: everyone here wants something real.
- Fully handled: from your first call to the restaurant reservation.
Less scrolling. More intention.
This is Known.

bluejetty:00179558:ios.description:
Master the rails and take command of a high-speed metro system! In this realistic simulator, you are not just a driver, but the lifeline of a bustling metropolis. Precision, timing, and focus are your most important tools as you navigate complex routes and manage heavy passenger flows. 
BECOME A PROFESSIONAL METRO DRIVER
Take full control of a real metro train. You are responsible for maintaining strict schedules, managing acceleration and braking, and adhering to speed limits. Every shift requires absolute concentration—one mistake can disrupt the entire city's transit system. 
EXPLORE ICONIC GLOBAL METROPOLISES
Travel through some of the most advanced and iconic subway networks in the world. Experience the unique atmosphere of massive transit hubs. From the neon streets of Tokyo and Seoul to the massive transit hubs of Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Nanjing, and Wuhan, and even the iconic routes of Moscow — the world's most advanced cities are now your playground. 
DELIVER PASSENGERS SAFELY
Your primary mission is efficient transport. Stop precisely at every station, manage door operations, and monitor your progress through rear-view mirrors and specialized onboard cameras. The goal is to maximize passenger throughput while maintaining a smooth and safe ride. 
TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE
Monitor your professional growth through detailed statistics. Keep track of the total distance covered, your average speeds, and the massive number of passengers you have successfully transported across your career.
https://playway.kz/privacy
https://playway.kz/tos

bluejetty:00000578:ios.name: Game of Thrones: Conquest ™
bluejetty:00000578:ios.summary:
The War rages on! Forge your empire with Fire and Blood like the House of the Dragon. Raise your dragon, call knights to your army, and conquer the Seven Kingdoms in this immersive strategy building game!
Experience the official Game of Th
bluejetty:00000578:ios.description:
The War rages on! Forge your empire with Fire and Blood like the House of the Dragon. Raise your dragon, call knights to your army, and conquer the Seven Kingdoms in this immersive strategy building game!
Experience the official Game of Thrones and House of the Dragon strategy building game set in a timeless Westeros at war. Great houses clash, dragons rule the sky, and the army of the dead threatens the realm.
Build your kingdom, forge strategic alliances, and battle to secure Seats of Power for your empire. Train your dragon, command your troops, and collect your favorite Game of Thrones and House of the Dragon characters as you engage in epic war and strategy battles to conquer the Seven Kingdoms!
If you enjoy immersive battle strategy games, kingdom building, forming powerful allegiances, or raising dragons, Game of Thrones: Conquest is for you!
GAME OF THRONES: CONQUEST FEATURES
COLLECT HEROES:
- Over 100 heroes from House of the Dragon and Game of Thrones await your command, including Rhaenyra Targaryen, Jon Snow and unique dragon Heroes like Syrax. 
- Level them up to boost your kingdom’s battle and building stats. 
- Use strategy and deploy heroes into battle to reinforce your armies and win the war!
STRATEGY & KINGDOM BUILDING: 
- This strategy building game starts with you leading a house in Westeros.
- Build your castle’s defenses and train knights and other troops to raise your army for war.
- Research crucial technologies for battle and economy at the Maester’s Tower. 
- Craft powerful weapons, armor, and trinkets at the Forge to build the foundation of your empire!
RAISE & TRAIN YOUR DRAGON: 
- Build a dragon pit and receive a rare dragon egg to hatch. 
- Name, customize, and train your dragon . Turn it into the ultimate war weapon and scorch your foes!
- Raise your dragon to become the cornerstone of your kingdom and protect your empire.
- Feed it and care for it, and your dragon will help you become king! 
FORGE ALLIANCES: 
- Use strategy to build powerful alliances to call upon during battle.
- Bend the knee or recruit knights and bannermen as part of your kingdom’s strategy. 
- Become an unstoppable force and forge the next empire in the Great War!
 KINGDOM VS. KINGDOM WARS: 
- Experience PvP battle strategy game action and take over iconic Game of Thrones Seats of Power like Winterfell, King’s Landing, Dragonstone and Castle Black.
- Strategize, execute, and win with your allies in massive PvP battles to defeat whole kingdoms in epic tournaments. 
- Defeat empires and dominate the Seven Kingdoms!
VENTURE NORTH OF THE WALL: 
- Head North of the Wall with your empire’s troops and dragon to fight a whole new war!
- Test your kingdom’s strategies, strength, and coordination by battling unyielding monsters.
- Win exciting loot on time-limited instances of The Great Ranging and Titans of the North.
Calling all empire builders, dragon riders, aspiring kings, queens, knights, and castle defenders to rally to Westeros!
Game of Thrones: Conquest delivers a unique battle strategy, kingdom building, and dragon gameplay experience. Start your own empire, lead armies, and use your dragon to rain destruction on your enemies. Your goal is to prevail in war and become the ruler of the Seven Kingdoms!
PLAY GAME OF THRONES: CONQUEST NOW

X- https://twitter.com/gotconquest

YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/@GameofThronesConquest

bluejetty:00164549:ios.description:
Atlas – your all-in-one solution for clarifying any questions, creative content generation, education and seamless communication. 
Discover the future of communication, creativity, and personalized assistance. Download the Atlas App now and embark on a journey of intelligent conversations, limitless imagination, and dependable guidance. Your new AI friend is here to make every interaction extraordinary!
– Your Personal Assistant and Advisor
Experience the future of assistance! Our advanced AI chatbot is here to guide you through any situation. From answering questions to offering valuable advice, it's like having a knowledgeable friend by your side.
– Topic-specific Templates
Stuck on how to begin? Choose from a variety of templates tailored to different subjects. From casual chats to professional discussions, you'll find the perfect template to kick-start your conversation.
– Your Knowledge Partner
Need insights? Discover a world where your ideas come to life. With Atlas’s creativity and versatility, there's no end to the possibilities. Use the app to brainstorm, solve problems, and explore new concepts.
– Speech-to-Text Technology
Tired of typing? Just speak your mind! Our app converts your speech into text, making conversations convenient and hands-free. Keep the dialogue flowing seamlessly. 
– Unleash Your Creativity
Say goodbye to writer's block! Our app isn't just a chatbot – it's your personal writing assistant. Generate amazing texts, essays, and content effortlessly. Impress your professors, colleagues, or social media followers.
In-app purchases:
You can become a premium user by auto-renewing your subscription.
- Payment will be deducted from your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase;
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the expiry date;
- Subscription length: one week, one month;
- If you renew your subscription within 24 hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged the amount corresponding to the renewal price;
- Subscription cost: one week - $4.99, one month - $14.99;
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be disabled by going to User Account Settings after purchase;
- Cancellation of the current subscription during the active subscription period is not allowed.

bluejetty:00069430:ios.summary:
Bring everyone around one phone for Categories, a word party game made for playing face to face. Whether it’s a family game night or a get-together with friends, turn your next gathering into a lively race against the clock.
PICK A CATEGOR
bluejetty:00069430:ios.description:
Bring everyone around one phone for Categories, a word party game made for playing face to face. Whether it’s a family game night or a get-together with friends, turn your next gathering into a lively race against the clock.
PICK A CATEGORY. THINK FAST.
Choose a category for the round, then say a word that fits and starts with one of the letters on the board. It sounds simple—until time starts running out. Put your vocabulary to the test and see what everyone comes up with under pressure.
THREE WAYS TO PLAY
Party, Battle and Points give you three different ways to enjoy a word game together. Play with two or more people, all sharing one phone, and choose the mode that suits your group.
OVER 600 CATEGORIES
Animals, fruits, cities and many more topics keep the ideas coming. Pick categories your group enjoys, get creative with your answers and keep the conversation going between rounds.
MADE FOR TIME TOGETHER
Bring it out at a party, a family gathering or a relaxed evening at home. The people around you are part of the fun: their answers might surprise you, make you laugh or help you get to know them a little better. Want an extra challenge for whoever loses? Your group can agree on one.
Words Blast has been renewed once again to bring you the very best.
Gather your friends, choose a category and get ready to think on your feet. Hurry up—time is running out!

• Home Cleaning

• Pet Care 
• Moving & Hauling 
• Pest Control 
And more

bluejetty:00175373:ios.description:
If you're looking for "everything local," Patch is the app for you. Local schools? Check. Breaking news? Check. Homes for sale? We've got those, too. You'll always be in touch with your town with the Patch app.

bluejetty:00145821:ios.description:
The ImmobilienScout24 real estate app enables you to search free of charge for apartments, houses, properties, shared apartments, offices, warehouses and many more residential or commercial real estates. Do you want to find an apartment or a house to rent or buy? Just search with the Immo Scout app for real estates and find your new apartment or house.
YOUR ADVANTAGES AT A GLANCE:
EASY AND INTUITIVE PROPERTY SEARCH WITH VARIOUS FILTERS
• Free of charge and without commitment: Searching does not require a registration
• Targeted search for apartment size, number of rooms (studio, one, two, three or more…), features (balcony, built-in kitchen, garden, rooftop terrace…), real estate types (maisonette, roof top, offices…), apartments and houses for rent or buy (flats, bungalows, new built and resale homes, semi-detached or single family detached house...), commission-free real estates to rent or buy and much more
• Find suitable commercial real estates (e.g. office, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, warehousing, retail – rent, lease or buy)
• Search simultaneously for different places, cities, municipalities or zip codes
• Everything at a glance: Well-structured real estate exposés with various pictures and valuable information about price, location and features
• Send contact requests to the respective provider conveniently via email or phone
BENEFIT FROM OUR BIG REAL ESTATE OFFERING IN AUSTRIA
• We are one of the biggest and most popular real estate platforms in Austria with more than 70.000 listings
• Our listings include properties from all regions such as Vienna, Salzburg, Styria, Upper Austria, Tyrol, Lower Austria, Vorarlberg, Carinthia or Burgenland
• Start searching for apartments or find a house whether in cities or in the countryside, with real estates in Vienna, Salzburg, Graz, Linz, Gmunden, Innsbruck, Kitzbühel, Klagenfurt, Villach, Zell am See, Mödling, Sankt Pölten, Krems, Kufstein, Bregenz, Feldkirch, Baden among many more
• Whether three-room apartments, luxury houses in the countryside, properties, shared apartments or commercial real estates to rent, lease or buy – we offer a huge variety of real estate types
OUR LISTINGS ARE UP-TO-DATE
• Keep up with the latest properties: Save your individualized searches and get instant property alerts via notification or email as soon as new listings are available
• Save your desired real estates: Just create and manage your personalized shortlist and access it at any time, even offline
• Easily redirect real estates to friends, acquaintances and other apartment seekers
Thanks to the feedback from our app users, the app undergoes constant development and will be further improved. Thus, we are looking forward to your suggestions and ideas. What would you like to see in the next version? Feel free to contact us: support@immobilienscout24.at
Your team from ImmobilienScout24
http://www.ImmobilienScout24.at
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ImmobilienScout24Oesterreich

Join over 25,000 users! Break free from binge eating and feel in control again. Cravr is the #1 science-based recovery app helping you overcome binge and emotional eating, rebuild balance, and feel at peace around food. Whether you want to stop overeating, manage cravings, or finally feel normal around food, Cravr’s neuroscience-backed system helps you retrain your brain and regain your confidence.
With a structured 90-day, science-based recovery program, real-time progress tracking, supportive community, and full suite of tools…including reflections, guided practices, challenges, and more… you have everything you need to take control of your eating habits. Reset your brain. Rebuild your relationship with food. Reclaim your life.
**WHY THOUSANDS TRUST CRAVR**
REWIRE YOUR BRAIN
 Built on behavioral and cognitive science, our brain-retraining system helps you understand triggers, reframe thoughts, and regain control. Transform your mind into your strongest ally.
MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT
 Engaging daily exercises replace guilt with growth and restriction with mindfulness. Stop fighting your cravings… learn to surf them.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
 Monitor your improvements in mood, focus, energy, and relationship with food using Cravr’s real-time progress tools. Don’t just feel the change… measure it.
WATCH YOUR BLOOM BADGES GROW
Stay consistent and unlock new badges as you hit key milestones. Each bloom represents your progress… 1 day, 3 days, 5 days, 7 days, and beyond. Watch your garden come to life as you keep showing up!
A COMMUNITY THAT CARES
 Cravr is home to a thriving recovery community. Share wins, stay accountable, and connect with people who truly get it. You’re not alone in this journey.
ACHIEVE TRUE FREEDOM
 Every craving resisted, every reflection completed, every new habit formed strengthens your self-trust and resilience. Unlock your full potential.
TOOLS THAT WORK 
AI-powered craving tracking, urge-surfing exercises, and a full library of evidence-based resources…everything designed to help you heal and grow.
LEVEL UP YOUR LIFE 
Healing your relationship with food transforms your confidence, focus, and emotional well-being. Begin today and rediscover the best version of yourself.

"Now I feel calm, balanced, and in control. Instead of fighting food every day, I finally understand my cravings and know how to handle them."
I feel like a completely new person. I can enjoy meals without guilt, stop when I’m full, and trust myself again around food."
"The peace I’ve found is unreal. I used to think I was broken or had no willpower… turns out I just needed the right tools and support."
"Confidence. Eating out, grocery shopping, social events. I no longer feel anxious or ashamed. I finally feel free and normal again."

The subscription will automatically renew unless canceled in your iTunes Account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes settings.

bluejetty:00042175:ios.summary: Frank Pepe Pizzeria (est. 1925) is home to white clam pizza and one of the oldest and best-known pizzerias in the country. The Wooster St. legend is home to white clam pizza and one of the world's oldest and most famous pizzerias. Known loc
bluejetty:00042175:ios.description:
Frank Pepe Pizzeria (est. 1925) is home to white clam pizza and one of the oldest and best-known pizzerias in the country. The Wooster St. legend is home to white clam pizza and one of the world's oldest and most famous pizzerias. Known locally as Pepe's (pep-eez), it has its Original Location in the Wooster Square neighborhood of New Haven, CT. Today, there are locations across CT, MA, RI, NY, MD, VA, and FL, and they are growing!
Frank Pepe knew in 1925 that only coal burns hot and dry and doesn't give off steam like a wood fire. He knew that only a coal fire could give his "tomato pies" their famous crisp, charred, chewy crust.
 WHY WE MAKE PIZZA
A lot has happened since Frank Pepe started baking "ah-beets" 100 years ago. Pizza has gone from an obscure ethnic dish to become a mainstay of the American dining scene. But what hasn't changed at Pepe's is the family's commitment to the tradition of food quality and commitment to the community at large that Frank Pepe envisioned in 1925.
Pepe's reputation as one of the country's premier pizzerias spread far and wide as local residents, university students, and tourists passed through New Haven. In the early 1990s, Elizabeth and Serafina Pepe retired and passed the pizza business on to their children. This generation of Pepe cousins still operates the industry today and has overseen its expansion. Frank Pepe's Pizzeria Napoletana continues to thrive and grow.
OUR CRUST
One of Frank Pepe's first jobs was in a bakery, and this experience helped hone his skill in the art of baking. In its essence, pizza, or "apizza" as it is known in New Haven, is a humble meal with crust as the foundation, crushed tomatoes, and very simple, fresh ingredients topping the pie. The dough that all Pepe's restaurants use is identical to Frank Pepe's original recipe. Pepe's dough recipe is a wetter dough that takes longer to ferment, acquiring a much richer flavor than ordinary pizza dough. The hot, dry air produced by the coal oven works magic on the higher water content dough, contributing to the bubbly quality of the crust—almost like a thin, crispy, airy, ciabatta-style bread. Crisp on the outside and moist and chewy on the inside. True pizza crust bliss.
 OUR INGREDIENTS
Topping a Pepe's pie are the freshest, highest quality ingredients. The tomatoes come from a hand-picked field at the foothills of Mount Vesuvius in Naples, Italy, canned and imported every year at the direction of the Frank Pepe Family. Our clams for our famous clam pizza are harvested from the Long Island Sound, and the shores of Massachusetts and are hand shucked every day. The pecorino cheese, which adds the beautiful, salty finishing flavor to a Pepe's pie, is hand selected by the best producers from Sardinia, Italy, the birthplace of pecorino cheese. Our olive oil and cheese are explicitly made for Pepe's, using recipes and processes that work best in the higher heat, dryer baking environment produced by our coal-fired brick ovens. At Pepe's, we take meticulous care to ensure all of the ingredients topping our pizza pies are the very best.
OUR OVENS
A key to the Pepe's pie is the chemistry produced by the dry heat made by our custom 14 feet by 14 feet, 100,000-pound brick oven combined with our wetter, longer fermenting dough. Pepe's ovens are not your typical pizza oven – they are, in fact, a bread oven. At each of our stores, we custom-make a replica of the original Wooster Street oven, with every detail covered. We even re-use the mold first created in constructing the original caste iron doors for the oven mouth and coal chambers.
At Pepe's, we are proud of and passionate about the artisanal tradition of attempting to perfect the baking of mouth-watering pizza. Each and every day, we try to get better at our craft!

bluejetty:00100767:ios.description:
The NewsMemory eEdition app is offered by participating publications to let subscribers read an exact replica of the print edition on an iPad or iPhone.
Readers can quickly navigate the entire publication using iOS multi-gestures. Swipe to browse pages or sections or tap a live headline or page number to reach your favorite article. A thumbnail view lets you scan all the pages at once. To read a story, just tap to zoom the page image, or tap to article mode and read the whole story, including jumps, in the text window at the font size you prefer. The eEdition will also let you easily find topics using the section and story index, or find any ad or story via a full text search of words contained in the copy. The eEdition is published on the same schedule as the print edition. Just open the app to get the latest edition for on-line or off-line reading. You can also access back issues that you might have missed.To use, just download the app and select your publication. Access typically requires an account login and password that is provided to subscribers. Check with your publication for details. The app provides free access to a demo edition so you can try out the eEdition before subscribing. If you subscribe to several participating papers, the app will let you switch among them.

bluejetty:00084552:ios.summary:

Turn chats, articles, receipts, webpa
bluejetty:00084552:ios.description:
An App Store Editors’ Choice app, also recommended by MacStories and TidBITS.
More than screenshot stitching. Picsew brings scrollshots and photo stitching together in one focused, flexible workspace.
Turn chats, articles, receipts, webpages, notes, and comment threads into clean scrollshots. Then use the same app to arrange travel photos, recipes, outfits, tutorials, product comparisons, before-and-after stories, and social posts into polished vertical or horizontal images.
Whether you are saving something for later or creating something worth sharing, Picsew helps you move from a folder full of images to one finished piece—without tedious cropping, manual alignment, or switching between several apps.
SCROLLSHOTS WITHOUT THE BUSYWORK
• Scroll through content in any app and Picsew turns it into one complete scrollshot.
• Save an entire webpage in one step when you need the full article, guide, receipt, or order page.
• Select existing screenshots and let Picsew detect the overlapping areas and stitch them automatically.
• Fine-tune every join yourself when a complex layout needs a more precise result.
• Keep long conversations, research, instructions, and reference material together instead of scattered across your photo library.
TURN PHOTOS INTO A STORY
• Arrange photos vertically for a long-form post, step-by-step tutorial, travel diary, recipe, or product showcase.
• Join photos horizontally for comparisons, panoramas, timelines, and before-and-after presentations.
• Combine screenshots and regular photos in the same project when your story needs both context and visuals.
• Work with up to 300 images at once and keep the finished result in high resolution.
MAKE EVERY IMAGE READY TO SHARE
• Hide names, faces, account details, addresses, and other private information with blur or mosaic.
• Add text, arrows, shapes, annotations, watermarks, and borders to explain what matters.
• Place screenshots inside polished device mockups for presentations, portfolios, app updates, and social media.
• Adjust the result before export so you can share a finished image instead of sending it through another editor.
EXPORT IT YOUR WAY
• Save a high-resolution image when quality matters.
• Export as PDF for documents, instructions, archives, and easy sharing.
• Split an extra-long image into neatly sized slices for social platforms and messaging apps.
Picsew fits into the way you already work. Open it from the Share Sheet, jump in from a widget, and navigate with VoiceOver. From a quick scrollshot to a carefully arranged photo story, the tools you need stay together in one app.

* Listen anywhere with downloadable audio narration in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and other languages 
* Be inspired and reminded daily with scripture notifications
* Become more familiar with the Book of Mormon by exploring the Discover section
* See the Book of Mormon come to life with dramatized accounts in the Videos section

bluejetty:00128940:ios.description:
ATTENTION: Only for use in participating laundry locations.
Scheffres Laundry is an iPhone application providing the easiest and smartest complete laundry solution. This app allows you to pay for laundry cycles from your account by using Bluetooth to communicate with the washer or dryer.
Simply use Scheffres Laundry to purchase credit right from the app, then use that credit for your laundry. A full accounting is available to see your transaction purchase history.
• Scan the QR code of your laundry room (one time process)
• Start laundry machines via Bluetooth by scanning QR code on the machine
• Check your card/account balance, and add value to your account for laundry.
For participating laundry rooms, you can view machine availability as well as receive alerts when your laundry cycle is complete.
