bluejetty:00134257:ios.name: Places Been - Travel Tracker
bluejetty:00134257:ios.summary:
Keep track of all countries, states, cities and places that you visited on your trips!
"Places Been" is a travel tracker app that allows you to conveniently search and mark those places, as easy as placing pins on your travel map. Visited
bluejetty:00134257:ios.description:
Keep track of all countries, states, cities and places that you visited on your trips!
"Places Been" is a travel tracker app that allows you to conveniently search and mark those places, as easy as placing pins on your travel map. Visited places are beautifully displayed with their corresponding country flag on a map.
The app automatically generates a list of all visited countries and states/provinces/regions based on the cities you tagged. It also helps you to keep track of your personal Bucket List - all places that you are still planning to visit and your fav places in the world.
As a bonus you can create your personal Flag Map based on the countries that you visited - similar to a scratchmap!
Complete list of features:
• Travel tracker: Tagging of visited cities, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, national parks and airports & cruise ports
• Tracking of visited US American National Park, US National Monuments and Nationalparks of many more countries!
• More than 8000 commercial airports of the world to track
• Mark your favorite places and create your bucket list
• Travel inspiration: Find landmarks and inspiring places for your next trip / in your next destination
• Extensive offline database containing all cities > 500 inhabitants in the world
• Complete list of all countries of the world including their flags
• List of all states, provinces or regions for the following countries: United States (US), Canada (CA), Germany (DE), Austria (AT), Switzerland (CH), Spain (ES), Italy (IT), France (FR), United Kingdom (GB), Australia (AU), Brasil (BR), Portugal (PT), Ireland (IE), Poland (PL), Sweden (SE), Romania (RO) and more
• Highlighting of visited countries, continents and states/regions based on tagged places
• Manage of your own Bucket-List (places you want to visit)
• Generate your personal Flag Map (flags of visited countries within their country shapes)
• Stats about the places that you traveled to
• Import of TripAdvisor My Travel Map / "Where I've Been" Map
• Share your pinned places and your maps via Twitter, Facebook, Whatsapp with your friends and family
• View your personal travel map online from any device
Are you a world traveler or do you want to travel the world? Start your travelmap now and remember where you've been and what you've seen!

bluejetty:00023555:ios.description:
This is the highly recommended and praised Function Generator App - an amazingly great and powerful tone generator. Enriched with a vast amount of features yet it is extremely intuitive and designed for simplicity.
Get to know this great App now! It is very well maintained and has received considerable upgrades over the past years.
So, … what can you do with this App?
• PLAY TEST TONES Sine, Rectangular, Triangular and Sawtooth.
• PLAY FREQUENCY SWEEP TEST TONES in both directions (minimum to maximum frequency and maximum to minimum frequency). 
• PLAY VOLUME SWEEPS (from minimum to maximum volume).
• Try the SWEEP REPEAT / WOBBLE function.
• Try the MUSIC TONES PLAYBACK.
• Experiment with the huge FINE TUNE SELECTON, PRESETS SELECTION!
• Or create your own CUSTOM PRESETS!
• And SAVE an endless amount of CONFIGURATIONS (Frequency, Sweep, Noise) for later quick access and direct playback function.
• Even play back different kinds of NOISE – White, Pink, Violet, Grey, Brown, Blue is also supported.
The Function Generator is AMAZINGLY INTUITIVE and SIMPLE!
AND THESE ARE THE ADVANCED SETTINGS/FEATURES:
=> Extending The Frequency Range (1Hz - 21kHz)
=> Extending The Sweep Times (0.1s - 600s)
=> Changing Min/Max Slider Frequency Ranges 
=> Changing Max Sweep Time Slider Range
=> Changing Signal Amplitude
=> Enabling Of The Sweep Repeat / Wobble Function
=> Frequency Slider Setting to Linear or Logarithmic
=> Left/Right Channel Individual Selection
=> Permanently Saving Custom Presets
=> Saving Of Endless Number Of Audio Configurations
=> Phase Out Setting (custom phase shift of the generated signal)
=> BPM (Beats per Minute) Feature
=> Dual Function Generator
=> MultiTone Generator (playback of up to eight individual tones)
=> Background Theme Selection (Light/Dark)
Check out the new Tutorial page: www.ee-toolkit.com/audio-function-generator

bluejetty:00047068:ios.description:
Trickster: The creative group game in the style of Dixit, Tabu, Activity or Nobody is perfect. 
A fun board game for 3 to 99 players, with which you are guaranteed to banish boredom. And the best part? Anyone can play the game from home! This way, you can laugh together even from a distance 
Trickster: Sometimes personal, sometimes a little embarrassing, sometimes just crazy, different questions guarantee you varied rounds. Trickster is THE parlour game for your game night or for a quick round in between.
No equipment is required: Just have everyone download the app and you're ready to go! Whether with friends or in large mixed groups, fun is guaranteed with this game!
Which friend knows you the best?
Who can distinguish the Tricksters’ answer and from the fake ones?
How can you spark your creativity?
Who is the Trickster?
The trickster game principle:
INFO: you must be at least three to play Trickster! Each of you has to download the free app on your mobile phone.
- All players* will see an incomplete statement on their smartphone, for example "If I won the lottery tomorrow, the first thing I would do is...". 
- The players have to complete it from the Trickster's (= game master's) point of view in such a way that they put themselves in the Trickster's position and answer as if the Trickster had written this answer. The Trickster answers the question to the best of his knowledge.
- Once everyone has submitted their answer, all of the suggested solutions appear on their display, including the Trickster's, which must be guessed. 
- Now each player types in which of the statements he or she thinks the Trickster has written. After that the game is resolved. 
- Points are awarded to every player who has correctly guessed the Trickster's statement. If the own suggestion was picked, points are also awarded. The Trickster gets points for each correct guess.
Trickster: The creative group game in the style of Dixit, Tabu, Activity or Nobody is perfect. 
A fun parlor game for 3 to 99 players, with which you are guaranteed to banish boredom. And the best part? Anyone can play the game from home! This way, you can laugh together even from a distance.

The key goal of Hiddify is to provide a secure, user-friendly and efficient tunnelling client. It enables you to route all traffic to a remote server of your choose, utilising VPN-Service permission.

- Hiddify Profile
- Normal V2ray/Xray Connection Profile Link
- Clash Connection Profile Link
- Sing-Box Connection Profile Link

 - User Friendly
 - Optimized and Fast
 - Automatically select LowestPing , LoadBalance
 - Show user usage information
 - Easily import sublink by one click using deeplinking 
 - Free and No ADS
 - Easily switch user sublinks
 - more and more
Support:
- XHTTP, Mieru, Naive, Wireguard
- All Protocols supported by Sing-Box 
- VLESS + xtls reality, vision
- VMESS
- Trojan
- ShoadowSocks
- Reality
- V2ray
- Hystria2
- TUIC
- SSH
- ShadowTLS

bluejetty:00179168:ios.description:
Banking That Fits Around Your Life
The NBB App makes everyday banking simple, secure, and fully digital. Open accounts, send money, pay bills, manage cards, apply for personal finance, invest, update your KYC, and monitor your finances from one convenient app. 
Open Accounts in Minutes
• Open your first NBB account in under five minutes using a selfie.
• Access multiple currencies with a single debit card.
• Manage all your accounts in one place.
• Open and manage a Thara’a Prize Account digitally, track activity, and grow your savings while earning chances to win dream prizes.
Digital Personal Finance
• Apply for personal financing anytime, anywhere.
• Top up existing finance with minimal documentation.
• Access Instant Top Up and receive funds within minutes, with no documents required for eligible customers. 
Account Management
• View balances, transaction history, investments, and card activity.
• Personalise account names and favorite frequently used accounts.
• Copy and share your IBAN instantly.
• Top up BHD accounts using debit cards from other banks.
• Download account statements for up to six months. 
Send Money with Ease
• Transfer between your own NBB accounts.
• Send funds to other NBB customers.
• Make local transfers through Fawri and Fawri+.
• Schedule recurring payments with standing orders.
• Add, edit, search, and manage beneficiaries easily. 
Pay Bills Conveniently
• Pay utility and service bills through Fawateer.
• View outstanding balances for favorite billers.
• Settle multiple bills in a single transaction. 
Complete Card Control
• Manage debit, credit, and prepaid cards directly from the app.
• Lock or unlock cards instantly.
• Replace, reissue, activate cards, and manage PINs.
• Link or unlink multi-currency accounts.
• View card details, transactions, and statements.
• Set spending limits for supplementary credit cards.
• Add eligible cards to Apple Pay for secure contactless payments. 
Yalla Family Banking
Designed for children aged 10–18, Yalla Family Banking helps families build good money habits.
• Open and manage a child’s account.
• Send allowances and respond to money requests.
• Support savings goals through Savings Pots.
• Monitor spending and control card settings. 
Digital Investments
Access government securities and Treasury Bills directly through the app.
• View available offerings.
• Submit bids digitally.
• Track holdings, maturity dates, and reinvestment instructions. 
Secure and Easy Access
• Register using National ID, account number, debit card, or credit card.
• Sign in with biometrics or a passcode.
• Reset passwords directly within the app. 
The NBB App brings everyday banking, family finance, personal financing, payments, card management, savings, and investment services together in one secure digital experience.

bluejetty:00015839:ios.description:
علا - كل اللي تحتاجه للتفوق في مكان واحد
حياكم الله في علا، المنصة التعليمية الرائدة والمعتمدة التي تساعدك على الدراسة بذكاء ورفع درجاتك. صُممت علا لتجمع كل ما يحتاجه الطالب للتفوق في مكان واحد، ريح نفسك من تشتت و تعدد المصادر و البحث في عشرات القنوات والمواقع. مواد علا الشاملة تُحدَّث باستمرار لتتوافق مع أحدث تغييرات منهجك، لتمنحك تجربة تعليمية موثوقة ومتكاملة علشان تقدر تدرس وانت مرتاح ومطمئن.
سواء كنت تستعد للاختبار القصير، أو لاختبار الفاينل، أو اذا كنت ترغب في تحسين مستواك الدراسي، ستجد في علا كل ما تحتاجه لفهم الدروس بشكل أسرع، وتنظيم مذاكرتك، والاستعداد للتفوق في اختباراتك بثقة.
مواد منصة علا معدة من نخبة المعلمين ذوي الخبرة العميقة في شرح منهجك. في كل مادة يستفيد الطالب من:
• دروس مسجلة قصيرة ومركزة مشروحة بأسلوب واضح وممتع تبسط المفاهيم المعقدة إلى شرح سهل وسلس.
• مذكرات شاملة تغطي منهجك بالكامل وتوفر مرجعًا متكاملاً للمذاكرة. يغنيك عن أي مصدر آخر.
• ملخصات الزبدة والمسارات السريعة التي تختصر لك الاستعداد لاختبارك في وقت أقل وتحدد لك أهم المواضيع.
• اختبارات سابقة محاكية مع تقارير أداء شخصية تساعدك على تحديد نقاط ضعفك والتغلب عليها.
• مدرسك بين يديك متى ما احتجته - اسأل معلمك واحصل على اجابة فورية من معلمين ذوي خبرة في منهجك وفاهمين طريقة تفكيرك.
• بثوث مراجعة مباشرة تجهزك للاختبار وتراجع لك منهج اختبارك وتعطيك فرصة لتتفاعل مع مدرسك.
• بطاقات الحفظ والعاب الحفظ التي تساعدك في حفظ كل ما تحتاج معرفته لاختبارك.
ادرس على راحتك في أي وقت وبأي مكان و حرر نفسك من جدول التدريس الخصوصي المحدود. وفر فلوسك وتفوق.
تفتخر منصة علا بحصولها على جائزة أفضل منصة تعليمية في الدولة، وبثقة آلاف الطلاب الذين يعتمدون على المنصة لمساعدتهم على رفع درجاتهم، وتوفير وقتهم، وتحقيق أهدافهم الدراسية. منصة علا هي الخيار المعتمد من الطلبة الأوائل – حيث أن خريجي منصة علا يتصدرون قائمة الطلبة الأوائل كل سنة.
اشترك في منصة علا اليوم واحصل على كل ما تحتاجه وانطلق في رحلة التفوق.
علا - ادرس بذكاء

bluejetty:00134915:ios.name: SonoSequencr
bluejetty:00134915:ios.summary:
With SonoSequencr you can create individual sequences to perform recurring tasks with just one click.
If you have multiple Sonos devices and want to play a radio station on all of them, it takes some time to set this up. With SonoSequencr,
bluejetty:00134915:ios.description:
With SonoSequencr you can create individual sequences to perform recurring tasks with just one click.
If you have multiple Sonos devices and want to play a radio station on all of them, it takes some time to set this up. With SonoSequencr, all you have to do is open the app and tap your previously created sequence.
You can lock your iOS device or use another app while your sequence is running in the background.
Of course, you can also start it from the widget (The Today widget is only available up to and including iOS 17), Apple Watch or using Flic Buttons.
Here are some examples:
- Group kitchen and dining room, set volume to 5, start a radio station and set a sleep timer to 2 hours
- Switch your Playbar in the living room to the TV input, set the volume to 40, add dining room and set the equalizer settings for both devices to neutral
- Disable the subwoofer and enable voice enhancement + night mode on the Playbar in the living room
- Set the equalizer settings for all your devices to specific values
- Disable touch on speaker and enable status light for all your devices
- Set the volume of the kitchen and living room to the same value as in the dining room
- Make an announcement with your individual text in the children's room
- etc...
Each of these examples, created once, requires only one tap in the widget or on your Apple Watch.
SonoSequencr also includes a restricted mode. This allows you to restrict control to specific devices, among other things.
Using an optional in-app purchase, you can also start sequences at specific times or via webhooks (e.g. from IFTTT). Of course, this requires that the iOS device is on the same network as your Sonos devices at the time. For intensive use of webhooks, it is recommended to run SonoSequencr in 'server mode'. In this mode, SonoSequencr is always running in the foreground on a dedicated iOS device.
There are many more features like grid view, create dynamic alarms, HTTP requests, launch other apps, automatic battery charging in server mode, transfer sequences between devices, etc....
You can only use music (radio streams/tracks/albums) for your sequences that are stored in your Sonos Favorites (My Sonos) or in your TuneIn radio stations. You can't search your entire music library in this app. Just add your most used music to my Sonos then it can be used in your sequences.
The Timed Sequences feature is only available with an optional in-app purchase 'Premium'. With this automatically renewing subscription, up to 20 sequences can be run at freely configurable times. The function is only active as long as a valid subscription exists. The costs are billed via the iTunes account. The subscription will be renewed automatically within 24 hours before expiration (same time and costs), unless it is cancelled before in 'Settings' -> 'Manage Subscriptions' or in the iTunes settings.
To use this app you must have a working Sonos system. SonoSequencr supports Sonos software 1 and 2.
For terms and conditions and privacy policy see:
https://celltekk.de/sonosequencr/help/privacy
This is not an official Sonos app.

bluejetty:00186415:ios.name: Music Looper - Practice Tool
bluejetty:00186415:ios.summary: Practice smarter with Music Looper – the all-in-one app to slow down, loop and isolate any part of a song. Import your own files or use Apple Music, record yourself with a metronome, and take hands-free control with a Bluetooth foot pedal.
bluejetty:00186415:ios.description:
Practice smarter with Music Looper – the all-in-one app to slow down, loop and isolate any part of a song. Import your own files or use Apple Music, record yourself with a metronome, and take hands-free control with a Bluetooth foot pedal.
Key Features:
• Seamless A–B loop playback
• Slow down music without changing pitch
• Video lessons & concerts: loop, slow down and transpose the sound with the picture in sync — frame step, zoom and mirror
• EQ & filters: cut the lows or highs, boost the bass, or isolate the left or right channel — free
• Automatically change speed, pitch, or BPM during practice
• Practice Lists: save your loops as ready-to-go practice routines
• Line up routines from different songs and practice them back-to-back
• Play Along: record yourself playing over a loop, then hear your take lined up with the backing track
• Progress tracking with daily goals, reminders, streaks, session history and stats
• Smart review: saved practices come back when they're due, sooner if they were hard
• Start a practice or practice list with Siri and Shortcuts
• Find songs and practices instantly with Spotlight search
• Follow your live practice on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Control playback from the Lock Screen and your headphones — play, pause, jump back to the loop start
• Apple Watch remote: play, switch loops, run practices and record takes from your wrist
• iPad & Mac: a sidebar for your groups and practice lists, with your library beside the song editor
• AI practice coach: a private, on-device suggestion for what to practice next
• Song analysis: reveal sections, chords and tempo — free for 5 songs every month
• Tap a chord for guitar & piano finger charts; jump to any section and loop it
• Auto-scrolling waveform: zoom in and it follows the playhead smoothly, keeping the next chords in view
• Mixer AI: separate any song into 6 stems — vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and more
• Automatic ready-named loops, BPM and first-beat detection
• Record music with metronome
• Organize your songs with folders and tags
• Export changed pitch/speed files
• Share loops with bandmates — export a song's loops and import them via AirDrop
• Teacher & student: assign a whole practice list — loops, practices and a note — as one shareable file
• Sync across your devices with iCloud
Practice Lists – build your own routine:
Save any loop with its perfect speed, pitch or BPM settings, then group your favorites into practice lists. Music Looper walks you through them one after another and gradually ramps up the tempo, key or BPM as you improve – so you can just play while the app keeps score. Set a daily goal, get an optional reminder, and track your streaks, session history and progress over time to stay motivated. Teaching? Share an entire practice list with your students as a single assignment they can import in a tap.
Play Along – record yourself over the loop:
Pick a loop, set a count-in, a short start delay and how many times you want to go round, then play while Music Looper records you through the mic. Your take is played back lined up with the backing track, so you hear exactly where you drifted – nudge the timing, keep the takes worth keeping and record again. Recordings stay on your device. Mix the backing stems to hear only the parts you need, save the whole setup as a practice, add it to a practice list, and every session counts in your daily goal, streaks and stats.
Apple Music + Shazam support:
Practice with your Apple Music songs. Record a melody offline and identify it later with Shazam.
Perfect for:
• Music students and teachers
• Singers, drummers, guitarists, pianists
• Dancers and choreographers
• Anyone who wants to learn or practice music effectively
To use Apple Music songs, an active Apple Music subscription is required.
Terms of Service: https://musiclooper.com/index.php/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://musiclooper.com/index.php/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00024386:ios.name: Otherworld Legends
bluejetty:00024386:ios.summary:
"The best warriors and fighters from different times and spaces are summoned to the mirage created by Asurendra. They pass one trial after another, to finally come to face the long-buried secret behind this realm…"
Welcome to Otherworld Le
bluejetty:00024386:ios.description:
"The best warriors and fighters from different times and spaces are summoned to the mirage created by Asurendra. They pass one trial after another, to finally come to face the long-buried secret behind this realm…"
Welcome to Otherworld Legends | pixel roguelike action RPG. You are the warrior we've been waiting for. Here you will be able to:
• Explore beautiful otherworlds like tranquil bamboo grooves, zen patios, grand underworld dungeon tombs or dreamy mirage palaces. 
• Master heroes with fiery temper and overwhelming power. 
• Collect bizarre and funny items and experiment with their combinations to find the best build. 
• Together with the randomly generated dungeon world, every playthrough is a thrilling experience.
Main Features
• Easy Control: Super intuitive control for smooth punchy combat! Super combos are just a tap away. 
• Distinctive Heroes: Many heroes at your choice, each with a distinct fighting style. Melee, range, and magic. Archer, knight, and kung fu master. There is always your cup of tea.
• Enemies of All Kinds: A huge variety of enemies, bosses and scenes, from towering knights to dumb cute monsters including zombies, ghosts and more. Crawl the dungeon and pick up a fight!
• Countless Builds: Collect a sea of items that offer all sorts of bonuses. Mix and match items to make up your perfect item builds. Explore the item combinations that best suit your fighting style.
• Randomly Generated dungeons: Prepare for all the surprises and adventures you can get in the roguelike world - random enemies, secret rooms and hidden shops. Brawl with unknown bosses, loot abundant rewards, raid the dungeon, and become the ultimate hero.
• Assisted Control: Assisted control helps you effortlessly target enemies and execute fabulous combos with few taps. 
• Exquisite Retro Pixel Art: A unique mix of 2D and 3D retro pixel art styles and awesome hand-drawn animations. 
• Play Online: Multiplayer supported. Team up with up to 4 friends afar and co-op to fight monsters shoulder-to-shoulder!
• Play Offline: No Wi-Fi? No worries. Single players can also enjoy offline battle anywhere anytime without the limit of internet connection.
Enjoy Otherworld Legends Now! Brawl with mighty monsters in this pixel roguelike action RPG, have some dungeon crawler fun, and make it to the end!
Follow Us

Facebook: @otherworldlegends
Email: info@chillyroom.games
Instagram: @chillyroominc
Twitter: @ChillyRoom

bluejetty:00119000:ios.description:
Brought to you by the #1 award-winning app.
Bookipi Expense is a FREE budgeting app with an easy-to-use expense tracker. Plan and record expenses and scan receipts on the go. Use beautiful charts to review your cash flow and plan your budget weekly or monthly.
Automatically track expenses by connecting your bank feeds to your in-app wallets. Your expense transaction line items automatically flow through to the expense tracking app with secure and real-time bank feeds.
Unlike other budgeting and money management apps, Bookipi Expense helps you separate personal finances and business expenses with UNLIMITED WALLETS for free. You can track your business, travel, and personal expenses in one budgeting platform.
Trusted by over 500,000+ small business owners and freelancers in 179 different countries, Bookipi is now delivering the FULL experience. Sync your budgeting data to our invoice maker and receive payments on the same platform.
Track all of your income & expenses with a versatile budget planner app. Monitor your spending and SAVE MONEY TODAY.
KEY FEATURES:
FREE Unlimited Wallets
Track your expenses and earnings for personal, professional, or even per-project purposes. By using multiple wallets for multiple occasions, you’re guaranteed never to lose track of your spending.
Sync Wallet Balance to Bank Feed
Sync your bank to your wallets in real time! Add multiple bank feeds and ditch summarizing expenses across your bank accounts. Save time and manage all of your expenses in one app.
Budget Planning
Easily create monthly or weekly budgets for better money management. Receive notifications for when you are nearing your limit.
Spending Limits
Set unique spending limits on each of your unlimited wallets. We'll notify you when your spending is close to your budget limit based on your inputs and real-time bank feeds.
Unique Categorization
Log and categorize your expense and income entries to make your finances easy to review and organize. Complete with unique icon assigning.
Charts & Expense Breakdowns
Each wallet has a unique daily report of monthly income & expenses. Visualize your spending patterns and plan your finances ahead of time with our charts and expense breakdowns. By analyzing your monthly financial activity, find out how you can save more money.
Receipt Storage
Store and manage receipts for easy retrieval. Just take a picture to store it in our secure databases for your easy reference.
Review Transactions
Our money management app helps with record-keeping so you’re more confident in money matters. Search transactions by date and name, and find attached photo receipts. 
Data Exporting
Generate instant summaries of your wallets with a tap through our CSV exporting feature.
Automatic Bookipi Invoicing Data Synchronising
Bookipi Invoice users are rewarded with automatic data syncing. Allowing you to keep track of all of your income and expenses in one seamless process. 
OTHER OUTSTANDING FEATURES:
- Expense Record Keeping
- Change Currency
- Transfer Expenses Between Wallets
- Transaction Notes
- In-App Chat Support
- Global Currency Selections
- Intuitive UI Design
- Frequently Updated Video Tutorials
Bookipi Expense is the easiest free app to track personal & business expenses in one app. Manage your expenses and plan your spending on the go. Track how much money goes in and out of your accounts and have full control over your finances today!

bluejetty:00146859:ios.description:
Unlock Your Brain’s Full Potential with Mendi
Elevate your cognitive wellness and transform your daily mental routine with Mendi, the brain training solution that harnesses advanced neurofeedback technology to help you thrive.
Experience Cutting-Edge Brain Training
Mendi pairs a sophisticated app with a sleek, lightweight headband to deliver scientifically-validated cognitive training. Utilizing state-of-the-art Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS), our system monitors changes in oxygenated blood flow to your prefrontal cortex, the brain’s powerhouse for focus, memory, emotional balance, and decision-making. With every session, gain clear, real-time insights into your brain’s performance and push your mental fitness to new heights.
How It Works
— Advanced Neurofeedback: Sensors on the Mendi headband track your brain’s activity, delivering precise and actionable feedback through proprietary algorithms.
— Brain Training: Think of each session as an exercise for your mind, designed to boos neuroplasticity and strengthen your cognitive capabilities.
— Safe & Scientifically-Backed: Our training protocol is not only effective but also grounded in rigorous scientific research, ensuring a safe and lasting benefit for your brain health.
Consistency is Key
Achieve measurable improvements by integrating Mendi into your routine. For optimal results, commit to daily training for six to eight weeks and experience a noticeable boost in mental clarity and focus.
Meet the Mendi Headband
— Effortless Connectivity: Enjoy quick, reliable connections with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
— Innovative fNIRS Technology: Experience neurofeedback engineered to revolutionize brain training.
— Designed for Comfort: Weighing just 55g, the headband is both lightweight and comfortable for extended sessions.
— Smart Features: Equipped with a built-in accelerometer and gyroscope, USB Type-C charging, and up to 60 sessions per charge, Mendi is built to keep up with your busy lifestyle.
Invest in a Healthier, Sharper Mind
With Mendi, taking charge of your brain health has never been more accessible or engaging. Join countless others on the journey to enhanced focus, improved emotional regulation, and better decision-making. Start your brain training revolution today and unlock the potential of a sharper, more resilient mind.
Elevate your brain fitness, download Mendi now and experience the future of cognitive enhancement.

bluejetty:00145364:ios.summary: iBiker, the ultimate cycling and indoor Spinning® tracker, will track your routes and rides, helping you monitor your indoor or outdoor cycling and training by distance, route, cadence, speed, and time. Free mapping, tracking, coaching and
bluejetty:00145364:ios.description:
iBiker, the ultimate cycling and indoor Spinning® tracker, will track your routes and rides, helping you monitor your indoor or outdoor cycling and training by distance, route, cadence, speed, and time. Free mapping, tracking, coaching and heart rate training app. Integrates with Apple Health and Apple Watch. 
Whether you love mountain biking or street cycling, iBiker is a great workout planner and route tracker! Create routes with GPS that you run on a regular basis and compare progress over time and over the same route. 
Take your rides to the next level, with amazing voice coaching, friends and family following, LiveTracking, group tracking, goals and so much more. Everything you need to make your rides great. 
iBiker supports other activities too, like runs, elliptical, Crossfit, and more. Track all you need to keep a healthy heart, stay healthy, or lose weight, from daily steps, to hard gym, to cycling over the hills and roads. 
Integrates with Apple Health, Apple Watch, or a Polar, Wahoo, Scosche, Viiiiva, POWR LABS, CooSpo, OrangeTheory, Garmin, Moofit or other bluetooth low energy heart rate monitors. We bring your heart rate and training zones to life, guiding you through what you need to do to be effective & get more out of your training. 
There is a ton free, but join us for totally cool heart rate tracking and zone training, custom structured workout routines, HIIT training, and more.** 
FREE FEATURES:
* Heart rate monitor tracking and training**
* GPS routes for outdoor workouts
* Customizable voice coaching
* Sync to the web for easy access, storage and viewing.
** Requires an Apple Watch or a compatible heart rate monitor (Bluetooth Smart)
Steps & Daily Activity Partners: 
- Apple Health
- Garmin
- Fitbit
Share your workouts too: 
- Apple Health
- Strava
- MyFitnessPal
- TrainingPeaks
SUBSCRIPTIONS: 
STAR membership – Yearly subscription, $24.99 USD or $4.99 per month. 
* Adds advanced heart rate tracking, training and zone support with an Apple Watch or a compatible heart rate monitor (Bluetooth Smart)
* Real time heart rate charts and zone analysis.
* Speed and cadence sensor support to help you track your biking distance, speed and cadence
* Fitness assessments.
* Create or use custom workout Routes & Routines to spice up your training (HIIT, LIIT, Tempo, you name it you can create it and do it!)
* LiveTracking – let your spouse or friends & followers track you and cheer you on during your workouts
* Create your own group online - share data with friends
* Compare activities and workouts for deeper insight
* No Ads
* More
All payments are charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, $24.99 per year or $4.99 per month for a Star membership. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription defined above, where applicable. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal can be turned off in your user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Privacy Policy: 
http://www.fitdigits.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: 
http://www.fitdigits.com/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00175243:ios.description:
Transform Your Faith Walk with Abide – The #1 Christian Meditation App
Featured in Crosswalk, TechCrunch, and recommended by Pureflix!
Embark on a transformative journey with Abide, the premier Christian meditation app. Dive into a deeper connection with God, find peace in your daily life, and rejuvenate your soul with our biblically inspired meditations.
Why Choose Abide?
Extensive Library of Christian Content: Explore more than 2000 meditations, 365+ bedtime stories, and full-production kids' stories that bring the Bible to life, along with more than 50 Bible book audio guides. Immerse yourself in audio from all chapters of the NIV Bible and discover featured monthly content that brings fresh perspectives and topics to your daily practice.
Thematic Biblical Content: Our content spans a wide array of themes, from anxiety and trust to healing and worship, ensuring there's always a meditation that meets your needs.
Tailored to Your Lifestyle: Whether you have two minutes or fifteen, Abide fits into your daily routine. Our meditations are crafted to accommodate your schedule, making growth in your relationship with Jesus both achievable and enjoyable.
Sleep Better with Biblical Stories: Drift into peaceful slumber with our collection of bedtime stories, all rooted in Scripture. Allow God's Word to lull you into restful sleep so you can wake up refreshed for the day ahead.
A Community of Faith: Join millions, including Grammy award-winning artists and Christian leaders, who have found solace and strength in Abide.
User-Friendly and Enriching: Easily engage with Abide. Press play and begin your journey toward rejuvenation and peace, guided by God’s sacred Word.
Personalize Your Journey: Save your favorite meditations and stories to "Favorites" for easy access, and journal your thoughts in daily entries to reflect on your growth.
Custom Experience: Select background music and nature sounds to create the perfect ambiance for your devotional practice.
Apple Health Integration: Effortlessly keep track of your meditation and sleep sessions with integration into your Apple Health app.
Subscribe for Exclusive Content
Enhance your journey with our yearly subscription plan:
Over 365 Bedtime Sleep Stories: Crafted for deep, restful sleep, including a rich collection of stories for kids.
In-Depth Guides: More than 50 audio guides on specific Biblical topics.
Extended Meditations: Dive deeper with longer guided sessions.
Short Daily Devotionals: Start your day with quick, inspiring messages.
Premium Music: Over 500 calming and relaxing music tracks
Hear from Our Community:
"I’ve been using the app mostly for sleep. There are lots of different topics I love, like freedom from depression. C’mon y’all! That is good stuff, check that out! There are people that need to know about this app. It’s amazing!" - Mandisa, Grammy Award-winning artist & American Idol finalist
"I love Abide so much! It helps me sleep. I listen to it every night." - Isabella R.
"I absolutely love my Abide app! It keeps my eyes and ears on the Lord throughout my day. I really enjoy listening to the app in the morning as I'm getting ready for work... This is one of my absolute favorite apps!!" - Maggie W.
"I wake before sunrise and flood my mind with Abide's blessings." - Bruce H
Discover Your Oasis
Let Abide help connect you to God in a new way. Download Abide now and begin your journey to experiencing the peace of Christ.
Subscription Details
After the free trial, your subscription will automatically renew unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by going to your App Store account settings. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00148579:ios.summary:
HOW TO PLAY
Are you a crewmate or a betrayer? Crewmates will work together to complete tasks around the map to win, but make sure to stay alert! Betrayers among the crew will sneak around to cause disruptions and eliminate your fellow crew
bluejetty:00148579:ios.description:
HOW TO PLAY
Are you a crewmate or a betrayer? Crewmates will work together to complete tasks around the map to win, but make sure to stay alert! Betrayers among the crew will sneak around to cause disruptions and eliminate your fellow crewmates.
Between rounds, you and your teammates will discuss who could be the betrayer. Did you see anything suspicious? Did you see someone sneaking around your eliminated crewmate? After discussing together, you will get to vote on who you think is betraying the crew. Warning: if you guess wrong and vote out an innocent crewmate, the betrayers will be even closer to winning!
MULTIPLE FUN ROLES
- Crewmates: to win, crewmates must complete all of their tasks and / or work together to discover and vote out the betrayer!
- Betrayers: if you’re a betrayer your goal is to eliminate crewmates and cause disruptions to their tasks!
- Sheriff: a sheriff’s job is to protect your fellow crewmates. Complete tasks and gather information so that you can eliminate a betrayer to save your crew! Be careful! If you eliminate a crewmate, you will also eliminate yourself!
- Jester: your objective is to convince the crew that you are the betrayer! Trick them into voting you out to win!
VARIETY OF MAPS AND MODES
Betrayal offers multiple game modes and maps!
- Core mode is the default mode that allows you to play with crewmates and betrayers
- Hide & Seek is a fun new mode where crewmates must avoid not only betrayers, but also a monster that will seek out and eliminate you! Work together to find your tasks and complete them before you’re found!
Want a change in scenery? Betrayal offers fun maps to choose from!
- Spaceship: board the spaceship for a trip to an unknown galaxy!
- Haunted Mansion: a two-story map with a spooky theme!
Looking for a change of pace? Take a break and relax with friends in Betrayal's unique fishing lobby! Complete quests, upgrade your fishing gear, and try your best to catch the biggest fish!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
Show off your style! You can customize your own unique look with a large collection of features, garments, accessories, hats, and pets! 
CONSTANTLY UPDATING
Betrayal is always evolving to bring new and fun content! Keep an eye out for new maps, modes, and cosmetics coming in the future!
Game Features:
- Play online with friends or other players from across the world
- Customize your character with a variety of fun features, skins, and pets
- New maps, modes, and roles consistently updated
- Easy and fun gameplay
- Unique and beautiful art style
Join our Discord server for more information, announcements, or to share your suggestions with us: https://discord.gg/RYANxDYM

Whether you’re working on growing your hair faster, enhancing its texture, or simply keeping it healthy, Styled provides step-by-step guidance to help you achieve noticeable improvements.

bluejetty:00115272:ios.description:
Welcome to Pop Jigsaw, the ultimate puzzle game designed to bring fun, relaxation, and brain-teasing entertainment to your fingertips! Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or a casual player, Pop Jigsaw is the perfect game to unwind, stimulate your mind, and dive into a world of captivating images.
Why You’ll Love Pop Jigsaw:
Wide Variety of Puzzles
Pop Jigsaw offers a huge selection of high-quality images across different categories like nature, animals, art, and more. Whether you're in the mood for serene landscapes, vibrant pop art, or cute animals, there’s always something new to enjoy!
Flexible Difficulty Levels
From beginner to expert, Pop Jigsaw allows you to choose how challenging you want your puzzles to be. Adjust the number of pieces to match your skill level and gradually build your confidence as you complete more difficult puzzles.
Simple & Intuitive Controls
Designed with smooth and intuitive touch controls, piecing together puzzles in Pop Jigsaw is seamless and satisfying. Just drag and drop the pieces into place and watch as your masterpiece comes together.
Daily Puzzle Challenge
Stay motivated and engaged with daily challenges! Every day, Pop Jigsaw delivers a brand-new puzzle for you to solve. Complete the challenge and earn rewards to unlock even more content!
Colorful Themes & Categories
Dive into various themes and explore an ever-expanding library of puzzles. Our vibrant images and artwork ensure that each puzzle is unique, and there’s something for everyone, no matter your taste or preference.
Progress Saving
Working on a tricky puzzle? No need to worry – Pop Jigsaw saves your progress automatically, allowing you to pick up right where you left off whenever you're ready.
Special Features:
Different numbers of pieces
Auto-save function so you can complete puzzles at your own pace
How to Play:
Choose a puzzle from the wide range of categories.
Select the number of pieces to match your skill level.
Drag and place the pieces together to complete the puzzle.
Take your time and enjoy the process – no rush!
Whether you're looking to relax or challenge your brain, Pop Jigsaw offers an enjoyable and satisfying experience. Download today and start piecing together beautiful images!
Subscription pricing and terms：
In Pop Jigsaw we offer you the following two subscription options:
1. A weekly subscription costs $4.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per week.
2. A monthly subscription costs $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per month.
3. A yearly subscription costs $49.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game. In addition, you'll get unlimited hints, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.

NOTE: This is *not* a Blackjack game, it is a practice aid for learning basic strategy in Blackjack, and it assumes you already are familiar with the basic rules of the game.  Using this app will *not* guarantee winning in real play, but it will help you play the best possible strategies in any situation.

• Skill levels: Higher levels concentrate your training on the harder-to-memorize hands 
• Strategy guide shows all the best moves and highlights the strategy for the current hand and dealer card
• Hint button shows a strategic analysis of the current hand
• Left-handed and right-handed playing layouts 
• Many different rule configurations (1-4 decks, dealer hits/stays on soft 17, double after split, early/late surrender)

Finances shows you at a glance how much money you have left this month – and what that means per day.
HOW IT WORKS
• Set a monthly budget and see what’s left
• Your month starts when you want – on payday, for example
• Log expenses in seconds: type the amount, pick a category, done
• Category suggestions by merchant – sort it once and the app remembers
• Choose your currency: €, $, £, CHF and more
FIXED COSTS IN ONE PLACE
• Rent, insurance, phone, subscriptions and one-time payments at a glance
• Shared costs: add who pays how much
• Reminders before every payment and a weekly preview
• See what’s left after fixed costs and what can go to savings
INSIGHTS & SAVINGS GOALS
• Monthly trend compared with last month
• Spending by category and category budgets
• Savings goals with an expected date
LOG WALLET PAYMENTS AUTOMATICALLY
With a Shortcuts automation, card payments from Wallet land in the app by themselves. You only confirm the category – right from the notification.
IPHONE AND MAC
Your data syncs through your private iCloud. Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and Mac desktop.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your data stays on your devices and in your own iCloud. Optional lock with Face ID or Touch ID.

Create problem sets and study with “Learned” and “Not Yet”, all within your note app. With Uni:Note, you can review alongside your original notes and study problem sets in the companion app Uni:Note Pocket by importing a backup.
Uni:Note is a handwriting app for iPad with a simple, ad-free interface that lets you write as you would in a paper notebook.
Designed under the guidance of a current university student, it focuses on being easy to use in class.
Along with Apple Pencil handwriting, it supports writing on images and PDFs, vertical notebooks, and multiple windows.
Keep taking notes while working with class handouts and PDF materials.
Use the notes you write for review.
Study Assistant (AI) supports Circle to Solve, problem set generation, and AI Summary. You can also create and edit problem sets yourself.
Recording and real-time transcription are also supported.
Take notes while recording a class, then use AI Summary to summarize the transcription.
Customize the navigation bar and palette to suit the tools you use most.
■Key Features
• Create and edit problem sets with handwriting, the keyboard, pasted text, or TSV/CSV files
• AI problem set generation from your notes
• Study with “Learned” and “Not Yet”, resume where you left off, and shuffle questions
• Review with your original notes displayed alongside
• Study problem sets imported from a backup in Uni:Note Pocket
• Handwriting with Apple Pencil
• Writing on images and PDFs
• Vertical notebooks and multiple windows
• Recording and real-time transcription
• AI Summary and Circle to Solve
• Sticky Marker
• Ruler, Move Selection
• Undo and Redo for moves and changes to shapes, pasted images and PDFs, and sticky notes, plus lines drawn with the ruler
• Open the Button Guide with “?” (from the “…” menu in a notebook)
• Pomodoro timer
• Navigation bar and palette customization
• Export PDF
• Backup and restore
■About Privacy
Uni:Note uses in-app identifiers that do not directly identify you to manage your AI Balance and purchase status.
It also collects diagnostic information, such as crash logs when the app crashes, to investigate issues.
When you use AI features, data needed for processing, such as selected note content and transcriptions, is sent to an AI service to generate answers, problem sets, summaries, and similar output.
Routine diagnostic information does not include information that directly identifies you or the contents of notes, audio, transcriptions, or attachments.
The information collected is used to provide AI features, manage their use, and improve app quality.

apple-macos:6760626211.name: PommeCore
apple-macos:6760626211.description:
PommeCore is the full-featured companion app for MeshCore LoRa mesh radios — a decentralized, off-grid messaging network that works without internet, cell towers, or servers. Everything runs over long-range LoRa radio, directly between devices.
MESSAGING
Send and receive direct messages with real-time delivery tracking (Sending → Sent → Delivered, with round-trip time). Channel (group) messages broadcast to everyone on the mesh. Reactions and quoted replies are interoperable with MeshCore One. Undelivered messages retry automatically, then flood the mesh.
CONTACTS & CHANNELS
Organise contacts with favourites, nicknames, notes, and groups. Mute or block individuals. Each group and channel has its own notification mode and sound. Export and import contacts via QR code or meshcore:// URLs.
MESH MAP
See all contacts with GPS on an interactive map. Tap a pin to open that contact's chat. Enable position trails for movement history. The link quality overlay draws colour-coded lines (SNR) to contacts in range.
RADIO SETTINGS & TOOLS
Configure frequency, spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate, and TX power from the app. Radio Stats, RF Monitor with Packet Log, Line of Sight analysis, Radio Calculator, Airtime Calculator, and Frequency Scanner are all included.
BACKUP & UPDATES
Export your radio configuration as a .meshprofile file. Firmware update checker alerts you when a new release is available. Over-the-air ESP32 firmware updates via WiFi.
REMOTE MANAGEMENT
Administer repeaters and room servers over the mesh — change names, frequencies, routing scope, and advert intervals without physical access.
WIDGETS & WATCH
Home screen and lock screen widgets show connection status, battery, and unread count. The watchOS companion lets you read and reply to DMs and channel messages from your wrist.
iPHONE, iPAD & MAC
One app runs natively on iPhone, iPad, and macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel). Connects via Bluetooth LE, WiFi, or USB serial on Mac.
LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Czech, Polish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.
ACCESSIBILITY
VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Differentiate Without Color Alone, Dark Mode, Voice Control.
PRIVACY
No account required. No servers. No data collection. All communication is peer-to-peer over LoRa radio. iCloud sync for nicknames, notes, groups, and settings uses your private iCloud account.
HARDWARE REQUIRED
A MeshCore-compatible LoRa radio running Companion firmware is required. Recommended: Compatible Mesh radio with latest MeshCore Companion firmware
IN-APP PURCHASES
Tip Jar ($0.99–$9.99) — voluntary support, no functional gating.
PommeCore for Apple Watch ($1.99, one-time) — unlocks the watch companion app.
All other features are free.
